fields.ammo:bone_arrow#description: Crude but freely available. Always replenished between fights.
fields.ammo:bone_bolt#description: Crude but freely available. Always replenished between fights.
fields.ammo:fire_arrow#description: Explodes on impact, dealing fire damage to all nearby units.
fields.ammo:frost_arrow#description: Chills the target, potentially freezing them solid.
fields.births:bg:ancestor_priest#description: The chiefs and heroes are laid to rest with the trophies of their most glorious hunts and offered blood mead when the moon is full.
fields.births:bg:antler_speaker#description: The young ones duel for dominance, the mature ones gather the kin with presence and speech.
fields.births:bg:apothecary#description: Everything is a poison. The dose is the whole of the argument.
fields.births:bg:apprentice#description: Three years of fetching, one of watching, and a fortnight of being allowed to try.
fields.births:bg:berserker#description: A warrior who fights with uncontrolled fury, trading precision for annihilating force.
fields.births:bg:blade_contemplative#descriptio: The mantis holds perfectly still before it moves. So do you. The strike is not an act of violence — it is the end of a very long thought.
fields.births:bg:blood_drinker#description: This is not their first incarnation in this body, and probably not the last, looking on how they savour the hunt.
fields.births:bg:bog_warden#description: Long years of standing knee-deep in the same patch of swamp have made you territorial and surprisingly canny about it. You know every root and current. Others stumble; you do not.
fields.births:bg:bone_dancer#description: You rattle with purpose where others grimace. A drum, a flourish, a joke at the right moment — you discovered that morale is its own kind of magic, and yours is inexhaustible.
fields.births:bg:bonfire_dancer#description: These? They make a clinking sound when I move, and these here are to reflect lights and sparkle, and this one is —
fields.births:bg:boundary_walker#description: You have always lived at the edge where ocean meets sky, where river meets sea. The in-between is home.
fields.births:bg:brawler#description: No school, no forms, no weapon. A very great deal of practice.
fields.births:bg:cache_master#description: Wherever they go in the forest, they know a spot. A bag hidden here, food stashed in a tree stump there, a safehouse when you need it.
fields.births:bg:canopy_ambush#description: They look for traps on the ground, listen for rustling in the leaves behind. The joke's on them, I've been watching from the treetops for hours.
fields.births:bg:caravan_guard#description: The trade roads between hive-cities need walking. You walk them heavy and slow, and nothing touches the cargo.
fields.births:bg:cat_burglar#description: Up the wall, over the sill, and out again before the lamp is even lit. The name writes itself, and they have heard the joke.
fields.births:bg:catacomb_keeper#description: You tend the dry places. You know where every bone is, who it belonged to, and how long they have been here. The catacombs are yours and you maintain them with cheer and precision.
fields.births:bg:charm_seller#description: Half of it is the charm. Half is knowing who needs one, and what they are afraid of.
fields.births:bg:charnel_yogi#description: You meditate where death is most concentrated. The proximity to dissolution, to rot and impermanence, has sharpened your understanding of the mind and weakened your attachment to the body.
fields.births:bg:conference_pilgrim#description: You made the journey. The thirty gathered at the highest waypoint — the one above the clouds that is on no one's map — and found what was there. Some say the Simurgh was not there. Some say the Simurgh was exactly there. You came back, and it is difficult to explain what you found, except that you are no longer looking for it.
fields.births:bg:conjurers_hand#description: You do not call a thing you cannot send back. This is taught early, and usually twice.
fields.births:bg:coral_guard#description: You held a post at the outer walls of the palace. The tidal patterns of watch-change are in your bones.
fields.births:bg:current_herald#description: News travels fast in the deep. You are faster.
fields.births:bg:cutpurse#description: Marjara stole nothing, marjara is innocent of this crime!
fields.births:bg:dancer#description: The floor is not the point. The moment before the floor is the point.
fields.births:bg:deep_hunter#description: You roam the deep water alone. What others call the hunt is to you a long meditation in moving silence.
fields.births:bg:diplomat#description: A speaker between peoples, trained to find common ground in the most hostile of rooms.
fields.births:bg:elder_voice#description: Not the fastest, not the strongest, but the one who can keep the pack alive the longest.
fields.births:bg:executioner#description: One who delivers final judgment. Efficient, dispassionate, feared.
fields.births:bg:far_scout#description: The hive's eyes go further than its walls. You mapped the meadow in pollen-language and brought it home in your body.
fields.births:bg:farmer#description: A worker of the land, with tireless endurance and practical knowledge.
fields.births:bg:firekeeper#description: It does not go out. That is the whole of the office, and it is harder than it sounds.
fields.births:bg:flame_seeker#description: The flame is a teacher. You have studied it your whole life. It has not yet consumed you.
fields.births:bg:forest_drifter#description: A hunt when hungry, a trade when bored, a long sleep in a warm patch of sunlight when neither seems worth the effort.
fields.births:bg:forest_singer#description: On moonlit nights, the song carries further than you can see, the answer coming back from somewhere unexpected.
fields.births:bg:forest_thief#description: The settlements at the forest edge have interesting things — bright cloth, sweet foods, objects whose purpose I don't understand but which catch the light magnificently. I know which dogs bark and which don't. I know when the guards sleep.
fields.births:bg:former_soldier#description: Death did not end their service. Muscle memory survives the grave.
fields.births:bg:fortune_seeker#description: The hollow log three wing-lengths off the ground, just off the north pass — there is silver in it. You know this the way you know where the mice run. The buried thing, the hidden cache, the lost object — they have a particular quality in the dark that found and visible things lack. Lakshmi moves in circles you can follow.
fields.births:bg:grave_tender#description: Someone digs, someone speaks, someone remembers where. Out here it is all the same someone.
fields.births:bg:guard#description: A protector of places and people, trained to hold ground and outlast attackers.
fields.births:bg:healer#description: Trained in white magic and the medical arts, devoted to the restoration of body and spirit.
fields.births:bg:hedonist#description: …the feast after the hunt, the fear on a stranger's face, the music from the village fire that reaches the treeline — all this is the blood of experience, and I will have my fill!
fields.births:bg:herbalist#description: The forest speaks of cures and poisons, if you know how to listen. When you break a branch, you see little. They see the weather, time, soil, animals and fungi, spirits and the dead.
fields.births:bg:hive_architect#description: The comb is not built — it grows, cell by cell, through ten thousand coordinated decisions. You were one of them.
fields.births:bg:honey_alchemist#description: The honey is not food. It is memory, medicine, and slow fire. You know the difference between a healing batch and a poisoned one.
fields.births:bg:hunter#description: A tracker and killer of prey, patient and precise at range.
fields.births:bg:ill_omen#description: You have been appearing before catastrophes since before you can remember. You arrive; something happens. You learn not to take it personally. Eventually you learn to take it very personally — to arrive where you choose, and let the catastrophe follow from that. An omen is only uncontrolled prophecy.
fields.births:bg:infernal_scribe#description: A keeper of sins and karmic ledgers. In hell, bureaucracy is its own form of torment — and these figures wield it like a weapon.
fields.births:bg:jaina#description: You looked at your blades and understood the problem. They were made for one thing only, and that thing leaves a mark on the soul. You chose the longer road: discipline, the practice of not-harming, and finally the great fast that others call death but you know as the last purification.
fields.births:bg:jessed_hawk#description: Trained, hooded, tethered, fed by hand. You learned the wrist and the lure, the falconer's whistle, the particular quality of patience that humans confuse with obedience. You watched their settlements from above for years before you understood what you were seeing. Now you are neither fully wild nor fully tame, and you know things that neither world suspects.
fields.births:bg:jugaad#description: The camp near the river has a forge. I watched them for a season before I went in. They thought I wanted food. I wanted to understand what they were doing with fire and metal. The first tool I made was better than theirs. The seventh one they couldn't explain. I take requests now, in exchange for food and a formal agreement with their dogs.
fields.births:bg:keel_rider#description: You found that boats go places if you hold on to the underside and wait. You have been to ports whose names you cannot pronounce. You have watched markets from below the dock pilings. You know more about distant trade than the merchants who paid for passage, and you got there for free.
fields.births:bg:lord_of_the_range#description: Every tree in three valleys is marked. When lesser things feel watched, they are right.
fields.births:bg:maneater#description: They tell bedtime stories to their children about her, unable to see her dark silhouette lurking behind the window.
fields.births:bg:meadow_ward#description: You are bound to a place. The meadow's health is your health. Strangers who wish safe passage learn to speak to you first.
fields.births:bg:merchant#description: A trader of goods and services, sharp-tongued and sharper-eyed for opportunity.
fields.births:bg:monk#description: A practitioner of spiritual disciplines, attuned to inner forces most ignore.
fields.births:bg:musician#description: Someone has to be playing when the thing happens, or nobody remembers it right.
fields.births:bg:mycelium_tender#description: You may find them sitting quietly in the clearing, listening to the mycelium sharing stories you couldn't even fathom.
fields.births:bg:network_node#description: You held a position in the real-time flow of the hive's collective mind. Not a soldier, not a builder — a relay, a processor, a voice in the continuous hum.
fields.births:bg:night_scholar#description: The waypoint at midnight is a different place than the waypoint at noon. The day-birds leave things: messages, feathers, the warm impressions of bodies on stone. You read it all. You know more about what happens in the light hours than any creature who was there for them. Knowledge accumulates in the dark.
fields.births:bg:noble#description: Born to privilege and power, accustomed to commanding others.
fields.births:bg:old_tusk#description: Forty seasons in these hills. I know which hollows flood in the rains, where the healing clay is, where the truffle runs deepest.
fields.births:bg:palace_vizier#description: You attended the Naga King, drafted proclamations in brine-script, and read the omens in current-patterns.
fields.births:bg:penitent#description: A suffering soul who turned their torment inward and found something unexpected: clarity. Frail at first, but possessed of a spiritual awareness that others in hell have entirely forgotten.
fields.births:bg:plague_victim#description: Carries the sickness that killed them. Even in death, the rot spreads.
fields.births:bg:pleasure_dancer#description: The cat folk know many find their grace and lack of morals quite delightful, at least before they wake from the reverie and find their purse missing.
fields.births:bg:pollen_rishi#description: You move between the flowering nodes of the meadow's invisible geography, accumulating knowledge the way a wing accumulates dust.
fields.births:bg:post_runner#description: The peak where two passes cross. The lone horn of rock three days east. The great cliff above the frozen lake. You know every one — the approach thermals, the best perches, who is likely to be there. The route is not how you travel. The route is who you are.
fields.births:bg:preserved#description: Alchemical arts halted your decay. Oils, mantras and mineral compounds have kept you intact while others rotted to bone. You remember considerably more than most of your kind.
fields.births:bg:priest#description: A servant of the divine, trained in ceremony and in the healing and harmful uses of sacred power.
fields.births:bg:psychic#description: It began with knowing who was at the door. It did not stop there.
fields.births:bg:quarrier#description: Stone gives at one angle only. Finding it is the work. The hitting is the easy part.
fields.births:bg:quiet_tooth#description: A tooth is a knife that is always with you, quick and quiet when you spot a straggler, a weakling, one lost.
fields.births:bg:raider#description: One who takes what they want by force, quick to strike and quicker to vanish.
fields.births:bg:range_reader#description: When I run, I am eyes, I am ears, I am heart. I notice the colour that does not belong, the shadow that holds still while the leaves move.
fields.births:bg:realm_walker#description: He has traveled far, in this world and beyond. He learned a lot, tricked many and ate quite a few, too.
fields.births:bg:reveler#description: A social creature of feasts, festivals, and flattery. Charm opens more doors than keys.
fields.births:bg:root_shaper#description: The tuber doesn't know it's being guided. The root finds the right direction because the direction is good, and you make the direction good. Enchantment is not force — it is a very patient suggestion.
fields.births:bg:scarred_lead#description: Every carnivore that tried left a mark and a lesson. The crowd follows him towards the safe water.
fields.births:bg:scholar#description: A student of ancient texts and wisdom, more at home with scrolls than swords.
fields.births:bg:sea_dancer#description: In the crystal hall you moved like a current through still water. The court watched. The King smiled.
fields.births:bg:shambler#description: Barely conscious, driven by hunger. What remains of a person after death strips everything else away.
fields.births:bg:shell_wright#description: The shed carapace is not waste. It is material — harder than wood, lighter than iron, shaped already by the body that wore it. You learned to work it: to cut, to layer, to join. What you make fits the one who will wear it because you understand what it is to be armoured from birth.
fields.births:bg:shrine_keeper#description: The great fig tree has been sacred since before memory. I leave offerings at the roots — a smooth stone, a bright beetle, a length of vine arranged just so. I do not know why. My mother did it. And hers.
fields.births:bg:sky_lord#description: Three valleys. Every road, field, and creature visible at once from the high thermal. Others look at their feet and call that seeing. You look at everything from above and call it home. The ground is not the world. The ground is what you look at when you want to know where you are.
fields.births:bg:slope_herbalist#description: I know where the bitter herb grows. I know the clay that draws out poison.
fields.births:bg:smith#description: Heat, then shape, then cold. Everything else is opinion.
fields.births:bg:smuggler#description: I prefer to call it free trade, friend. Care for some supplies, arms — or perhaps something more exciting for a gentleman of such discerning tastes?
fields.births:bg:songline_guide#description: Listen, how the ancestors ran those paths where we run, how they drank where we drink, how they sang where I sing!
fields.births:bg:soul_jailer#description: A warden of the condemned, guarding souls sentenced to suffer. Brutal and disciplined in equal measure.
fields.births:bg:sounder_guard#description: The piglets run to me when they're scared, and not once have I failed them.
fields.births:bg:sounder_matron#description: You might fight a wolf, but just try raising your voice against the mother.
fields.births:bg:spy#description: An operative who trades in information, deception, and precisely timed violence. Trusted by no one, useful to everyone.
fields.births:bg:still_hunter#description: You do not chase. You find the right place, and you wait. The prey comes to you eventually. It always does.
fields.births:bg:stooper#description: Two hundred wing-lengths of silent fall. The wind becomes a pressure, then a scream, then nothing — because at the end of the stoop there is no more thinking, only the moment of contact. Everything else you do in your life is preparation for this or recovery from it.
fields.births:bg:storm_watcher#description: The weather tells you first, if you are outside enough to be told.
fields.births:bg:strangler#description: At first it takes strength to grip so tightly. In time it becomes patience.
fields.births:bg:swarm_caller#description: The hive can extend beyond the hive. You learned to ask rather than just know — to reach through the network and draw a portion of it toward you. The swarm comes when called. It is not a weapon. It is a form of speech.
fields.births:bg:temple_dove#description: Hatched in the temple courtyard, fed on offerings, trained to carry prayers tied to your leg between shrines. You never needed to find food. You never needed to know where you were going — the route was always already known. You are out in the wider world now, and it is strange: loud, directionless, full of things that were not in the prayers.
fields.births:bg:temple_warden#description: A protector of sacred places, combining martial readiness with spiritual discipline.
fields.births:bg:the_hungry#description: The hunger is not a problem. It is the condition of becoming.
fields.births:bg:the_sensate#description: They left the forests a lifetime ago, for the delights only civilized life can offer. Now they hunt by seduction, by art, by magic — and their prey hides in silks and perfume, and seems rather excited to be hunted.
fields.births:bg:thief#description: Locks are a conversation. Most of them are not very good at it.
fields.births:bg:tide_seer#description: The naga lineages carry old knowledge. You read futures in the way water moves around stone.
fields.births:bg:torturer#description: A professional in the application of suffering. Methodical, knowledgeable about bodies and their limits, and utterly without sentiment.
fields.births:bg:treetop_wit#description: The line between funny and frightening is a matter of timing. You work both sides of it from a height, with an audience that can't easily leave. The fall is never accidental. The recovery is always the point.
fields.births:bg:trickster#description: You live for the moment the illusion lands. Misdirection, impossible vanishings, arguments that fold in on themselves — you treat confusion as both art form and survival strategy.
fields.births:bg:troop_elder#description: I know which fig ripens first and which mango is always bitter. I know who should not sit next to whom at the sleeping tree, which young males are building coalitions, which females are calculating. The troop is a city in the canopy.
fields.births:bg:truffle_hunter#description: One starts seeking the morsels out by smell, then by intuition, finally by the psychic imprint of the burgeoning mycelium.
fields.births:bg:tunnel_merchant#description: The surface roads belong to those who fear nothing. The tunnel roads belong to you. Your caravan of great beetles moves slow and sure through passages older than memory, and the surface predators never knew you passed.
fields.births:bg:tunneler#description: You dig. What others call the underworld is simply where you work. The roots of the meadow are familiar as a face.
fields.births:bg:vent_warden#description: The chimneys are older than memory — older than the coral palace, older than the names of the ocean-born. Where the thermal vents breathe, life clusters around the heat. You hold the threshold. You were not appointed to this. You are the threshold.
fields.births:bg:wanderer#description: A traveler who has seen many places and learned to read people and terrain alike.
fields.births:bg:warrior#description: Trained in the arts of combat, body hardened by years of drill and battle.
fields.births:bg:water_carrier#description: Uphill full, downhill empty, and nobody in the village has ever once said thank you.
fields.births:bg:waypoint_gossip#description: Messages are cargo. Stories are currency. You carry both and charge for neither, because the one who gives freely is the one everyone is glad to see at the waypoint. You know more about what is happening across three mountain ranges than any of the people it is happening to.
fields.births:bg:witch#description: Some find the power to resist in the very rejection of all imposed authority.
fields.births:bg:wreck_gleaner#description: The surface-folk build ships and lose them to the deep. You have walked through more of their halls than any of them ever did.
fields.births:bg:young_brave#description: First bulk, then cut. This youngster has bulked impressively indeed.
births:names:animal:forest:gana#parent_w: May the pack know your voice
May your howl carry the valley
May the song live in you
May the hunt find you worthy
fields.births:names:animal:forest:gana#philosop: Gana name children for resonance: what the pack will hear of them. A name is meant to carry across a valley and come back changed by the distance, so the good ones are built out of sound before they are built out of meaning. A gana who has not yet been heard at range is not considered fully named.
fields.births:names:animal:forest:gana.personal: wolf-voice; the howl that defines the pack
sound-maker; one who fills the valley
resonance; the echo after the sound
the sound itself; presence as vibration
moon-child; runs at night under cold light
fields.births:names:animal:forest:gana.place_na: Where howls multiply — the pack gathers here to call across distance
Territorial high point; visible from everywhere in the range
The chase-down terrain — open enough for full speed
Where the pack convenes for ceremony; the howl here carries farthest
fields.births:names:animal:forest:landscape#des: Shared forest geography visible across births.
fields.births:names:animal:forest:landscape.nam: The upper world — vanara territory, shyena hunting ground, marjara observation post
Where the largest tree's roots create natural chambers — dura burrow below, vanara sleep above
A wetland zone where varaha and rakshasa territories overlap uneasily
The invisible boundary between predator territories — every species reads it differently
The crossing point — temporary neutral ground; all know not to hunt here
The dura name for the underground fungal network; others sense it but don't discuss it
The vanara name for any tree producing right now — location changes, name is permanent
births:names:animal:forest:marjara#paren: May you see and not be seen
May the spotted light find you
fields.births:names:animal:forest:marjara#philo: Marjara are solitary and precise. They pay close attention to light — the quality of dappled forest light is the aesthetic foundation of their world, both for hunting and for beauty. Names often refer to moments of perception: the instant before action, the quality of stillness, the particular light of a given hour. A parent says: 'May you see and not be seen.' Place names describe functional qualities of terrain: cover quality, sight-line distance, how the light falls at different hours.
fields.births:names:animal:forest:marjara.perso: the spotted one; identity through pattern
of the sight; defined by what they perceive
full attention; the quality of being completely present
of the moment; always in the exact instant
the still one; patience made physical
the slow and deliberate; not slow but deliberate
the precious and chosen; quality over quantity
dark medicine; healing that works in shadow
of the form; aware of their own presence in space
fields.births:names:animal:forest:marjara.place: Their primary scouting boulder — good sight-lines, excellent cover
The deer ford they watch — reliable prey approach
Their territory's main marker — highest reachable point
The forest section where dappled light through canopy creates ideal ambush conditions
A territory claimed after months of patient observation — named for the effort
The territorial boundary where their markings end — and another's begin
Poor territory, dry and avoided; named as a warning
births:names:animal:forest:mriga#parent_: May you hear what others miss
May the alarm sound through you
May the trail hold your memory
May you be first to know and last to be found
fields.births:names:animal:forest:mriga#philoso: Mriga name children for alertness: what they will notice that others miss. The name is a claim about attention, and it is tested early — a fawn is called by it from out of sight, and how fast the head comes up settles whether it fits. Like the gana they hold that a name should carry across a valley, but for the opposite reason: theirs has to be heard by someone already running.
fields.births:names:animal:forest:mriga.persona: the animal; pure creature-nature, neither predator nor prey
antelope-born; the dark-eyed one, seen at the edge of the clearing
the run; flight understood as a form of judgement, not fear
quick-moving; never still long enough to be settled on
the heard thing; alertness received as an inheritance
grass-born; sustained by what everyone else walks over
the eye; the one who sees it first and says so
fields.births:names:animal:forest:mriga.place_n: An area with consistent wind direction — always know what is upwind
Open meadow where predators can be seen at distance
The tree near which the warning bark always sounds; others know to listen
The ancestral migration path — walked so long it is part of the body
The distance covered in a good season's migration
births:names:animal:forest:rakshasa#pare: May you be the one who is not found
May you be solitary and sufficient
May you need no one and want for nothing
fields.births:names:animal:forest:rakshasa#phil: Rakshasa are intensely solitary and dislike compound identities. A name should be one clean word, like a strike. Parents name children late — not at birth but at the first successful hunt, which is when a rakshasa becomes someone worth naming. Before that, they are simply 'the young one.' Place names are possessives: not 'The Ridge' but 'My Ridge.' Not 'The Territory' but 'My Territory.' They use personal place names rarely, only when speaking to others.
fields.births:names:animal:forest:rakshasa.pers: valor; one who proves themselves by action
sharp; the precision of the predator
the fierce one; intensity as identity
maker-of-marks; the one who shapes the world around them
the trunk; formidable presence without explanation
the frenzied one; unstoppable once started
hunter; using the prey-word for the predator, which is deliberate
the enemy; to be feared before known
fields.births:names:animal:forest:rakshasa.plac: Their current hunting circuit — defined by travel time, not landmarks
A remembered hunt site near a fruiting tree — told to other rakshasa as coordinates
A stretch of poor territory between productive ones — a warning, not a name
Anywhere they do not go; attributed to another's territory without acknowledgment
The territorial marker tree; the scratches are the claim
fields.births:names:animal:forest:region#design: The forest as eight overlapping territories — no creature sees the whole of it. Every tree is a claim, every stream a boundary. The forest is not a place; it is an aggregate of contested presences.
births:names:animal:forest:vanara#parent: May you find the high branch
May you be too quick for consequence
May the fruit be there when you arrive
fields.births:names:animal:forest:vanara#philos: Vanara naming is semi-serious — they understand names matter but cannot resist making the moment funny. A child named at birth gets a formal aspirational name. A child who does something memorable in their first year often acquires a second name that sticks better. The formal name is used in ceremony; the second name is used in everything else. Parents say: 'May you laugh last,' which sounds like a blessing but is also practical advice.
fields.births:names:animal:forest:vanara.person: quick and restless; cannot be held in one place
the multitude; many things at once
lightness; the quality of being almost nothing, so cannot be caught
tawny-lord; the old honorific, used ironically
fields.births:names:animal:forest:vanara.place_: A canopy route between two fruiting areas — vanara maintain it by keeping branches connected
Site of a famous escape or prank; coordinates used in storytelling
Simply: the highest accessible point in their territory
Self-explanatory. Location shifts seasonally but the name stays.
Where a notable fall happened — told with varying degrees of sympathy depending on the audience
Where this troop meets with another; neutral ground, old agreement
births:names:animal:forest:varaha#parent: May the earth tell you its secrets
fields.births:names:animal:forest:varaha#philos: Varaha are deeply communal — the sounder is the unit of identity, not the individual. Names are given at birth and reflect the circumstances: the quality of the earth beneath the birth-site, what the sounder was doing, what the weather was doing. A child born during heavy rain near good tubers might become Mudblessed. A child born when the sounder was moving fast through danger becomes Runborn. Names are warm, round, earthy.
fields.births:names:animal:forest:varaha.person: earth-giver; one who finds nourishment for others
deep and formidable; takes up space in the world
of the seal; one who marks and is marked
the place; one who belongs where they are
the pillar; holds the sounder together
fields.births:names:animal:forest:varaha.place_: The best wallowing site — seasonal, but returned to every year
Their regular rooting circuit — memorized by every member
A specific spot, remembered by name across generations
Ancient forest floor with rich tubers — the sounder's most productive ground
Where the sounder sleeps; location changes seasonally but always called this
Ancestral birthplace of the lineage matriarch; visited ceremonially
births:names:animal:meadow:bhramara#pare: May the flower know your name
May you find the right flower
May the hive never lose you
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:bhramara#phil: Bhramara individual names are ceremonial constructions given by the hive mind collectively. What the hive names you is what you are. Names describe roles compressed into sounds — a long title reduced to something that can be waggle-danced in seconds. The individual barely matters; the function matters entirely. Place names are extremely precise: defined by flower species, altitude, humidity, and time of day.
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:bhramara.pers: wandering one; the scout, the finder
flower-keeper; maintains the relationship with the source
dancer; communicates what cannot be spoken
thread-holder; the quality that connects all parts
of the assembly; defined by belonging to the whole
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:bhramara.plac: A hillside rich in the hive's preferred species — primary foraging ground
The interior chamber where recruitment dances orient the foragers
Dangerous territory between flower sources — no landmarks, high exposure
A location they defend against; not feared, just contested
Most productive foraging zone; name is also a direction communicated in dance
births:names:animal:meadow:dura#parent_w: May what you make outlast you
May you know what is below
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:dura#philosop: Dura measure everything in depth and duration. A name should describe what endures — what goes below, what is made carefully, what roots support. Children are named at the moment they first help dig: they take a stone from the tunnel, they carry earth up and out, and in that moment the sounder watches to see how they work. The name comes from the quality of that first effort. A deliberate child becomes Careful-Layer. A strong child becomes Deep-Strike.
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:dura.personal: the digger; one who makes the way
layer-by-layer; built from accumulated careful work
of the interior; most at home in the deep
root-seeker; follows what holds things together
of the broad earth; sees the whole stratum
excavated; shaped by the work of digging
blue-dark earth; the richest soil, deep down
the below one; always headed further down
of the good soil; knows quality earth by feel
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:dura.place_na: The main tunnel complex — named for depth, not breadth
Where the largest tree's root system creates natural chambers; coolest and quietest
A complex junction designed for escape — the number is the guarantee
Upper tunnels used in wet season — less comfortable, safer from flooding
The ancestral burrow site; always maintained even when no longer primary
Emergency ventilation shaft; everyone knows its location, no one mentions it to outsiders
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:khadga#philos: Khadga are in no hurry — they name children slowly, watching first. A newborn khadga may go unnamed for an entire season while the parent observes. When the name comes, it is final and heavy, like a footfall. Khadga do not give children aspirational names; they name what they see. A calm child: Stillness. A heavy child: The Great Weight. A child who charges the wall of their enclosure repeatedly: Perhaps the Wall Matters.
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:khadga.person: strength-bearer; the one who holds force without deploying it
the dense and heavy; occupying space completely
steadiness itself; will not be moved by argument or urgency
tough and fibrous; does not break, ever
the massive one; presence as statement
stability; the ground beneath the ground
of the great; one who does not need to prove it
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:khadga.place_: The best wallow — visited in seasonal rotation, remembered across years
Their current territory; not named further, the claim is enough
Natural thornscrub boundary — they did not build it but they maintain it by not breaking through
A particular stand of trees that provides afternoon relief — crucial in dry season
Site of an old territorial battle — remembered as landmark even by those who didn't witness it
The waterhole — visited at exact same time every day, by individual habit of each khadga
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:landscape.nam: The universal truce-point — every species drinks here, the truce is older than any current inhabitant
The path worn by thousands of years of seasonal movement; visible from above
The great mound; not a landmark but a place of gathering for practitioners
Meadow beyond meadow — featureless to outsiders, rich in meaning to those who live here
A rocky outcrop rising from the plain — khadga dust-wallow below, yaksha marker above, shyena hunting perch above that
The furthest reach of the wet-season water; everything within is temporarily different
births:names:animal:meadow:patanga#paren: May the light find you worthy
May you choose the fire that illuminates
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:patanga#philo: Patanga naming is aspirational to the point of ecstasy. They name children for what the child will burn toward. A name is a trajectory. To name a child 'Flame-Seeker' is not prediction; it is summoning. Patanga names are given at the moment of first strong light-response — when the infant turns instinctively toward any source of brightness. That first turn is the name.
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:patanga.perso: light-seeker; defined by what they move toward
the austerity-one; heat as spiritual practice
meteor-child; a trajectory, not a destination
illumination; not the light but the effect of light
brilliance-born; the quality of fire before the fire
offering-born; came into existence as a gift
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:patanga.place: The eternal fire temple — seen from outside as the only reliable light source in the meadow
Metaphorical: the point of the journey, whatever form it takes
Where past patanga have gone to the flame; remembered without sadness
Anywhere they do not go; an anti-name, a direction to avoid
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:region#design: The meadow as five very different births experience it — open sky, exposed ground, no cover. Existence here is negotiated differently than in the forest: everything can see everything. Territory is marked with more desperation and defended with more commitment.
births:names:animal:meadow:yaksha#parent: May nothing cross that you did not allow
May you be remembered at the contract
May your word bind as well as stone
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:yaksha#philos: Yaksha are guardians by nature — they define themselves by what they hold, not what they pursue. Names are formal, often compound, and describe a function as much as a person. A yaksha child is named at the moment they first demonstrate awareness of a boundary — when they stand at the edge of something and know, without being told, that they must not let it be crossed. Place names are ancient, maintained across generations, and often coincide with actual boundary markers.
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:yaksha.person: of the mountain-stone; permanent as the earth itself
forest-guardian; the protector at the boundary of wildness
of the sacred field; one who knows what is cultivated and what is not
protector; the function as the name
the holding one; maintenance as identity
boundary-keeper; the one who knows the line
complete protection; total in their vigilance
the establisher; one who sets things in place
fields.births:names:animal:meadow:yaksha.place_: The line they hold; any Yaksha territory's primary name is this
Where an ancient territorial agreement was struck; the terms are still in force
Where tribute is left by those passing through; accepted without thanks, which is the etiquette
Where disputes between territories are resolved; both sides must approach from downwind
Directional boundary markers; each direction has its Post, visited in rotation
The single tree at the center of the territory; often ancient, always marked
births:names:animal:ocean:karka#parent_w: May what you hold outlast you
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:karka#philosop: Karka value endurance above all things — what is built, what is held, what does not crack. Names are given late, after the child's shell has begun to harden into its characteristic pattern. A name given too early is considered bad luck: you have named a thing before it has proven itself. Karka parents say: 'May nothing crack you.' Place names are functional and precise — defined by thermal output, structural integrity, depth to bedrock.
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:karka.personal: stone-natured; one of the deep rock
firm and lasting; one who does not yield
shell-keeper; guardian of the inner form
layer-upon-layer; one built from accumulated time
of the peak; one who holds the high point
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:karka.place_na: Primary thermal vent complex — most productive, most contested
The coral barrier reef face — karka ancestral territory
A pass they have guarded for so long that 'the Long Vigil' is also a measure of time
Where a notable elder's shell finally failed — remembered with respect, not grief
The original thermal vent the karka settled; ancestral
The primary shell-wright workshop; open to all karka, by tradition
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:landscape#desi: Shared ocean geography. These names appear in any ocean zone event text.
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:landscape.name: The main channel — naga measure sovereignty by how much of it they hold
The Long Current
The coral barrier pass — karka territory
The Narrow Claim
The bioluminescent zone in deep water — beautiful and disorienting
The Bright Below
What ocean creatures call the shallows — disconcertingly lit, too exposed
The Deep Above
The submarine migration route from coast to deep ocean
The Path Between Worlds
An ancient submarine cliff claimed by makara as territorial marker
The Oldest Wall
Where cold deep water rises — primary makara feeding ground
The Upwelling
The open water approach to the coral barrier — contested, dangerous
Before the Reef
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:makara#philoso: Makara are so ancient and solitary that their naming traditions are barely traditions — more like geological habits. They rarely name children; often a young makara goes unnamed until they have held a territory for a season, at which point they name themselves after its most characteristic feature. Place names are simple, definitive, and never change. 'The Trench' has been the Trench for longer than anything else in the ocean has a name.
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:makara.persona: profound depth; one of the serious deep
great water; of the vast kind
ocean; not a creature of it but an expression of it
whale-swallower; one who exceeds what seems possible
meeting of waters; where all currents converge
beloved of the bottom; at home in the deep dark
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:makara.place_n: The deepest point. No other name needed.
Where the cold rises — primary feeding ground, claimed
The ancient submarine cliff — makara territorial boundary since before memory
The open approach water — the makara's anteroom
A zone of no current — disliked but used for ambush
births:names:animal:ocean:matsya#parent_: May the shoal know your turn
May you be fast without hesitation
May the light find you in deep water
May you always be in the middle
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:matsya#philoso: Matsya are the most present-tense of all births — they live in the immediate movement of the shoal, in the collective turn. Individual names are given by the shoal, not the parents, and usually describe the child's behavior in their first week. A matsya who always turns left at the decision point becomes Leftward. A matsya who sees the shadow first becomes Shadowwatch. Names are short because they need to carry fast across water.
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:matsya.persona: wave; born in the rising water
the crossing; one who leads through difficult passages
balance; the one who holds the center of the school
deep-hearted; goes further than the others
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:matsya.place_n: The reef face where sunlight meets depth — primary hunting ground
Their regular circuit route — spoken of as a direction, not a place
The depth below which the shoal does not go; understood without discussion
A rich feeding ground; no permanent name, moves with the season
The sunken wreck — avoided, but useful as a landmark
The exposed water gap in migration — fear and necessity together
births:names:animal:ocean:naga#parent_wi: May you carry the old water
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:naga#philosoph: Naga hold lineage as the deepest form of identity — a name is an inheritance, a claim, a record. Children are named for what the parent hopes they will carry into the future: a current, a memory, a way of holding still. Naga names are fluid, vowel-heavy, sinuous in the mouth. A naga who has held the same thermal current for a century may rename themselves after it. Place names are events remembered: not where something is, but what happened there and who was present.
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:naga.personal_: treasure-bearer; one who carries wealth of knowledge
on the path of Shesha; one who endures at the foundation
blue-deep; one of the dark water
Varuna's own; under the protection of the ocean lord
water-lotus; one who blooms in the dark
wave-maker; one who sets things in motion
ocean-natured; one who holds great depth calmly
whale-bearer; one who moves in the wake of giants
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:naga.place_nam: A thermal vent where naga meet annually to recite lineage records aloud
The ancestral territory of the oldest lineage — technically contested, practically not
Site of an ancient boundary dispute; still avoided
A particular reef formation that resembles sleeping naga — sacred, do not enter
Territory held continuously by one family for sixty years — remarkable and named for it
A disorienting current that scrambles scent trails and memory of routes — dangerous to the young
fields.births:names:animal:ocean:region#design: The ocean as the naga, karka, matsya, and makara experience it — ancient, territorial, layered by depth and current. Nothing here is accidental. Every feature has been claimed or contested.
births:names:animal:sky_distributed:kapo: May you know all the routes
May the flock gather at your call
May you be the one who comes back
fields.births:names:animal:sky_distributed:kapo: Kapota name things by the history of information that passed through them. A tree is named for the most important message ever relayed from it. A waypoint is named for the journey that established it. Personal names commemorate arrivals and departures — the moment of return is considered most naming-worthy. 'The One Who Came Back' is always an honored name. In the Conference of the Birds, every pilgrim is renamed upon arrival.
route-holder; carries the map in the body
the arriving one; always in motion toward
news-carrier; the medium is the message
pilgrim; the journey is the form
the completer; the one who finishes
The conference location — both a specific tree and a category
Reliable overnight stop on a long route; evaluated by predator pressure, not comfort
Origin point of an important piece of information — used as coordinates
Where returning pilgrims are greeted; a specific branch of the Assembly Tree
The start of the established route; most pilgrims begin here
The difficult migratory path — named for its character, not its length
fields.births:names:animal:sky_distributed:land: A reliable rising air column — different birds name different thermals; same name, different location
The conference tree on the ridge between forest and meadow — visible from both territories
Any primary nesting site — shyena use this as a proper noun; kapota use it as a category
The aerial corridor used by all migrating species; everyone knows it, no one owns it
The direction from which weather comes — all bird cultures orient by this
fields.births:names:animal:sky_distributed:regi: Sky births live across all three zones but share a vertical orientation — they measure the world in altitude, thermal quality, and wind. Their place names are mostly aerial; their ground-level place names are functional minimums.
fields.births:names:animal:sky_distributed:shye: Shyena measure the world in height and angle. Their territory is not the ground below but the airspace above it — measured in altitude bands, thermal columns, and sight lines. A name should describe either a quality of speed or a quality of vision. Children are named at first flight: what the parent saw in the first stoop tells them the name.
the hurler; released downward at speed
swift one; first in every moment
the upward one; always gaining altitude
sky-space; not in the sky but of it
A reliable rising column — named per location, this is the best one in range
Main nesting site; a cliff ledge with unobstructed approach and retreat
Hunting territory below — named from the air, looking down
A reliable updraft on a cliff face — used for gaining altitude without effort
The position where the morning hunt begins — a compass direction more than a place
An airspace controlled by another — acknowledged without confrontation
births:names:animal:sky_distributed:uluk: May you see what others miss
May you understand before you act
fields.births:names:animal:sky_distributed:uluk: Uluka are the most deliberate namers of all births. They watch a child for a full season before naming. What is observed in that season becomes the name — not what is hoped, but what is seen. 'You cannot name what you haven't watched,' they say. Place names are named for specific events of perception: what was heard there, what was seen from there, what was understood in that location for the first time.
owl-pure; the complete form of the birth
night-born; arrived in the generous dark
sight; vision as the whole self
the silent sage; speaks rarely, nothing lost in the silence
discernment; the exact quality that distinguishes the uluka
Primary perch — chosen for the quality of the surrounding silence
Night territory — not a place but a time-within-place
A specific discovery site — personalised, not transferable
Ancestral roost; old enough that no uluka alive remembers who first claimed it
Where they wait for dawn — a specific spot, used by many generations
The open daylit meadow — avoided, disorienting, remembered as warning
fields.births:race:bhramara#description: The nature of the relationship between a bhramara and their hive eludes the grasp of even the most empathetic of other beings. What is obvious is their coordination and refinement.
fields.births:race:black_devil#description: Spawned from the Outer Dark, black devils live off confusion and fear.
fields.births:race:blue_devil#description: Cold and calculating, blue devils keep grudges long after they were forgotten in the realms above.
fields.births:race:dralha#description: Warrior-kings who refused to relinquish their power at death and rebuilt their dominion from beyond the grave. Dralha are former chieftains, generals, and conquerors who linger in the charnel grounds surrounded by the spirits of those who served them in life. They lead through force and presence, wielding weapons with the same authority they carried in the living world.
fields.births:race:dre#description: Ghosts in the oldest and most literal sense: consciousness that has shed its body but not its attachments, drifting through the charnel grounds like smoke through bone. Dré are the most dissolved of the preta, barely present in the physical world. They feel little of its violence but remain bound to it by the thread of whatever they could not let go.
fields.births:race:dura#description: Patient and persistent, the Dura have been here longer than most things that walk. They have long mastered the secrets of the earth and became famous as farmers, traders and sturdy warriors.
fields.births:race:gana#description: Alone, a middling thing with good teeth. Together, nothing in the forest outruns us.
fields.births:race:green_devil#description: Quick-witted and paranoid, green devils make for excellent operatives and terrible friends.
fields.births:race:gyelpo#description: Powerful tantric practitioners and sorcerers who accumulated enough spiritual force in life to persist after death as kings of the spirit world. Where dralha rule through arms and loyalty, gyelpos rule through binding oaths, ritual contracts, and the weight of accumulated power. Shugden is the archetype: a sorcerer who refused to dissolve, who built a new throne from obligation and fear.
fields.births:race:human#description: Beings of potential and choice, balanced in all aspects
fields.births:race:kapota#description: Every message that mattered was carried by something small and grey that nobody thought to stop. The kapota remember all of them, and they remember who was lying.
fields.births:race:karka#description: Armoured, unhurried, and entirely uninterested in your schedule. The karka hold the reef passes the way a door holds a frame, and no one has yet argued one out of the way.
fields.births:race:khadga#description: The blade-limbed mantis, the dragonfly, the ambush grasshopper. They live by the first strike, unconquered in their weight class.
fields.births:race:makara#description: Deep beneath the waves dwell creatures strange and old, wielding weird magic and practicing yogas that only make sense for the cephalopod body.
fields.births:race:marjara#description: The patch of warm dappled light is their home, whatever they want at the moment their possession. Ever on the go, solitary and ungovernable, marjara can be found wandering in the least expected places.
fields.births:race:matsya#description: In the ocean, the slow and unwary quickly become a meal. The matsya are the children of those who lived, and they will do their best to make their ancestors proud.
fields.births:race:mriga#description: The feeling of dew on your antlers, the juicy new leaves of spring, the kinship of the herd! It is a good life.
fields.births:race:naga#description: Before the first apes descended from the trees, these serpentine beings raised their glimmering cities with ingenuity and wisdom.
fields.births:race:patanga#description: Poison, silk, iridescence, and a tendency to appear where least expected, the Patanga know how to kindle fear and wonder alike.
fields.births:race:preserved#description: Alchemical oils, mantras, and mineral compounds have halted your decay while others rotted to bone. The lords of their kind among the Rolang — rare, aware, and dangerous. You remember considerably more than most of your kind, and have had long years of stillness to put that memory to use.
fields.births:race:rakshasa#description: Shape-shifting lords of the jungle, presiding over the ancient cults of the hunt. What a tiger becomes, given lifetimes.
fields.births:race:red_devil#description: Hot-headed and driven by anger and lust, red devils are the finest warriors in the Hells.
fields.births:race:rolang#description: The newly dead of the hungry ghost realm. Rolangs have been in the world of the dead for a relatively short time and are the least conscious of its inhabitants. Young walking dead are dim and animalistic — rigid, slow, moving in a jerky jiangshi-like manner — and only over long ages do some begin to develop awareness of their condition. Most rot away into skeletons. A rare few are preserved by alchemical and yogic arts and become the lords of their kind.
fields.births:race:shaza#description: The predators of the underworld, the shaza aggressively seek out bodies to devour.
fields.births:race:shyena#description: The stoop is one decision, made at height and never revised. From up there the world sorts cleanly into things worth the dive and things that are not.
fields.births:race:skeleton#description: Freed from the needs of the flesh by unstoppable decay, skeletons have had time to think. Most maintain the dryness of their sprawling catacombs and praise the blessings of abundant calcium with cheerful enthusiasm. Conscious skeletons are far more common than among the newly dead — the long wait in the grave strips away the animal confusion and leaves something clear-eyed and surprisingly sociable behind.
fields.births:race:skeleton_copper#description: Skeletons born of molten copper mirrors in the court of the Skeleton King of the Setting Sun find themselves especially attuned to the arts of power and magnetism.
fields.births:race:skeleton_golden#description: Gleaming in the flickering light of the crypt cities, golden skeletons are respected nobles among their people.
fields.births:race:skeleton_iron#description: Born of broken weapons on endless battlefields of the multiverse, iron skeletons are hard and unyielding, the most serious and driven of their kin.
fields.births:race:skeleton_silver#description: Not many withstand the trials of the underworld without losing their compassion. Those who have managed that feat remain as healers and helpers, looking with hope for the future to the worlds far above.
fields.births:race:skeleton_turquoise#descripti: Prancing cheerfully in their rainbow skirts and flowery headdresses, turquoise skeletons serve as jesters, dancers and, often enough, grand viziers to the Great Bone Kings.
fields.births:race:uluka#description: They ask questions in the tone of someone who already has the answer and is deciding whether you deserve it. Nothing that hunts in silence is ever entirely trusted.
fields.births:race:vanara#description: Nothing in the canopy is fastened down, and anything that is merely constitutes the opening of a project. They are funny deliberately, which is the part people underestimate.
fields.births:race:varaha#description: Not looking for a fight, and not stepping off the trail either. Polite, in the way of a thing that could open you end to end and would rather not. No strength wasted, and never far from kin.
fields.births:race:vetala#description: Highly intelligent and curious tricksters who inhabit the charnel grounds. Vetalas are ambivalent towards the living and arbitrary in their dealings — sometimes helpful, sometimes dangerous, always keeping their own counsel. They drain life force through magic rather than physical violence, produce vivid illusions, and have a natural propensity for the arcane arts. Their propensity for rhetoric, humor, and meditation means they can usually talk their way out of a fight, though they rarely feel obliged to.
fields.births:race:white_devil#description: Lazy and a bit ditzy, white devils make pleasant company as far as hell's denizens go.
fields.births:race:yaksha#description: Something is being guarded — a spring, a hoard, a promise older than the hill it was sworn on. Ask which, and the answer arrives with the weight of a matter settled long before you were born.
fields.births:race:yellow_devil#description: Greedy and proud, yellow devils tend to cluster wherever wealth changes hands.
fields.births:race:yidag#description: Bellies distended with insatiable hunger, throats constricted to a hair's width — these beings are the most unfortunate embodiment of the karma that created their world.
fields.companions:agnishikha#flavor: Stands facing the sun with his wings spread until sundown, every day, for eleven years. Wants the fire. Does not enter it. That is the whole practice and there is nothing else.
fields.companions:amlamarjari#flavor: Party girl who found ways to patch up her comrades long after they couldn't go on. Her healing is excellent. Her bedside manner is chaotic.
fields.companions:anavatapta#flavor: Forty years of naga court administration and not one raised voice. He can find the sentence that ends an argument, and he has never once enjoyed using it.
fields.companions:angulimala#flavor: Executioner of a crime syndicate, known for a particular professional habit involving fingers. He is fast, precise, and oddly graceful about it.
fields.companions:ayurmangala#flavor: Fascinated by humanoid anatomy the way a botanist is fascinated by plants. Can be persuaded to forego vivisection of party members — keeping them alive is, after all, a more interesting experiment.
fields.companions:balavardhana#flavor: Holds a thermal over the meadow as his personal fief. Comes down only to settle things, and settles them quickly.
fields.companions:brihannala#flavor: Retired from leading a troop of sixty and now collects stolen objects and unlikely stories with equal enthusiasm. Will trade you either for something you don't know.
fields.companions:chapala#flavor: Born between two wheels on a road nobody names. Prices everything, respects nothing, and is already somewhere else.
fields.companions:chitrangada#flavor: Pale as limestone, silent as weather, entirely without malice. Killing is what a cat does, isn't it?
fields.companions:choki#flavor: Left to gather in the forest. Came back to find the village gone — a flash flood, no warning, nothing left. Drowned herself in the same river three days later. Still here, still not sure what she is waiting for.
fields.companions:coolhead_hotblood#flavor: A people-pleasing librarian who let frustration build in his innards like an alchemical retort. One day the seal broke. He found the experience clarifying.
fields.companions:dhvanika#flavor: She may be old, but she is far from senile — a glint in her eye, and in the knife she keeps half hidden.
fields.companions:dirghajihva#flavor: She has never given an order; she yawns at the right moment and the argument ends. Now, greater challenges await her and the pack is fretful to see her go.
fields.companions:drupchen#flavor: Performed every ritual, recited every text, accumulated every merit point. Believed none of it. He is in the hungry ghost realm, which he finds philosophically interesting now that he can no longer attribute it to coincidence.
fields.companions:durvasa#flavor: Professional curse-caster, contract work only, reliable until his final commission. His target had a solid practice of the Devourer of Curses. The invoice was never collected.
fields.companions:dvijihva#flavor: A sorcerer for hire who worked for two rival clients simultaneously, studying both thoroughly. He was killed when they compared notes. He considers this an occupational hazard.
fields.companions:dyutapati#flavor: Owner of a casino in hell — cigar always lit, odds always in his favour, smile always present. The house wins. He is the house.
fields.companions:ekadamshtra#flavor: Ran a sounder of forty for thirty years and handed it on cleanly, a rare event indeed. She eats last, sleeps with one eye open.
fields.companions:enakshi#flavor: Has held the clearing eleven seasons running and has never once had to touch anyone to do it.
fields.companions:ghoraka#flavor: When the wolves killed his sounder, he found a source of power deep in the grief and bloodlust. Now the wolves keep their distance, seeing the oily smoke seeping from his eyes.
fields.companions:ghoshaka#flavor: Born on a city wall a long way from any forest, and paid up as of last spring. Now he has come to the homeland of his ancestors for the first time in his life.
fields.companions:gomchen#flavor: A master of ten thousand sutras who found that political dominance within the monastery walls required a different kind of mastery. He acquired it. He was very good at it. He is here.
fields.companions:himasara#flavor: Comes down from the snow every second season with moss, antler-glue and prices. Has never once been cold in your presence and finds your fire excessive.
fields.companions:hustle_bones#flavor: Has traded his finger joints for better deals, his ribs for bulk discounts, and one femur for something he won't discuss. Still in profit, last he checked.
fields.companions:iron_oath#flavor: His commanding officer fell in battle three hundred years ago. The order to stand down was never transmitted. He kept his post. He is not pleased about having been relieved of it.
fields.companions:jawbreaker#flavor: Fast, reckless, and deeply committed to the principle that the best defence is a fractured orbital bone. Also picks pockets while they're down.
fields.companions:kabandha#flavor: Three valleys, every tree marked, and not one of them argued about it. Finds the party's habit of walking through places baffling.
fields.companions:kambu#flavor: Held one gap in the reef wall for nineteen years. Nothing got past. He does not consider this an achievement — it was simply his place in this life.
fields.companions:kandali#flavor: Cultivates the fungal network under nine acres of forest floor and speaks about it the way other people speak about family. Do not step on the nine-year patch.
fields.companions:kanjus#flavor: Owner of a textile manufactory, maximiser of profit, minimiser of worker wellbeing. In hell he applies the same efficiency to whatever operation he finds himself part of.
fields.companions:karnak#flavor: A red devil cast out of the Infernal Guard for showing mercy to a damned soul. He carries the contradiction quietly.
fields.companions:khara#flavor: The one from the stories. She is aware there are stories, and has opinions about which of them are accurate.
fields.companions:khedrup#flavor: Treated the dharma as a system to be optimized. Found every multiplying formula, every auspicious day, every legitimate shortcut. He preserved himself flawlessly. He is still in the hungry ghost realm. He is reviewing his calculations.
fields.companions:kripana#flavor: A wealthy man who spent nothing, ate little, and wore his clothing until it dissolved. He died sitting on his gold. In the hungry ghost realm, the gold is gone. The hunger is not.
fields.companions:kruddha#flavor: Taking such delight in the hunt, in the kill, in the tearing of flesh, must have a downside. But this is for the philosophers to ponder another day.
fields.companions:kshanaka#flavor: How can you resist her eyes, her hips, her laughter? Wait — what did you say happened to her last master?
fields.companions:kshudraka#flavor: Trades in omens, debts, and things people would rather forget they said. Nocturnal, immaculately polite, and never once has she been the one holding the loss.
fields.companions:leraya#flavor: A huntsman who grew bored with animals and started tracking people instead. The challenge was the point. He is still tracking.
fields.companions:madhuvrata#flavor: One voice in a hive of four thousand, seconded to the surface for reasons the hive has not explained to them either. Sings in three parts by themselves.
fields.companions:mandaka#flavor: Third storey, no rope, and back down with the thing before the dog finished turning its head. Considers locks a personal challenge.
fields.companions:marmajna#flavor: A physician of genuine skill who understood the body as a system of resources. He began with cadavers. The logic that followed was, he still insists, impeccable. Exactly where the line was — he is still working on that.
fields.companions:mehr#flavor: Tall, one-eyed, recovered from a tar pit with most of her prophecies intact. The one that failed was accurate. The court simply did not want to hear it.
fields.companions:minakshi#flavor: Dances the shoal-turns that keep a school alive — a thousand bodies changing direction as one. Out of the water she is merely extraordinary.
fields.companions:mrichha#flavor: Disappearing from one clearing and appearing in another, bringing food and medicine. Others say they travel through the roots and hyphae.
fields.companions:nadaka#flavor: They were always a strange kid, unnerving others unable to figure out what it is that they really think, behind all those jokes and evasion.
fields.companions:nangwa#flavor: Died mid-sentence, mid-proof, mid-thought. The argument is almost certainly sound. He just needs a moment to finish it. He has needed this moment for quite some time now.
fields.companions:nayanika#flavor: Taken young, sold south, came back in silk with rings on every point. Holds your eye a moment past comfortable. Answers nothing.
fields.companions:niloka#flavor: I'm here to patch you up, child. Why? And why do you care, pray tell?
fields.companions:nirvikalpa#flavor: Will not eat anything that had a face and will not walk where she cannot see the ground, in case of insects. Weighs two thousand pounds. Has never harmed anything.
fields.companions:nishkasita#flavor: A rakshasa who stopped hunting and started entertaining. His reasons are as mysterious as his past, but some things may be gleaned from how he handles a knife when cutting an onion.
fields.companions:niyamendra#flavor: Court bureaucrat of a petty king, who found his true calling in the invention of regulations. He can freeze any ordinary process in place — paperwork is eternal.
fields.companions:nurse_bones#flavor: Non-violent by choice. She patches up whoever needs patching up, including enemies, which the party finds occasionally inconvenient.
fields.companions:nyingje#flavor: Made a vow to remain until every being in this realm found its way out. Still here. Still trying. Probably the oldest being in the charnel grounds, and the least troubled by it.
fields.companions:peldon#flavor: Ran the village market for forty years. Knew every price, every shortage, every family's circumstances. Indispensable and invisible in equal measure. She finds she cannot stop being useful.
fields.companions:phalguna#flavor: Can build anything out of anything given an afternoon and no supervision. Every solution is temporary, every temporary solution has now been load-bearing for six years.
fields.companions:phenaka#flavor: Carries messages up and down four hundred miles of coast and knows every waypoint, every teahouse, and everyone's business. Delivers all of it, whether or not it was the message.
fields.companions:phulla#flavor: They started out with oyster mushrooms, then learned the way of the morel, finally graduated to the little ones that speak. Now, they work healing and miracles, insisting the power flows through, not from them.
fields.companions:prashan#flavor: Spent centuries asking riddles at crossroads. When the charnel grounds ran short of interesting passersby, he went looking for them. He is still looking for the question no one can answer.
fields.companions:princess_spiderface#flavor: Actually rather nice, though the face doesn't help first impressions. She calls the spirits she summons by name and asks how they've been.
fields.companions:raktamatta#flavor: A law-abiding butcher who followed every regulation, filed every permit, and enjoyed his work with a thoroughness that made inspectors nervous.
fields.companions:rasabhava#flavor: His formula for eternal preservation was correct in every detail. He finished mixing it the night before he died. He has had some time to consider the timing.
fields.companions:red_peony#flavor: She carries a two-handed club the size of a small tree and moves like she knows exactly how much space she takes up. A lot.
fields.companions:runborn#flavor: Exiled from the sounder for killing a brother in a fit of rage. Now they seek redemption and self-discipline.
fields.companions:rupaka#flavor: They tried to change her into a proper little lady and failed. She tried to change them into newts and succeeded.
fields.companions:saka#flavor: Desiccated by the white salt flats of a desert that keeps its dead well. Still carrying the composite bow he carved from horn and sinew. Still knows which direction the game runs.
fields.companions:samvibrahmi#flavor: Driven by constant suspicion of assassination, he prepared obsessively for every conceivable threat. He was ultimately killed by a cabbage cart. He still doesn't know how they did it.
fields.companions:saramaya#flavor: Gathers what grows on the ridge and treats whatever she finds hurt. Charges nothing, accepts everything, and so today again she went to sleep on an empty stomach.
fields.companions:sarangi#flavor: Comes back to the same meadow every dozen years for the tea and the grass, in that order. Remembers the meadow better than the meadow remembers itself.
fields.companions:sarpatailaka#flavor: A trader in snake oil and false cures, who offered hope where real treatment was available. The daggers are for customers who want a refund.
fields.companions:serji#flavor: The biggest man in the hot hell gym — and the one who walked out. Not because he won, but because winning there stopped meaning anything.
fields.companions:setubandha#flavor: Walks the line between salt and fresh, deep and shallow, this realm and the next. Claims the boundaries are the only places where anything real happens.
fields.companions:shantipala#flavor: Brokered peace between enemies by naming what each side secretly needed and daring them to deny it out loud. Now performs the same service at the Skeleton King's copper mirror court, with mixed results.
fields.companions:shesharati#flavor: Reads the tide the way other people read faces, and has stopped pretending this is a metaphor. She left the palace because the court wanted prophecies and she only had weather.
fields.companions:shiny_needle#flavor: She prided herself on being the prettiest. When age threatened that, she found an elegant solution — draining the lifeforce of rivals through carefully rehearsed enchantments. She called it skincare.
fields.companions:shrutidhara#flavor: Wrong twice in thirty years, and she will tell you about both before she tells you her name. Walks at the back now, where she can see everyone.
fields.companions:sineater_thirteen#flavor: Born from a splinter of dark energy left when a primordial Srid was shattered by a wrathful Buddha. It has absorbed twelve previous identities and is still hungry.
fields.companions:sphotana#flavor: He woke from a nightmare to see his lair and his fur on fire, spreading from the dream into the world through his eyes and his breath. Now exiled, Sphotana seeks a way to contain his gifts.
fields.companions:sthanumati#flavor: Maintains the standing stones nobody else remembers the purpose of. She does not know either. She maintains them anyway, on the grounds that somebody clearly meant it.
fields.companions:sthiraka#flavor: The changing texture of the light is enough to keep him entertained. Better not bother him without a good reason, though.
fields.companions:takshari#flavor: Keeps the trophies, pours the mead, remembers which hero did what and to whom. The dead are less trouble than the living and better company.
fields.companions:tejasimha#flavor: First matches, then houses, then whole districts. He died laughing in a fire he started — hearty, genuine laughter, right to the end.
fields.companions:temba#flavor: Outcast at twelve. Followed at twenty. United the clans at thirty-five through sheer force of demonstrated possibility — showing them what happened when people stopped fighting each other long enough to eat. He never stopped being the outcast kid trying to feed people through a bad winter.
fields.companions:the_chronicler#flavor: Remembers the genealogies of peoples who left no other trace anywhere in the six worlds. Recites them anyway. Someone has to.
fields.companions:tikshnashringa#flavor: Charges in a straight line and meditates on why. Twenty years of practice have not made him stop charging; they have made him extremely precise about when.
fields.companions:timingila#flavor: Hunts alone in water where the light does not reach. Speaks rarely and with long pauses, as though surfacing between each sentence.
fields.companions:trinavati#flavor: Knows the slope, the clay, and which of the two you need. Will not be hurried down a mountain.
fields.companions:tsering#flavor: Worked every day of his life with diligence and nothing to show for it. No time to rest, no time to reflect. He is still moving, still laboring. He is not entirely sure why.
fields.companions:unmatta#flavor: Came down from the hills for one season of silk and wine and has not gone back in nine years. Insists he could stop. Nobody has asked him to.
fields.companions:vajradanti#flavor: Farms the boiling seams where the water comes up from under the world. Everything she knows about sorcery she worked out alone, at depth, with only the spirits to correct her.
fields.companions:valmika#flavor: Digs. Braces. Digs again. Has opinions about load-bearing timber that she will share whether or not you have expressed interest in load-bearing timber.
fields.companions:varika#flavor: This, my lord? How did I acquire it? Oh, from a middle aged person of no particular characteristics, of course!
fields.companions:vasuda#flavor: Born too early, she was the weakest in the sounder. She found inventive ways to pull her weight and protect her kin.
fields.companions:vayuvega#flavor: Battle mage for a gang in life — a firm believer in hitting hard first and letting the questions sort themselves out among the survivors.
fields.companions:vilasa#flavor: Boredom is a dangerous condition in a man without constraints and an unshakeable certainty of his own superiority. He passed through every conventional pleasure and kept going. By the end, the only question was what came next.
fields.companions:vimohini#flavor: In life, a mystic whose visions were so vivid that entire communities reshaped themselves around her prophecies. She wasn't lying. She genuinely saw another reality. In hell, the visions have teeth.
fields.companions:vishanin#flavor: Met a boar head-on once and has been dining out on it since. The scar is real. So, annoyingly, is the boar's.
fields.companions:water_lily#flavor: A village girl drowned as punishment for being found in bed with another girl. She has been very quiet ever since, but her stillness is not grief.
fields.companions:yaga_mataji#flavor: An old innkeeper who poisoned guests she found sinful. Her criteria were specific, her dosing was precise, and she kept excellent records.
fields.companions:yasha#flavor: Always one performance away from being truly seen, truly remembered. Still performing. The halls are empty now but the hunger for recognition does not consult the audience.
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_bhramara: Support caster that calls reinforcements; weak alone but dangerous when it completes a summon
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_dura_bur: Burrows underground and erupts adjacent to its target for a melee strike.
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_gana_alp: Not the fastest and not the strongest. The one the pack has already tested every alternative to.
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_gana_eld: Sings the hunt rather than joining it. What the pack hears from her, it does.
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_gana_how: Pack support; enchantment perks buff allies and weaken party members
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_gana_hun: A full-grown wolf that has done this many times. Closes only when the throat is already open.
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_gana_run: Pack hunter; grows sharper and harder to hit as more of the pack closes in.
Last of the litter and last to the kill. Harries the edges and runs from anything that turns.
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_gana_sta: Works the flanks while the pack holds the front. Goes for the straggler, never the strongest.
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_kapota_f: Flying mob; individually weak but overwhelming in numbers; grace perks give evasion bonus
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_kapota_m: Fast support; disrupts party formation; grace perks make it very hard to pin down
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_khadga_a: Arrives from concealment; guile perks grant blend_in/cheap_shot; first-strike opening
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_khadga_b: Natural mantis blades; very high crit chance from high finesse + unarmed crit perks
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_marjara_: Drops from canopy; guile perks give first-strike advantage; retreats after opening hit
Flanking predator; grace perks give evasion while repositioning; attacks from unexpected angles
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_matsya_s: Weak individually; pack bonus applies when 3+ present in encounter
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_mriga_he: Individually harmless. A stampede is not a fight, it is weather.
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_mriga_se: Watches the edge and calls the alarm. Hard to hit, hard to corner, and never fights alone by choice.
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_mriga_st: Rutting-season buck; charges anything that does not concede the ground. Antlers count as unarmed.
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_patanga_: Moves unpredictably before striking — impossible to anticipate.
fields.enemies:animal:archetype:animal_rakshasa: Boss-tier lone predator; singles out the weakest and most isolated party member.
