fields.items:blessed_smoke_crystal_mala#descrip: A hundred and eight beads of smoke crystal, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:blessed_sorcerer_hat#description: The pointed hat of the wrathful rites, worn with the Mahakala robe.
fields.items:blessed_sorcerer_robe#description: Heavy brocade bearing the face of Mahakala, for the wrathful rites.
fields.items:blessed_space_ngakpa_crown#descrip: The ngakpa's unbound hair is wound and pinned with this ornament. Space practitioners wear it through long retreat and carry it out with them.
fields.items:blessed_space_ngakpa_robe#descript: The red-and-white striped chuba of the ngakpa tradition — red for method, white for wisdom. Worn by tantric practitioners who have not taken monastic vows but have taken something harder. The garment is a reminder of what the wearer holds together.
fields.items:blessed_tantric_robe#description: Cut for the long ceremonies, where the rite runs past midnight.
fields.items:blessed_turquoise_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of turquoise, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:blessed_water_ngakpa_crown#descrip: Silver-set blue stone, worn at the crown. Reflects light in a way that always looks like water.
fields.items:blessed_water_ngakpa_robe#descript: Blue, the color of deep water. Water practitioners use it for meditations that require stillness and depth. The robe is heavier than it looks, which is also considered appropriate.
fields.items:bone_amulet#description: A carved bone amulet inscribed with mantras.
fields.items:bone_club#description: A knobbed femur swung like a gada. The form is ancient. The intent is clear.
fields.items:bone_dagger#description: A long bone sharpened to a point. Crude but quiet.
fields.items:bone_dust#description: Ground bone scattered in a cloud. Chokes and blinds anyone caught in it.
fields.items:bone_fittings#description: Pins, clasps, and rings carved from bone. Practical in their ugliness.
fields.items:bone_spear#description: A long bone lashed to a wooden shaft. Reach without refinement.
fields.items:bone_sword#description: A long bone ground to a double edge. Crude symmetry, brutish balance — the shape of a khanda in the materials of the damned.
fields.items:brahmi_ghrita#description: Brahmi herb clarified into ghee. A nerve tonic prized for clarity of mind and steadiness of hand.
fields.items:broken_manacles#description: Shackles snapped by someone determined. The iron is dense and workable.
fields.items:bronze_axe#description: A single-headed bronze axe. Splits wood and skulls with equal indifference.
fields.items:bronze_dagger#description: A short bronze blade, double-edged. Standard traveller's sidearm.
fields.items:bronze_dao#description: A broad single-edged bronze blade, heavy toward the tip. Unsophisticated in technique, effective in result.
fields.items:bronze_kukri#description: A forward-curved bronze blade, heavy toward the tip. Designed to chop rather than stab — the working knife of the mountain peoples.
fields.items:bronze_mace#description: A flanged bronze gada. Heavy on the back-swing, authoritative on contact.
fields.items:bronze_patisa#description: A wide two-handed bronze sword. Slow to bring to bear, decisive when it arrives.
fields.items:bronze_spear#description: A bronze-tipped spear with a hardwood haft. Reach and reliability.
fields.items:bronze_sword#description: A straight double-edged blade of cast bronze. The khanda: balanced, reliable, a soldier's sword.
fields.items:bronze_talwar#description: A slender curved blade of bronze. Lighter than a straight sword, quicker in the hand.
fields.items:butter_tea#description: Salt, yak butter, and strong tea in a wooden tube. Strange to outsiders, vital in the cold.
fields.items:chainmail#description: Interlocking iron rings provide solid protection.
fields.items:chang#description: Fermented barley beer in a cracked gourd. More warming than nourishing.
fields.items:chyawanprash#description: The great Ayurvedic jam — amalaki, honey, ghee, and forty-seven herbs. Dark, sweet, medicinal.
fields.items:cinnabar#description: Mercury sulfide, ground fine. Lurid red powder central to outer alchemy and Tibetan ritual medicine.
fields.items:cloth_robe#description: A simple robe, preferred by scholars.
fields.items:composite_bow#description: A recurve bow of layered horn, sinew and wood — the bow of Central Asian and Tibetan horsemen. Shorter than a longbow but just as powerful, with greater precision.
fields.items:copper_wire#description: Thin copper wire stripped from a larger mechanism. Useful for binding and conducting.
fields.items:cracked_bell_metal#description: Fragment of a bronze ritual bell. The alloy is good; the tone is gone.
fields.items:cure_all#description: A bitter draught that purges poison, disease, and curse alike.
fields.items:curry#description: A sealed clay pot of spiced lentils and root vegetables. Heavy, filling, restorative.
fields.items:dal_bhat#description: Lentil soup over rice — the meal that sustains half the Himalayas. Reliable and restorative.
fields.items:damascene_dao#description: A heavy single-edge blade of folded damascene steel. The watered pattern runs into the edge — which bites through armor as though finding it personally offensive.
fields.items:damascene_khanda#description: A straight blade of folded damascene steel, the layered grain visible along the edge. Perfectly balanced, reliably lethal.
fields.items:damascene_patisa#description: A broad two-handed damascene blade. Despite the craft that went into making it, its purpose remains entirely unambiguous.
fields.items:damascene_talwar#description: A curved damascene blade, patterned like flowing water. Lighter than any common sword of its power, swift enough to seem dishonest.
fields.items:datura_seed#description: Jimsonweed. Potent in small doses, lethal in larger ones. A staple of dark alchemy.
fields.items:demon_key#description: A black iron key taken from a hell warden. Its teeth seem to shift when no one is watching. Worth good coin to the right buyer — or perhaps it still opens something.
fields.items:demon_nail_bundle#description: Iron spikes shed from demonic hide. Sharp, pungent, and oddly workable.
fields.items:demon_plate_shard#description: A palm-sized chunk of demonic chest armor. Heavy, dense, and faintly warm.
fields.items:dragons_blood_oil#description: Rendered from dragonfire glands. Weapons coated in it burst into flame, and each wound fuels the wielder.
fields.items:dried_curd#description: Hard yak cheese that takes long to eat and longer to digest. Keeps indefinitely.
fields.items:dried_meat#description: Strips of yak or unidentified flesh, salted and dried. Tough, but sustaining.
fields.items:earth_charm_common#description: A piece of fossilized wood inscribed with a mantra of Prithivi. Reduces the mana cost of your next Earth spell.
fields.items:earth_charm_middling#description: A dense geode fragment pulsing with earthen power.
fields.items:earth_charm_rare#description: A crystal of living stone that amplifies earth magic.
fields.items:earth_charm_unique#description: A golden chip off Sumeru, the World Mountain. Vastly empowers Earth magic.
fields.items:elixir_of_power#description: A blazing golden elixir that ignites the mind. Restores mana fully and boosts spellpower for several turns.
fields.items:elixir_of_vitality#description: A deep crimson elixir that surges through the blood. Heals massively and temporarily increases maximum HP.
fields.items:ember_core#description: A smouldering sphere of compressed hellfire, warm to the touch. Used as a reagent in fire rituals and alchemical processes.
fields.items:empowered_air_ngakpa_crown#descrip: A light ornament of pale metal, worn low on the brow. Air practitioners note that it never seems to sit quite the same way twice.
fields.items:empowered_air_ngakpa_robe#descript: Green cotton, close-woven and lightweight. Air practitioners favor fewer layers and more movement. The color is said to invite the wind's attention.
fields.items:empowered_amethyst_mala#descriptio: A hundred and eight beads of amethyst, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:empowered_aquamarine_mala#descript: A hundred and eight beads of aquamarine, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:empowered_black_mantra_hat#descrip: A black crown of lacquered bone and iron. The weight is real and the message is clear.
fields.items:empowered_black_mantra_robe#descri: Black wool heavily embroidered with bone-white thread, charnel ground symbols running hem to collar. Practitioners of the dark schools wear it as armor of a different kind — it communicates what you are before you have to prove it.
fields.items:empowered_bone_bead_mala#descripti: A hundred and eight beads of bone, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:empowered_bone_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:empowered_bone_dorje#description: A ritual sceptre, the symbol of indestructible method. Weak as a weapon. In the right hand of a trained practitioner, it amplifies every spell cast. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:empowered_bone_drilbu#description: A ritual bell, held in the left hand. Its tone represents sunyata — emptiness. Rung in concert with the dorje, it opens the practitioner to a larger mana pool. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:empowered_bone_kangling#descriptio: A thigh-bone trumpet. The sound calls what should not be called. Used in Chöd to offer the self — spend 25% of max mana to stack raw spellpower. When mana is gone, the cost comes from HP. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:empowered_bone_khatvanga#descripti: A trident staff topped with a skull, the emblem of wrathful practice. Enemies within melee range feel their composure — and initiative — erode. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:empowered_bone_melong#description: A disc of polished bone hung at the breast. It shows what approaches, and turns some of it away.
fields.items:empowered_bone_phurba#description: A three-bladed ritual dagger. The three blades cut through ignorance, attachment, and aversion. Can be used to physically strike, but its true power is thrown — a ranged attack that pins and subjugates. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:empowered_bronze_damaru#descriptio: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Bronze is a compromise — not the ideal metal for space-work, but workable. Practitioners who cannot find sky-iron use it and find it adequate.

fields.items:empowered_chodpa_eye_covering#desc: A blindfold of dark cloth. What is called does not need to be seen.
fields.items:empowered_chodpa_robe#description: The chodpa's robe, worn to the charnel ground and not washed after.
fields.items:empowered_citrine_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of citrine, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:empowered_conch_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. The conch announces peace — pacification, healing, and the dharma that soothes. White magic runs through conch like water through a shell.

fields.items:empowered_crystal_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of crystal, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:empowered_dreamers_robe#descriptio: Loose, and strangely quiet. Worn for the practices done while asleep.
fields.items:empowered_earth_ngakpa_crown#descr: Gold-set amber, heavy, stable. Earth practitioners tend not to adjust it once it is on.
fields.items:empowered_earth_ngakpa_robe#descri: Yellow, the color of late-season grain and mountain clay. Earth practice is patient, and practitioners who favor earth magic tend to keep their robes in repair longer than most.
fields.items:empowered_fire_ngakpa_crown#descri: Copper ornament with a small flame-shaped finial. Warm to the touch even in cold, which practitioners find appropriate.
fields.items:empowered_fire_ngakpa_robe#descrip: Red with orange-bordered trim, the color of the hearth fire that is never fully extinguished. Fire tantra practitioners work with heat as both metaphor and fact. The robe holds warmth longer than the material seems to warrant.
fields.items:empowered_gold_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Gold is earth's incorruptible face — abundance, permanence, and stability. Earth-working through gold tends to endure longer than the fight.

fields.items:empowered_healers_crown#descriptio: A white cap edged with gold thread and a small blue stone at the brow. Healers are not hard to spot, and this is half the point.
fields.items:empowered_healers_robe#description: White cotton with saffron-dyed borders and a medicine wheel embroidered at the hem. The sleeves roll back easily. Healers wear it not as display but as identification: you can call on this person.
fields.items:empowered_iron_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Iron is the metal of air — sharp, mobile, cutting. Storm and wind obey it more readily than softer metals.

fields.items:empowered_longlife_cap#description: A cap of long life. Those who stand beside its wearer find themselves harder to kill.
fields.items:empowered_pandita_cap#description: A tall brocade cap worn by scholars and translators, marking long years of study. The pandita tradition values accumulated learning over inspired guessing. So does this cap.
fields.items:empowered_pandita_robe#description: The scholar's robe. Debate is a kind of combat, and this is its armour.
fields.items:empowered_rosewood_mala#descriptio: A hundred and eight beads of rosewood, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:empowered_sages_robe#description: Plain and heavy. The sage mends and endures in equal measure.
fields.items:empowered_sandalwood_mala#descript: A hundred and eight beads of sandalwood, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:empowered_silver_damaru#descriptio: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Silver belongs to water — clarity, reflection, and the deep current. Spells cast through silver flow rather than strike.

fields.items:empowered_sky_iron_melong#descript: A disc of polished sky iron hung at the breast. It shows what approaches, and turns some of it away.
fields.items:empowered_smoke_crystal_mala#descr: A hundred and eight beads of smoke crystal, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:empowered_sorcerer_hat#description: The pointed hat of the wrathful rites, worn with the Mahakala robe.
fields.items:empowered_sorcerer_robe#descriptio: Heavy brocade bearing the face of Mahakala, for the wrathful rites.
fields.items:empowered_space_ngakpa_crown#descr: The ngakpa's unbound hair is wound and pinned with this ornament. Space practitioners wear it through long retreat and carry it out with them.
fields.items:empowered_space_ngakpa_robe#descri: The red-and-white striped chuba of the ngakpa tradition — red for method, white for wisdom. Worn by tantric practitioners who have not taken monastic vows but have taken something harder. The garment is a reminder of what the wearer holds together.
fields.items:empowered_tantric_robe#description: Cut for the long ceremonies, where the rite runs past midnight.
fields.items:empowered_turquoise_mala#descripti: A hundred and eight beads of turquoise, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:empowered_water_ngakpa_crown#descr: Silver-set blue stone, worn at the crown. Reflects light in a way that always looks like water.
fields.items:empowered_water_ngakpa_robe#descri: Blue, the color of deep water. Water practitioners use it for meditations that require stillness and depth. The robe is heavier than it looks, which is also considered appropriate.
fields.items:enchantment_charm_common#descripti: A little jar of colorful powder. Reduces the mana cost of your next Enchantment spell.
fields.items:enchantment_charm_middling#descrip: A braided talisman of consecrated silk.
fields.items:enchantment_charm_rare#description: A little hibiscus flower, forever fresh and fragrant.
fields.items:enchantment_charm_unique#descripti: The string from a gandharva's sitar, woven into an ornamental loop.
fields.items:face_cloth#description: A strip of cloth wound across the nose and mouth. Standard equipment for anyone who travels through the ash fields or charnel grounds.
fields.items:fine_alchemists_kit#description: A folding brass frame, three retorts, and a burner that has scorched every table it ever sat on. Smells of sulphur through the case.
fields.items:fine_lute#description: Pear-bellied, gut-strung, never quite in tune in cold weather. A crowd that is listening is a crowd that is not deciding anything else.
fields.items:fine_medicine_bag#description: Needles, catgut, tincture bottles and a bone saw, rolled in waxed cloth. Heavy at the shoulder. Heavier when it is needed and not there.
fields.items:fine_merchants_scales#description: Brass pans on a folding beam, with a set of true weights and a set of the other kind. Which is which depends on the day.
fields.items:fine_quartermasters_ledger#descrip: Every ration, every arrow, every mile, in a hand so small it needs holding to the light. An army eats before it fights.
fields.items:fine_smiths_hammer#description: Two pounds of forged steel on a hickory haft, the face polished mirror-bright by work. Not made as a weapon. Perfectly willing.
fields.items:fine_thieving_tools#description: Picks, tension wrenches, a mirror on a wire, a strip of shim brass. Rolls up small. Explains poorly.
fields.items:fine_war_standard#description: A pole, a crosspiece, and a rag that has been somewhere. Men who cannot hear an order can see this.
fields.items:fire_bomb#description: An alchemical incendiary that explodes on impact.
fields.items:fire_charm_common#description: A smoldering ember charm. Reduces the mana cost of your next Fire spell.
fields.items:fire_charm_middling#description: A small red crystal, glowing softly and warm to the touch.
fields.items:fire_charm_rare#description: A supernaturally crimson scale off the tail of a lizard yogini from the Sun.
fields.items:fire_charm_unique#description: A phial with a flicker of elemental flame that never goes out.
fields.items:fire_crystal#description: A shard of crystallized hellfire, warm to the touch even in the cold hells. Alchemists prize it as a potent reagent.
fields.items:fire_resistance_talisman#descripti: An old offering found near the lava guardian's passage. Grants some protection from flames.
fields.items:firebomb#description: A clay flask of alchemical oil. Shatters on impact and ignites everything nearby.
fields.items:flame_oil#description: Coats a weapon with alchemical fire. Next 3 attacks deal bonus fire damage.
fields.items:flashbang#description: A blinding alchemical burst. Disorients all enemies in the area.
fields.items:frost_oil#description: Coats a weapon with bitter cold. Next 3 attacks deal bonus cold damage and may chill.
fields.items:frost_steel_fragments#description: Plates of metal tempered by the cold hell's extremes. Harder and stranger than plain iron.
fields.items:frozen_heart_amulet#description: A sapphire heart encased in eternal ice. Slows the wearer's pulse, granting preternatural calm.
fields.items:ghost_pepper#description: A dried spirit-world pepper. Causes searing pain on contact — thrown at enemies, not eaten.
fields.items:good_iron_armor#description: Sturdy iron armor left behind by the frozen army. Still in remarkable condition.
fields.items:good_iron_weapon#description: A well-made iron weapon. When found, its type matches the bearer's best weapon skill.
fields.items:greater_fire_bomb#description: A volatile alchemical explosive packed with concentrated flame powder.
fields.items:greater_mana_potion#description: A potent distillation of magical essence.
fields.items:guduchi#description: Giloy stem, dried and powdered. Called 'the divine nectar' for its resilience.
fields.items:healing_herb#description: A bitter-tasting leaf with mild restorative properties.
fields.items:healing_moss#description: Grey-green, slow-growing, scraped from the north face of stones. Keeps for years.
fields.items:health_potion#description: A red tincture that restores vitality.
fields.items:hell_iron_shards#description: Fragments of demon-forged armor, still warm to the touch.
fields.items:hellforge_ingot#description: A rough ingot poured at one of the infernal forges. Still carries heat from the casting.
fields.items:herb_bundle#description: Assorted medicinal herbs, roots, and dried flowers.
fields.items:holy_oil#description: Blessed ointment that imbues a weapon with divine wrath.
fields.items:holy_water_bomb#description: Consecrated water that scalds the unholy.
fields.items:hunting_bow#description: A simple wooden dhanush, the classic bow of hunters and soldiers alike. Balanced between power and ease of use.
fields.items:ice_shard#description: A shard of living ice that hums with power, gifted by the spirits of the frozen lake.
fields.items:inferno_bomb#description: An unstable alchemical charge that detonates in a massive fireball, leaving burning ground.
fields.items:iron_axe#description: A heavy iron axe, good for chopping.
fields.items:iron_bichawa#description: A curved iron dagger with a double-looped guard that catches and traps incoming blades. Worn in the off-hand to defend while striking.
fields.items:iron_chakram#description: A flat iron throwing ring with a sharpened outer edge. Flies in a stable arc and passes through the first target to strike the second. Retrieve after battle.
fields.items:iron_dagger#description: A simple iron dagger, quick to strike.
fields.items:iron_dao#description: A heavy single-edged iron blade, widening toward the tip. Built to chop through armor, not dance around it.
fields.items:iron_helmet#description: An iron helmet with nose guard.
fields.items:iron_katar#description: A transverse-grip push dagger — the hand passes through an H-shaped handle and the blade extends along the forearm. Difficult to deflect, punishing on a direct hit.
fields.items:iron_khanda#description: A straight double-edged iron blade. Balanced for cut and thrust alike — the dependable sword of soldiers across a dozen realms.
fields.items:iron_kukri#description: An iron kukri, the blade angling sharply forward. More damage than a dagger, less reach than a sword. The kukri does not split the difference — it ignores it.
fields.items:iron_mace#description: A flanged iron gada, the classical striking weapon of warriors across the subcontinent. Heavy, direct, and very final.
fields.items:iron_patisa#description: A broad two-handed iron blade. Takes both arms to wield and enough strength to mean it.
fields.items:iron_ring#description: A plain iron ring. Adds little beauty but some substance.
fields.items:iron_shield#description: A sturdy iron shield with a boss.
fields.items:iron_sword#description: A curved iron saber, lighter than a straight blade. Quick on the draw, precise on the thrust.
fields.items:iron_trishula#description: A three-pronged iron trident — Shiva's emblem made into a weapon of war. The forked head is harder to dodge than a single point, and on a true hit the prongs catch and hold.
fields.items:jatamansi#description: Himalayan spikenard. Calms wind humor, aids rest in hostile terrain.
fields.items:khabse#description: Fried dough twists, dense and sweet — festival food from a better life.
fields.items:khichdi#description: Rice and lentils cooked down to a thick porridge. The universal comfort food.
fields.items:lamellar_armor#description: Rows of overlapping iron plates laced together with cord — the armor of Tibetan and Central Asian warriors. Lighter than chainmail, more protective, and easier to repair in the field.
fields.items:lapis_powder#description: Ground lapis lazuli, sky-blue and faintly bitter. Used in Tibetan art, medicine, and ritual.
fields.items:leather_vest#description: A layered wool travelling coat, the everyday garment of Tibetan highlanders. Worn belted, one shoulder free — practical protection against cold and blade alike.
fields.items:legendary_agate_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of agate, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:legendary_air_ngakpa_crown#descrip: A light ornament of pale metal, worn low on the brow. Air practitioners note that it never seems to sit quite the same way twice.
fields.items:legendary_air_ngakpa_robe#descript: Green cotton, close-woven and lightweight. Air practitioners favor fewer layers and more movement. The color is said to invite the wind's attention.
fields.items:legendary_alchemists_kit#descripti: A folding brass frame, three retorts, and a burner that has scorched every table it ever sat on. Smells of sulphur through the case.
fields.items:legendary_black_mantra_hat#descrip: A black crown of lacquered bone and iron. The weight is real and the message is clear.
fields.items:legendary_black_mantra_robe#descri: Black wool heavily embroidered with bone-white thread, charnel ground symbols running hem to collar. Practitioners of the dark schools wear it as armor of a different kind — it communicates what you are before you have to prove it.
fields.items:legendary_bone_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:legendary_bone_dorje#description: A ritual sceptre, the symbol of indestructible method. Weak as a weapon. In the right hand of a trained practitioner, it amplifies every spell cast. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:legendary_bone_drilbu#description: A ritual bell, held in the left hand. Its tone represents sunyata — emptiness. Rung in concert with the dorje, it opens the practitioner to a larger mana pool. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:legendary_bone_kangling#descriptio: A thigh-bone trumpet. The sound calls what should not be called. Used in Chöd to offer the self — spend 25% of max mana to stack raw spellpower. When mana is gone, the cost comes from HP. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:legendary_bone_khatvanga#descripti: A trident staff topped with a skull, the emblem of wrathful practice. Enemies within melee range feel their composure — and initiative — erode. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:legendary_bone_melong#description: A disc of polished bone hung at the breast. It shows what approaches, and turns some of it away.
fields.items:legendary_bone_phurba#description: A three-bladed ritual dagger. The three blades cut through ignorance, attachment, and aversion. Can be used to physically strike, but its true power is thrown — a ranged attack that pins and subjugates. Bone is the wrathful material — it has already been through death. Black magic practices find their anchor here naturally.
fields.items:legendary_bronze_melong#descriptio: A disc of polished bronze hung at the breast. It shows what approaches, and turns some of it away.
fields.items:legendary_chodpa_eye_covering#desc: A blindfold of dark cloth. What is called does not need to be seen.
fields.items:legendary_chodpa_robe#description: The chodpa's robe, worn to the charnel ground and not washed after.
fields.items:legendary_conch_bead_mala#descript: A hundred and eight beads of conch, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:legendary_conch_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. The conch announces peace — pacification, healing, and the dharma that soothes. White magic runs through conch like water through a shell.

fields.items:legendary_diamond_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of diamond, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:legendary_dreamers_robe#descriptio: Loose, and strangely quiet. Worn for the practices done while asleep.
fields.items:legendary_earth_ngakpa_crown#descr: Gold-set amber, heavy, stable. Earth practitioners tend not to adjust it once it is on.
fields.items:legendary_earth_ngakpa_robe#descri: Yellow, the color of late-season grain and mountain clay. Earth practice is patient, and practitioners who favor earth magic tend to keep their robes in repair longer than most.
fields.items:legendary_emerald_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of emerald, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:legendary_fire_ngakpa_crown#descri: Copper ornament with a small flame-shaped finial. Warm to the touch even in cold, which practitioners find appropriate.
fields.items:legendary_fire_ngakpa_robe#descrip: Red with orange-bordered trim, the color of the hearth fire that is never fully extinguished. Fire tantra practitioners work with heat as both metaphor and fact. The robe holds warmth longer than the material seems to warrant.
fields.items:legendary_gold_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Gold is earth's incorruptible face — abundance, permanence, and stability. Earth-working through gold tends to endure longer than the fight.

fields.items:legendary_healers_crown#descriptio: A white cap edged with gold thread and a small blue stone at the brow. Healers are not hard to spot, and this is half the point.
fields.items:legendary_healers_robe#description: White cotton with saffron-dyed borders and a medicine wheel embroidered at the hem. The sleeves roll back easily. Healers wear it not as display but as identification: you can call on this person.
fields.items:legendary_iron_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Iron is the metal of air — sharp, mobile, cutting. Storm and wind obey it more readily than softer metals.

fields.items:legendary_longlife_cap#description: A cap of long life. Those who stand beside its wearer find themselves harder to kill.
fields.items:legendary_lute#description: Pear-bellied, gut-strung, never quite in tune in cold weather. A crowd that is listening is a crowd that is not deciding anything else.
fields.items:legendary_medicine_bag#description: Needles, catgut, tincture bottles and a bone saw, rolled in waxed cloth. Heavy at the shoulder. Heavier when it is needed and not there.
fields.items:legendary_merchants_scales#descrip: Brass pans on a folding beam, with a set of true weights and a set of the other kind. Which is which depends on the day.
fields.items:legendary_mirror_bead_mala#descrip: A hundred and eight beads of mirror bead, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:legendary_opal_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of opal, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:legendary_pandita_cap#description: A tall brocade cap worn by scholars and translators, marking long years of study. The pandita tradition values accumulated learning over inspired guessing. So does this cap.
fields.items:legendary_pandita_robe#description: The scholar's robe. Debate is a kind of combat, and this is its armour.
fields.items:legendary_quartermasters_ledger#de: Every ration, every arrow, every mile, in a hand so small it needs holding to the light. An army eats before it fights.
fields.items:legendary_ruby_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of ruby, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:legendary_sages_robe#description: Plain and heavy. The sage mends and endures in equal measure.
fields.items:legendary_silver_damaru#descriptio: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Silver belongs to water — clarity, reflection, and the deep current. Spells cast through silver flow rather than strike.

fields.items:legendary_smiths_hammer#descriptio: Two pounds of forged steel on a hickory haft, the face polished mirror-bright by work. Not made as a weapon. Perfectly willing.
fields.items:legendary_sorcerer_hat#description: The pointed hat of the wrathful rites, worn with the Mahakala robe.
fields.items:legendary_sorcerer_robe#descriptio: Heavy brocade bearing the face of Mahakala, for the wrathful rites.
fields.items:legendary_space_ngakpa_crown#descr: The ngakpa's unbound hair is wound and pinned with this ornament. Space practitioners wear it through long retreat and carry it out with them.
fields.items:legendary_space_ngakpa_robe#descri: The red-and-white striped chuba of the ngakpa tradition — red for method, white for wisdom. Worn by tantric practitioners who have not taken monastic vows but have taken something harder. The garment is a reminder of what the wearer holds together.
fields.items:legendary_star_sapphire_mala#descr: A hundred and eight beads of star sapphire, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:legendary_tantric_robe#description: Cut for the long ceremonies, where the rite runs past midnight.
fields.items:legendary_thieving_tools#descripti: Picks, tension wrenches, a mirror on a wire, a strip of shim brass. Rolls up small. Explains poorly.
fields.items:legendary_topaz_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of topaz, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:legendary_war_standard#description: A pole, a crosspiece, and a rag that has been somewhere. Men who cannot hear an order can see this.
fields.items:legendary_water_ngakpa_crown#descr: Silver-set blue stone, worn at the crown. Reflects light in a way that always looks like water.
fields.items:legendary_water_ngakpa_robe#descri: Blue, the color of deep water. Water practitioners use it for meditations that require stillness and depth. The robe is heavier than it looks, which is also considered appropriate.
fields.items:longbow#description: A powerful bow requiring great strength to draw. Unmatched range and impact.
fields.items:lucky_charm#description: A small charm said to bring good fortune.
fields.items:mahasudarshana#description: A Tibetan compound of fifty herbs. Named for the great discus — cuts through obstruction.
fields.items:mana_potion#description: A shimmering blue elixir that restores magical energy.
fields.items:mantle_of_the_undying_flame#descri: Woven from perpetual embers, this robe burns without consuming. Fire cannot harm its wearer.
fields.items:masterwork_alchemists_kit#descript: A folding brass frame, three retorts, and a burner that has scorched every table it ever sat on. Smells of sulphur through the case.

fields.items:meat_stew#description: A heavy pot of slow-cooked meat and root vegetables. Smells better than it should down here.
fields.items:mercury_amalgam#description: Processed quicksilver fixed with sulphur. Central to both Tibetan and Indian outer alchemy.
fields.items:momo#description: Steamed dumplings stuffed with spiced meat and chilli — someone's best effort at comfort in hell.
fields.items:monks_hood#description: A deep cowl worn during practice and meditation. Cuts out the world. In that silence, something steadier than thought becomes available.
fields.items:monks_robe#description: A saffron-dyed cotton robe, simply cut. Marks the wearer as one who has taken vows. The discipline of monastic life shows in the body.
fields.items:neem_bark#description: Bitter and antiparasitic. You're not sure what lives in hell's water, but this helps.
fields.items:oak_staff#description: A sturdy oak staff, carved with simple protective symbols.
fields.items:obsidian_blade#description: A wide single-edged blade of chipped obsidian. The volcanic glass finds gaps in armor that iron cannot. The structural integrity is terrifying in its own way.
fields.items:obsidian_dagger#description: Volcanic glass knapped to a razor edge. Cuts cleaner than anything this tier — but drop it and it shatters.
fields.items:obsidian_spear#description: A hafted spear with a knapped obsidian head. Deadly on the thrust. Do not use it to parry.
fields.items:panacea#description: The alchemist's masterwork. Heals all wounds, purges all ailments, and restores body and mind to peak condition.
fields.items:paralyzing_oil#description: A numbing toxin extracted from cave spiders. Attacks may stun the target.
fields.items:perfected_agate_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of agate, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.

fields.items:perfected_black_mantra_hat#descrip: A black crown of lacquered bone and iron. The weight is real and the message is clear.

fields.items:perfected_bone_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. fields.items:perfected_chodpa_eye_covering#desc: A blindfold of dark cloth. What is called does not need to be seen.
fields.items:perfected_chodpa_robe#description: The chodpa's robe, worn to the charnel ground and not washed after.

fields.items:perfected_dreamers_robe#descriptio: Loose, and strangely quiet. Worn for the practices done while asleep.
fields.items:perfected_earth_ngakpa_crown#descr: Gold-set amber, heavy, stable. Earth practitioners tend not to adjust it once it is on.
fields.items:perfected_earth_ngakpa_robe#descri: Yellow, the color of late-season grain and mountain clay. Earth practice is patient, and practitioners who favor earth magic tend to keep their robes in repair longer than most.
fields.items:perfected_emerald_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of emerald, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:perfected_fire_ngakpa_crown#descri: Copper ornament with a small flame-shaped finial. Warm to the touch even in cold, which practitioners find appropriate.
fields.items:perfected_fire_ngakpa_robe#descrip: Red with orange-bordered trim, the color of the hearth fire that is never fully extinguished. Fire tantra practitioners work with heat as both metaphor and fact. The robe holds warmth longer than the material seems to warrant.

fields.items:perfected_healers_robe#description: White cotton with saffron-dyed borders and a medicine wheel embroidered at the hem. The sleeves roll back easily. Healers wear it not as display but as identification: you can call on this person.

fields.items:perfected_longlife_cap#description: A cap of long life. Those who stand beside its wearer find themselves harder to kill.

fields.items:perfected_opal_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of opal, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:perfected_pandita_cap#description: A tall brocade cap worn by scholars and translators, marking long years of study. The pandita tradition values accumulated learning over inspired guessing. So does this cap.
fields.items:perfected_pandita_robe#description: The scholar's robe. Debate is a kind of combat, and this is its armour.
fields.items:perfected_ruby_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of ruby, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:perfected_sages_robe#description: Plain and heavy. The sage mends and endures in equal measure.

fields.items:perfected_sorcerer_hat#description: The pointed hat of the wrathful rites, worn with the Mahakala robe.
fields.items:perfected_sorcerer_robe#descriptio: Heavy brocade bearing the face of Mahakala, for the wrathful rites.
fields.items:perfected_space_ngakpa_crown#descr: The ngakpa's unbound hair is wound and pinned with this ornament. Space practitioners wear it through long retreat and carry it out with them.
fields.items:perfected_space_ngakpa_robe#descri: The red-and-white striped chuba of the ngakpa tradition — red for method, white for wisdom. Worn by tantric practitioners who have not taken monastic vows but have taken something harder. The garment is a reminder of what the wearer holds together.
fields.items:perfected_star_sapphire_mala#descr: A hundred and eight beads of star sapphire, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:perfected_tantric_robe#description: Cut for the long ceremonies, where the rite runs past midnight.
fields.items:perfected_topaz_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of topaz, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:perfected_water_ngakpa_crown#descr: Silver-set blue stone, worn at the crown. Reflects light in a way that always looks like water.
fields.items:perfected_water_ngakpa_robe#descri: Blue, the color of deep water. Water practitioners use it for meditations that require stillness and depth. The robe is heavier than it looks, which is also considered appropriate.
fields.items:pilgrim_mantle#description: Worn by those who walk the long roads between shrines. The road is the practice.
fields.items:plague_flask#description: A biohazardous alchemical concoction. Spreads a fast-acting disease that jumps between enemies.
fields.items:plain_air_ngakpa_crown#description: A light ornament of pale metal, worn low on the brow. Air practitioners note that it never seems to sit quite the same way twice.
fields.items:plain_air_ngakpa_robe#description: Green cotton, close-woven and lightweight. Air practitioners favor fewer layers and more movement. The color is said to invite the wind's attention.
fields.items:plain_alchemists_kit#description: A folding brass frame, three retorts, and a burner that has scorched every table it ever sat on. Smells of sulphur through the case.

Can be used to physically strike, but its true power is thrown — a ranged attack that pins and subjugates. Copper carries fire — transformation, passion, and the forge. The practitioner who wields this brings heat to every working.
fields.items:plain_coral_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of coral, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:plain_crystal_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of crystal, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:plain_dreamers_robe#description: Loose, and strangely quiet. Worn for the practices done while asleep.
fields.items:plain_earth_ngakpa_crown#descripti: Gold-set amber, heavy, stable. Earth practitioners tend not to adjust it once it is on.
fields.items:plain_earth_ngakpa_robe#descriptio: Yellow, the color of late-season grain and mountain clay. Earth practice is patient, and practitioners who favor earth magic tend to keep their robes in repair longer than most.
fields.items:plain_fire_ngakpa_crown#descriptio: Copper ornament with a small flame-shaped finial. Warm to the touch even in cold, which practitioners find appropriate.
fields.items:plain_fire_ngakpa_robe#description: Red with orange-bordered trim, the color of the hearth fire that is never fully extinguished. Fire tantra practitioners work with heat as both metaphor and fact. The robe holds warmth longer than the material seems to warrant.
fields.items:plain_gold_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Gold is earth's incorruptible face — abundance, permanence, and stability. Earth-working through gold tends to endure longer than the fight.
fields.items:plain_gold_dorje#description: A ritual sceptre, the symbol of indestructible method. Weak as a weapon. In the right hand of a trained practitioner, it amplifies every spell cast. Gold is earth's incorruptible face — abundance, permanence, and stability. Earth-working through gold tends to endure longer than the fight.
fields.items:plain_gold_drilbu#description: A ritual bell, held in the left hand. Its tone represents sunyata — emptiness. Rung in concert with the dorje, it opens the practitioner to a larger mana pool. Gold is earth's incorruptible face — abundance, permanence, and stability. Earth-working through gold tends to endure longer than the fight.
fields.items:plain_gold_kangling#description: A thigh-bone trumpet. The sound calls what should not be called. Used in Chöd to offer the self — spend 25% of max mana to stack raw spellpower. When mana is gone, the cost comes from HP. Gold is earth's incorruptible face — abundance, permanence, and stability. Earth-working through gold tends to endure longer than the fight.
fields.items:plain_gold_khatvanga#description: A trident staff topped with a skull, the emblem of wrathful practice. Enemies within melee range feel their composure — and initiative — erode. Gold is earth's incorruptible face — abundance, permanence, and stability. Earth-working through gold tends to endure longer than the fight.
fields.items:plain_gold_melong#description: A disc of polished gold hung at the breast. It shows what approaches, and turns some of it away.
fields.items:plain_gold_phurba#description: A three-bladed ritual dagger. The three blades cut through ignorance, attachment, and aversion. Earth-working through gold tends to endure longer than the fight.
fields.items:plain_healers_crown#description: A white cap edged with gold thread and a small blue stone at the brow. Healers are not hard to spot, and this is half the point.
fields.items:plain_healers_robe#description: White cotton with saffron-dyed borders and a medicine wheel embroidered at the hem. The sleeves roll back easily. Healers wear it not as display but as identification: you can call on this person.
fields.items:plain_iron_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Iron is the metal of air — sharp, mobile, cutting. Storm and wind obey it more readily than softer metals.
fields.items:plain_iron_dorje#description: A ritual sceptre, the symbol of indestructible method. Weak as a weapon. In the right hand of a trained practitioner, it amplifies every spell cast. Iron is the metal of air — sharp, mobile, cutting. Storm and wind obey it more readily than softer metals.

Storm and wind obey it more readily than softer metals.
fields.items:plain_longlife_cap#description: A cap of long life. The wearer endures.
fields.items:plain_lute#description: Pear-bellied, gut-strung, never quite in tune in cold weather. A crowd that is listening is a crowd that is not deciding anything else.
fields.items:plain_medicine_bag#description: Needles, catgut, tincture bottles and a bone saw, rolled in waxed cloth. Heavy at the shoulder. Heavier when it is needed and not there.
fields.items:plain_merchants_scales#description: Brass pans on a folding beam, with a set of true weights and a set of the other kind. Which is which depends on the day.
fields.items:plain_pandita_cap#description: A tall brocade cap worn by scholars and translators, marking long years of study. The pandita tradition values accumulated learning over inspired guessing. So does this cap.
fields.items:plain_pandita_robe#description: The scholar's robe. Debate is a kind of combat, and this is its armour.
fields.items:plain_quartermasters_ledger#descri: Every ration, every arrow, every mile, in a hand so small it needs holding to the light. An army eats before it fights.
fields.items:plain_rosewood_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of rosewood, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:plain_sages_robe#description: Plain and heavy. The sage mends and endures in equal measure.
fields.items:plain_sandalwood_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of sandalwood, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:plain_silver_damaru#description: A small double-headed drum shaken by a cord. Three spells cast while holding it and the rhythm reaches its peak — the next spell costs 40% less mana. Silver belongs to water — clarity, reflection, and the deep current. Spells cast through silver flow rather than strike.

Silver belongs to water — clarity, reflection, and the deep current. Spells cast through silver flow rather than strike.

Spells cast through silver flow rather than strike.

Spells cast through silver flow rather than strike.
fields.items:plain_sky_iron_melong#description: A disc of polished sky iron hung at the breast. It shows what approaches, and turns some of it away.
fields.items:plain_smiths_hammer#description: Two pounds of forged steel on a hickory haft, the face polished mirror-bright by work. Not made as a weapon. Perfectly willing.
fields.items:plain_smoke_crystal_mala#descripti: A hundred and eight beads of smoke crystal, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:plain_sorcerer_hat#description: The pointed hat of the wrathful rites, worn with the Mahakala robe.
fields.items:plain_sorcerer_robe#description: Heavy brocade bearing the face of Mahakala, for the wrathful rites.
fields.items:plain_space_ngakpa_crown#descripti: The ngakpa's unbound hair is wound and pinned with this ornament. Space practitioners wear it through long retreat and carry it out with them.
fields.items:plain_space_ngakpa_robe#descriptio: The red-and-white striped chuba of the ngakpa tradition — red for method, white for wisdom. Worn by tantric practitioners who have not taken monastic vows but have taken something harder. The garment is a reminder of what the wearer holds together.
fields.items:plain_tantric_robe#description: Cut for the long ceremonies, where the rite runs past midnight.
fields.items:plain_thieving_tools#description: Picks, tension wrenches, a mirror on a wire, a strip of shim brass. Rolls up small. Explains poorly.
fields.items:plain_turquoise_mala#description: A hundred and eight beads of turquoise, worn smooth at the thumb. Counts the recitation so the mind need not.
fields.items:plain_war_standard#description: A pole, a crosspiece, and a rag that has been somewhere. Men who cannot hear an order can see this.
fields.items:plain_water_ngakpa_crown#descripti: Silver-set blue stone, worn at the crown. Reflects light in a way that always looks like water.
fields.items:plain_water_ngakpa_robe#descriptio: Blue, the color of deep water. Water practitioners use it for meditations that require stillness and depth. The robe is heavier than it looks, which is also considered appropriate.
fields.items:poison_bomb#description: A noxious cloud bomb that chokes everything in the area.
fields.items:poison_oil#description: A venomous coating that lingers on the blade. Next 4 attacks may poison the target.
fields.items:prayer_beads#description: Mala beads used for meditation and mantra recitation.
fields.items:precious_pills#description: Rinchen rilbu — Tibetan medicine's highest formulation. Gold, gems, and purified minerals compressed into small black pills.
fields.items:prosthetic_crude_arm#description: A shaped limb of bound wood and strap. It holds a shield, balances a load, and asks nothing else of you.
fields.items:prosthetic_crude_foot#description: A carved block shaped roughly to a foot, lashed to the ankle. Better than nothing, which is the competition.
fields.items:prosthetic_crude_hand#description: A carved wooden hand on a leather cuff. It grips, after a fashion, if you help it.
fields.items:prosthetic_crude_leg#description: A peg and a cup, strapped above the knee. Walking is possible. Running is a conversation.
fields.items:prosthetic_fine_arm#description: Blackened steel with a bone core, hollow and light. Whatever it costs to carry, it gives back in reach.
fields.items:prosthetic_fine_foot#description: A light articulated foot that reads the ground through the sole. You are surer on bad footing than you were before.
fields.items:prosthetic_fine_hand#description: Articulated steel over bone, each joint pinned separately. The grip is stronger than flesh and does not tire.
fields.items:prosthetic_fine_leg#description: Steel and cured hide with a leaf-spring in the ankle. It returns energy on every step — faster than the leg it replaces.
fields.items:prosthetic_fitted_arm#description: A hollow iron arm, counterweighted at the shoulder so it swings true. Properly fitted, it is simply an arm.
fields.items:prosthetic_fitted_foot#description: A hinged foot with a proper heel and toe break. Your gait comes back within a month.
fields.items:prosthetic_fitted_hand#description: An iron hand with sprung fingers, socketed to the forearm. Closes on command and stays closed.
fields.items:prosthetic_fitted_leg#description: A jointed leg with a sprung knee, socketed and padded. You can walk all day on it.
fields.items:random_common_talisman#description: A small carved token pressed into your hands by a grateful soul.
fields.items:rations#description: Dried meat and grain. Keeps the party fed on the road.
fields.items:raw_reagents#description: Mineral salts, dried fungi, and alchemical base compounds.
fields.items:realgar#description: Arsenic sulphide in orange crystal form. Toxic to demons and humans alike in sufficient quantity.
fields.items:rice_portion#description: A knotted cloth of uncooked rice. Plain, but it fills the belly.
fields.items:saffron_pinch#description: A generous pinch of saffron threads, wrapped in cloth. Rare and potent.
fields.items:salvage_kit#description: Usable metal, leather strips, and repair materials.
fields.items:salvaged_chain#description: Detached from a longer length. Someone was freed here, or escaped.
fields.items:scrap_metal#description: Bent nails, broken fittings, and salvageable metal scraps.
fields.items:scroll_bless#description: A buff scroll that raises combat effectiveness for several turns.
fields.items:scroll_blink#description: A utility scroll that teleports the user a short distance.
fields.items:scroll_blizzard#description: An AoE cold scroll that conjures a storm of ice.
fields.items:scroll_chain_lightning#description: An AoE air scroll. Lightning arcs between enemies.
fields.items:scroll_confusion#description: Causes an enemy to act erratically, attacking random targets.
fields.items:scroll_cure#description: Removes a negative status effect. Usable by anyone.
fields.items:scroll_dispel#description: Removes all magical buffs and debuffs from a target.
fields.items:scroll_earthquake#description: A heavy earth scroll that shakes the ground. Damages all enemies.
fields.items:scroll_fireball#description: An AoE fire scroll. The paper is slightly warm to the touch.
fields.items:scroll_firebolt#description: A scroll inscribed with the Firebolt incantation. Usable by anyone.
fields.items:scroll_haste#description: Grants an extra action for several turns.
fields.items:scroll_lesser_heal#description: A scroll inscribed with a healing prayer. Usable by anyone.
fields.items:scroll_magic_missile#description: A scroll of pure force. Usable by anyone.
fields.items:scroll_regeneration#description: A healing scroll that restores HP over several turns.
fields.items:scroll_shocking_grasp#description: A crackling scroll of air energy. Usable by anyone.
fields.items:scroll_slow#description: Slows an enemy, halving its movement for several turns.
fields.items:scroll_stone_skin#description: Hardens the skin like stone, granting temporary armor.
fields.items:scroll_stone_spike#description: A heavy scroll dense with earth energy.
fields.items:scroll_voidbolt#description: A scroll imbued with space magic. The ink seems to shift when you're not looking at it.
fields.items:sha_phaley#description: Meat-filled bread, pan-fried and still warm. Someone left these in a hurry.
fields.items:shadowcloak#description: Dark and close-fitted. Those who wear it learn to move with intention.
fields.items:shatavari#description: Asparagus root from high altitude. Replenishes after exertion.
fields.items:shilajit#description: Mineral pitch seeping from hot rock. Rasayana tradition names it the destroyer of weakness.
fields.items:short_bow#description: A compact bow, easy to carry and quick to draw.
fields.items:silk_cape#description: Woven from fine silk, it catches the light in a way that unsettles people. Possibly intentional.
fields.items:sky_iron_dao#description: A heavy chopping blade of sky-iron. Where ordinary steel fails against armored foes, this finds a way through.
fields.items:sky_iron_khanda#description: Forged from gnam-lcags — Tibetan sky-iron, meteoritic metal that fell from the heavens. Lighter than iron has any right to be. Sacred in its origins.
fields.items:sky_iron_patisa#description: A massive two-handed blade of meteoritic iron. Those who carry it feel the weight of the cosmos in every swing.
fields.items:sky_iron_talwar#description: A curved blade of meteoritic sky-iron. The metal carries something of the void from which it fell — strikes land with unsettling precision.
fields.items:smelling_salts#description: Sharp-smelling crystals. Revives a stunned or dazed ally.
fields.items:smoke_bomb#description: A blinding smoke cloud. Affects all units in the area.
fields.items:smoked_lenses#description: Ground from dark volcanic glass, set in a copper frame. Dimmer, but nothing can dazzle you.
fields.items:soma_resin#description: A gummy substance of uncertain origin. Smells of lightning and old ceremony.
fields.items:sorcery_charm_common#description: A glass lens infused with raw magical force. Reduces the mana cost of your next Sorcery spell.
fields.items:sorcery_charm_middling#description: A planetary sigil sealed in copper. When you put your ear to it, you can hear the seed syllable in its hum.
fields.items:sorcery_charm_rare#description: A compressed spell-knot from a battle sorcerer's kit.
fields.items:sorcery_charm_unique#description: A mahasiddha's last breath, sealed in lacquer.
fields.items:soul_stone#description: A piece of turquoise left behind by a liberated spirit. Warm to the touch.
fields.items:sovereign_oil#description: The pinnacle of applied alchemy. Deals fire, frost, and void damage simultaneously, bypassing all resistances.
fields.items:space_charm_common#description: A small namkha woven of white and sky-blue thread. Reduces the mana cost of your next Space spell.
fields.items:space_charm_middling#description: A looking glass, through which distance seems slightly different each time one looks.
fields.items:space_charm_rare#description: A piece of strangely light crystal, brought over from a dream. Through it, walls look thinner.
fields.items:space_charm_unique#description: A small bubble of perfect void, encased in a star sapphire.
fields.items:spirit_salt#description: Coarse salt charged with purifying energy. Disrupts spirit possession and curses.
fields.items:stamina_tonic#description: A bracing brew that floods the body with energy. Restores stamina and delays fatigue.
fields.items:steel_bichawa#description: A tempered steel bichawa with a finely wrought scissor-guard. Deflects blows that would break ordinary parrying weapons.
fields.items:steel_chakram#description: A tempered steel chakram, edge-ground to lethal sharpness. Cuts through two targets in a single throw. Sacred to Vishnu — warriors of the god realm carry them as devotion made manifest.
fields.items:steel_dao#description: A heavy tempered steel dao. Its weight carries through armor that would turn a lesser blade.
fields.items:steel_katar#description: A finely made steel katar with a folded crossguard. In skilled hands, the direct thrust finds gaps no ordinary dagger could reach.
fields.items:steel_khanda#description: A tempered steel khanda, beautifully balanced. The standard by which other blades are judged.
fields.items:steel_kukri#description: A well-forged steel kukri. The forward curve concentrates force at the point of impact. Light enough to carry everywhere. Reliable enough to use on anything.
fields.items:steel_longsword#description: A tempered steel khanda, beautifully balanced. The standard by which other blades are judged.
fields.items:steel_patisa#description: A massive two-handed blade of tempered steel. Commanders carry it as a statement. Warriors carry it as a fact.
fields.items:steel_ring#description: A polished steel ring. Heavier than it looks and quietly sturdy.
fields.items:steel_talwar#description: A beautifully curved blade of tempered steel. In the right hands it is less a weapon than an argument made conclusively.
fields.items:steel_trishula#description: A tempered steel trishula, each prong razor-edged. The divine weapon in its martial form — when all three points connect, the target does not move again quickly.
fields.items:steel_urumi#description: A long flexible blade of tempered steel, worn coiled at the waist. From Kalaripayattu — wielded in flowing arcs that cover the entire body. Requires total commitment; striking all enemies within reach but at reduced precision.
fields.items:storied_alchemists_kit#description: A folding brass frame, three retorts, and a burner that has scorched every table it ever sat on. Smells of sulphur through the case.
fields.items:storied_lute#description: Pear-bellied, gut-strung, never quite in tune in cold weather. A crowd that is listening is a crowd that is not deciding anything else.
fields.items:storied_medicine_bag#description: Needles, catgut, tincture bottles and a bone saw, rolled in waxed cloth. Heavy at the shoulder. Heavier when it is needed and not there.
fields.items:storied_merchants_scales#descripti: Brass pans on a folding beam, with a set of true weights and a set of the other kind. Which is which depends on the day.
fields.items:storied_quartermasters_ledger#desc: Every ration, every arrow, every mile, in a hand so small it needs holding to the light. An army eats before it fights.
fields.items:storied_smiths_hammer#description: Two pounds of forged steel on a hickory haft, the face polished mirror-bright by work. Not made as a weapon. Perfectly willing.
fields.items:storied_thieving_tools#description: Picks, tension wrenches, a mirror on a wire, a strip of shim brass. Rolls up small. Explains poorly.
fields.items:storied_war_standard#description: A pole, a crosspiece, and a rag that has been somewhere. Men who cannot hear an order can see this.
fields.items:summoning_charm_common#description: A clay figurine of a spirit deer. Reduces the mana cost of your next Summoning spell.
fields.items:summoning_charm_middling#descripti: A doll depicting a guardian deity, filled with herbs and paper talismans.
fields.items:summoning_charm_rare#description: A binding coin from a great chieftain's burial mound.
fields.items:summoning_charm_unique#description: A small scroll of otherworldly writing on sky-blue silk, bound in a dakini's hair.
fields.items:swarna_bhasma#description: Gold calcined through a hundred purifications. Rasayana medicine's most radiant offering.
fields.items:throwing_knife#description: A balanced knife designed for throwing.
fields.items:thukpa#description: Hand-pulled noodles in dark broth. A full bowl, still warm.
fields.items:thunder_bomb#description: A concussive blast that stuns those caught in the detonation.
fields.items:tinmo#description: Steamed spiral bread fresh off the pot. Dense and satisfying.
fields.items:travel_cape#description: Worn and practical. Keeps the wind off and the dust out. The fringe tells the story of every road.
fields.items:travel_provisions#description: Prepared trail food for the road — cooked grain, dried fruit, cured meat.
fields.items:travelers_amulet#description: A simple amulet blessed for safe travels.
fields.items:travelers_boots#description: Light boots made for long journeys.
fields.items:triphala#description: The three fruits — amalaki, haritaki, bibhitaki — pressed into a single cake. A complete remedy.
fields.items:tsampa#description: Roasted barley flour pressed into travel cakes. Staple of every Tibetan journey.
fields.items:tulsi#description: Holy basil, sacred to Vishnu. Purifies breath and blood. Grows even near the passes.
fields.items:turnip#description: Hardy root vegetable. Unpleasant raw, edible cooked, reliable everywhere.
fields.items:vajra_dao#description: A heavy single-edge blade of indestructible vajra-metal. Armor is, philosophically speaking, irrelevant.
fields.items:vajra_khanda#description: A straight blade of vajra-metal, the divine indestructible substance. It will not dull. It will not break. It simply continues.
fields.items:vajra_patisa#description: A two-handed blade of divine vajra-metal. It weighs less than a steel sword half its size. The universe, apparently, wants it swung.
fields.items:vajra_talwar#description: A curved vajra blade. In the right hands it is faster than thought — which, in Buddhist philosophy, is saying something.
fields.items:vajra_thunderbolt#description: A diamond sceptre crackling with divine lightning. Symbol of indestructible truth.
fields.items:void_grenade#description: Compressed extraplanar energy. On detonation, creates a spatial rift that disrupts all magic in the area.
fields.items:void_oil#description: Distilled from extraplanar essence. Strikes from a voided blade silence spellcasters.
fields.items:warding_oil#description: A shimmering oil that grants weapons the ability to pierce magical defenses. Next 3 attacks bypass magic resistance.
fields.items:water_charm_common#description: A phial of dew gathered on the first morning of the year. Reduces the mana cost of your next Water spell.
fields.items:water_charm_middling#description: A chip of glacial ice that never melts.
fields.items:water_charm_rare#description: A pearl formed in cold mountain springs, so clear it is almost translucent.
fields.items:water_charm_unique#description: A drop of water from the primordial ocean sealed in amber.
fields.items:whetstone_oil#description: Hones a blade to razor sharpness. Next 3 attacks deal bonus damage with improved criticals.
fields.items:white_charm_common#description: A blessed prayer bead. Reduces the mana cost of your next White magic spell.
fields.items:white_charm_middling#description: A consecrated prayer bead fashioned from a sacred tree.
fields.items:white_charm_rare#description: A pill of herbs, incense ashes and rare charms, empowered in a long ceremony.
fields.items:white_charm_unique#description: A pearl found among the cremation ashes of a liberated practitioner.
fields.items:wild_apple#description: Small, tart Himalayan apples. How they grow here is unclear.
fields.items:wooden_shield#description: A round wooden shield, basic protection.
fields.items:wooden_spear#description: A simple wooden spear with an iron tip.
fields.items:wooden_staff#description: A simple wooden staff, useful for walking and whacking.
fields.items:wool_cloak#description: Heavy wool, oiled against the rain. The kind of thing passed down rather than bought.
fields.items:yamas_ledger#description: The book of judgment, recording every deed. Whispers karmic secrets to its bearer.
fields.items:yoke_hardware#description: Iron fittings from a broken cart yoke — rings, bolts, and a chain length.
fields.perks:cross_perks:ambush_predator#desc: If you attack from stealth with a ranged weapon, the target cannot take reactions until their next turn. Allies attacking a target you revealed from stealth gain +10% accuracy for 1 turn.
fields.perks:cross_perks:arcane_archer#desc: Active (4 Stamina + spell mana cost). Imbue your next ranged attack with a known single-target spell. The arrow delivers the spell on hit, using your ranged accuracy instead of spell accuracy.
fields.perks:cross_perks:axe_and_board#desc: While wielding an axe and shield, your shield bash stuns for 1 extra turn and your axe attacks deal +10% damage against stunned targets. Shield is not required for axe damage bonus if target is already stunned.
fields.perks:cross_perks:battle_analyst#desc: +10% accuracy and +10% damage against enemy types you've previously defeated. After defeating 3+ of the same type, bonuses increase to +15%.
fields.perks:cross_perks:brawlers_grapple#desc: Active (5 Stamina). Grab an adjacent enemy. They cannot move or attack until they pass a Strength check (your Strength + Unarmed vs their Strength + 10). Your unarmed attacks against a grappled target have +30% accuracy and cannot be Dodged.
fields.perks:cross_perks:cat_burglar#desc: Lockpicking and trap disarming are completely silent. Can pickpocket enemies in combat (steal one consumable). +25% chance to evade traps that trigger.
fields.perks:cross_perks:curseblade#desc: Dagger attacks from stealth apply a random minor curse (Weakness, Blind, or Slow) for 2 turns. Dagger crits have a 30% chance to apply the same effect outside stealth.
fields.perks:cross_perks:dharma_warrior#desc: Defeating an enemy during mantra chanting grants +1 bonus mantra turn of progress. Non-lethal victories (enemies surrender at 1 HP instead of dying) grant +2 karma and +10% XP from the encounter.
fields.perks:cross_perks:dharma_warrior#flavor: The sword that spares cuts deeper.
fields.perks:cross_perks:diamond_body#desc: While unarmored, +25% resistance to all status effects. Immune to poison and disease. If you also have Iron Shirt Technique, its Armor bonus increases by 10%.
fields.perks:cross_perks:diamond_body#flavor: The body is the first temple.
fields.perks:cross_perks:dual_discipline#desc: Can dual-wield a sword and dagger. Off-hand dagger attacks deal 50% damage. Switching between any weapons is a free action.
fields.perks:cross_perks:elementalist#desc: Spells that target an enemy's elemental weakness deal +25% damage. You can identify elemental weaknesses without spending an action to scan.
fields.perks:cross_perks:elementalist#flavor: The universe speaks in five voices.
fields.perks:cross_perks:field_commander#desc: At the start of combat, all companions may reposition up to 2 tiles before the first turn. All companions gain +1 Movement for the first round.
fields.perks:cross_perks:field_workshop#desc: Can craft and repair during travel without stopping. Repair costs reduced by 50%.
fields.perks:cross_perks:flame_adept#desc: Fire damage +15%. Immune to fear and morale penalties. Leadership and Performance effect durations +1 turn.
fields.perks:cross_perks:flame_adept#flavor: Passion is not consumed — it is shared.
fields.perks:cross_perks:flame_fist#desc: Unarmed attacks deal bonus fire damage equal to 15% of your Spellpower. On crit, the target burns for 3 turns.
fields.perks:cross_perks:fools_courage#desc: Active (1 action). Tell a joke that restores 15% Stamina to all allies within earshot. Outside of combat, removes Fear and restores low morale.
fields.perks:cross_perks:fools_courage#flavor: "We're not going to die here. I haven't finished my bit."
fields.perks:cross_perks:frost_warden#desc: Your zone-of-control reaction attacks Slow enemies for 1 turn. While you did not move this turn, your spear's reach extends by 1 tile.
fields.perks:cross_perks:gentleman_thief#desc: Shops never report theft. Can "case" shops through conversation to reveal hidden inventory. Persuasion checks involving deception gain +20%.
fields.perks:cross_perks:gentleman_thief#flavor: It's only stealing if they notice.
fields.perks:cross_perks:healer_general#desc: Companions can use healing items on each other as a free action once per round (normally costs an action). Your Medicine bonuses apply to companion-administered healing at 50% effectiveness.
fields.perks:cross_perks:holy_smite#desc: Active (4 Stamina + 8 Mana). Channel divine energy into a weapon strike: +30% damage as Holy. Heals you for 25% of damage dealt. Double damage vs undead and demons.
fields.perks:cross_perks:inspiring_sermon#desc: Active (1 action, non-combat). Give a speech that grants all party members +10% to their next skill check and +5% damage for the next encounter. Stacks up to 2 times between rests.
fields.perks:cross_perks:karmic_insight#desc: You can sense the karma alignment of NPCs and enemies (hostile, neutral, virtuous). Dialogue options with karmic weight are highlighted. +15% XP from events resolved peacefully.
fields.perks:cross_perks:know_your_enemy#desc: Scanning an enemy costs 0 actions (normally 1). Scanned enemies take +10% damage from all party members. Enemy information persists between encounters.
fields.perks:cross_perks:living_library#desc: Knowledge-based dialogue options are always available regardless of party composition. Events that reward knowledge grant +20% XP.
fields.perks:cross_perks:master_enchanter#desc: Can permanently enchant one piece of equipment per rest. Adds a minor elemental bonus (+5% damage or +5% resistance of a chosen element). One enchantment per item.
fields.perks:cross_perks:metamagic#desc: Once per combat, modify a spell as you cast it. Choose one: double range, split between 2 targets (75% damage each), or convert its element to another you have at 3+.
fields.perks:cross_perks:mystic_healer#desc: Your single-target healing spells also apply a minor buff (Regen, +10% Armor, or +10% Dodge — chosen randomly) for 2 turns.
fields.perks:cross_perks:necromancer#desc: When an enemy dies, you may spend 10 Mana to raise it as an undead minion at 50% of its original stats. Maximum 2 undead active at once. Undead last until destroyed but cannot be healed.
fields.perks:cross_perks:one_mind_one_fist#desc: You can make unarmed attacks while chanting a mantra without breaking the chant. Landing an unarmed hit during a mantra accelerates progress by 1 turn.
fields.perks:cross_perks:phalanx_fighter#desc: While wielding a spear and shield, allies adjacent to you gain +15% Armor. Your spear reaction attacks also trigger when adjacent allies are targeted by melee attacks.
fields.perks:cross_perks:poisoner#desc: Weapon coatings last twice as long (double applications per dose). During events, you can poison food, drink, or supplies — targets are Weakened for their next encounter.
fields.perks:cross_perks:prepared_caster#desc: You can prepare 2 additional spells per rest. Mandala creation time reduced by 1 action.
fields.perks:cross_perks:saboteur#desc: Can create trapped objects that deal damage and apply a status effect when enemies interact with them. During events, can sabotage enemy equipment — reducing their Attack or Armor by 15% for the next encounter.
fields.perks:cross_perks:sacred_authority#desc: Area-of-effect healing spells gain +25% effectiveness. When you heal an ally, they gain +10% damage on their next attack.
fields.perks:cross_perks:sentinel#desc: Reaction. When an enemy leaves your melee range (1 tile), make a free attack against them (sword or unarmed).
fields.perks:cross_perks:shadow_strike#desc: Attacks from stealth deal +50% damage and Silence the target for 1 turn. After attacking from stealth, 30% chance to immediately re-enter stealth if no enemies are adjacent.
fields.perks:cross_perks:skirmisher#desc: Ranged attacks suffer no accuracy penalty when made after moving. You can disengage as a free action once per turn.
fields.perks:cross_perks:spellblade#desc: When you cast a self-targeting enchantment, your sword gains bonus elemental damage equal to 20% of your Spellpower for the buff's duration. Element matches the enchantment's school.
fields.perks:cross_perks:spellblade#flavor: The blade remembers what the hand commands.
fields.perks:cross_perks:stone_adept#desc: +10% max HP. +10% Armor. Crafted items are one quality tier higher. Immune to knockback and forced movement.
fields.perks:cross_perks:stone_covenant#desc: Defensive enchantments (Stone Skin, etc.) gain +2 turns duration and provide knockback immunity. You may maintain one additional concentration enchantment beyond the normal limit.
fields.perks:cross_perks:storm_summoner#desc: Your summons gain a lightning aura: enemies ending their turn adjacent to a summon take air damage equal to 10% of your Spellpower.
fields.perks:cross_perks:supply_chain#desc: Shops restock 50% faster. Bulk purchases (3+ of the same item) receive a 15% discount.
fields.perks:cross_perks:tactical_adaptation#de: After the first round of combat, you identify the enemy composition. All companions gain +5% accuracy and +5% Dodge for the remainder of the battle.
fields.perks:cross_perks:the_golden_word#desc: Unlock exclusive shop tiers with rare items. Can hire elite mercenaries unavailable to others. +10% to both buy and sell prices on top of Trade bonuses.
fields.perks:cross_perks:theoretical_breakthrou: Once per rest, cast a spell one level above your current ability from a school you have at 4+. The spell costs double mana.
fields.perks:cross_perks:thunder_breaker#desc: Stun effects you inflict also Silence the target for 1 turn. Mace attacks against Silenced enemies deal +15% damage.
fields.perks:cross_perks:tide_adept#desc: All healing effects +15% (given and received). +20% resistance to water and ice damage. Can breathe underwater (event use).
fields.perks:cross_perks:void_adept#desc: Space magic mana costs reduced by 15% (multiplicative). +10% to all Space-element skill checks. Once per rest, cast your next Space spell as a free action (no action cost).
fields.perks:cross_perks:void_adept#flavor: You have touched the emptiness between things.
fields.perks:cross_perks:void_necromancy#desc: Your curses cannot be dispelled by normal means (requires a dispel of equal or higher level). Debuffs you inflict last 1 extra turn.
fields.perks:cross_perks:walking_meditation#des: Movement does not break concentration or mantra chanting. +2 Movement while chanting a mantra.
fields.perks:cross_perks:war_chant#desc: Bardic performances affect all allies regardless of range (normally area-limited). Performance buffs last 1 extra turn.
