fields.perks:cross_perks:weapon_master#desc: +10% damage with all weapons. Switching weapons is a free action. +1 action on the first turn of combat.
fields.perks:cross_perks:wind_adept#desc: +1 permanent Movement Speed. Air damage +15%. Immune to Slow effects.
fields.perks:cross_perks:wind_adept#flavor: The wind does not ask permission.
fields.perks:cross_perks:witch_doctor#desc: Potions you brew or administer heal 50% more. After combat, you can brew one basic medicine from enemy loot at no material cost.
fields.perks:cross_perks:witch_doctor#flavor: Nothing is wasted when you know what to look for.
fields.perks:skill_perks:absolute_presence#desc: Active (once per combat). All your currently active buffs are applied to all allies at full strength for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:against_all_expectatio: If you roll a natural 1-2 on a d20, 25% chance to convert it into a natural 20.
fields.perks:skill_perks:aim_at_the_vitals#desc: Passive. Dagger attacks against enemies that are suffering any status effect gain +10% crit chance.
fields.perks:skill_perks:aim_at_the_vitals#flav: An open wound is an invitation.
fields.perks:skill_perks:aimed_shot#desc: Active (4 Stamina). Gain +25% accuracy and +20% damage on your next ranged attack this turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:akimbo#desc: Passive. All secondary arm attack chances in the multi-arm chain are increased by +20% (e.g. off-hand chance 50%→70% at Finesse 10).
fields.perks:skill_perks:all_in#desc: When below 50% HP, axe attacks deal +25% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:all_the_world_a_stage#: As long as at least one enemy or neutral observer is present: - Allies gain 3% morale regeneration per turn - Enemies suffer 3% morale decay per turn - Social and mental effects by the performer cannot critically fail
fields.perks:skill_perks:alpha_and_omega#desc: When you have 3+ summons active, all summons gain +10% to all stats per summon beyond the second.
fields.perks:skill_perks:amplified_misfortune#d: Debuff spells gain a 1-tile AoE around the primary target.
fields.perks:skill_perks:anatomy_knowledge#desc: +10% damage against biological enemies (does not apply to constructs, elementals, or undead).
fields.perks:skill_perks:apex_predator#desc: Your strongest active summon (highest base stats) gains +30% to all stats.
fields.perks:skill_perks:applied_toxicology#des: Can craft weapon coatings: poison (DoT), paralysis (chance to stun), weakening (-10% Attack). Coatings last for 3 hits.
fields.perks:skill_perks:appraiser#desc: Identify magical properties of items without using scrolls or spells. Reveal hidden enchantments on equipment.
fields.perks:skill_perks:appraisers_eye#desc: Identify the value of items at a glance. Detect hidden compartments in containers (20% chance to find bonus loot).
fields.perks:skill_perks:apprentice_smith#desc: Can craft basic weapons and armor from common materials.
fields.perks:skill_perks:armor_of_faith#desc: Gain bonus Armor equal to 10% of your highest elemental affinity total.
fields.perks:skill_perks:armor_specialist#desc: Crafted armor gains +10% Armor and -10% Movement penalty.
fields.perks:skill_perks:armored_skin#desc: When wearing heavy armor, gain +10% resistance to all elemental damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:ashes_remember_heat#de: Enemies killed while burning leave behind a burning terrain effect (2 fire damage/turn for 3 turns) on their tile.
fields.perks:skill_perks:ask_the_right_question: +10% to social checks in dialogue involving knowledge, lore, or investigation.
fields.perks:skill_perks:attune_charm#desc: Active. Consume a charm to empower the next spell from its school: +20% Spellpower, +1 turn duration, or +10% accuracy.
fields.perks:skill_perks:aura_of_peace#desc: Passive. Enemies entering a 2-tile radius around the caster, and every 3rd turn thereafter, must pass a Focus save or become Pacified for 2 turns. Each enemy can only be affected by this aura once per combat.
fields.perks:skill_perks:avatar_of_the_storm#de: Aura. All allies' attacks deal +5% bonus Air damage and gain a 10% chance to Stun for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:avatar_of_the_wind#des: Aura. At the start of your turn, all other allies gain +1 Movement, +2 Initiative, and +5% Dodge for 1 round.
fields.perks:skill_perks:backstab#desc: Attacks from behind gain +20% crit chance and +50% crit damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:bare_chest#desc: +25% resistance to fear and pain effects while unarmored or in light armor.
fields.perks:skill_perks:bark_orders#desc: Active (1 action). Grant one ally +1 Movement and +10% accuracy until end of their next turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:battle_doctrine#desc: Before combat, choose a doctrine: - **Aggressive:** +10% Damage, +3 Initiative - **Defensive:** +10% all resistances, +15% healing received - **Adaptive:** +5% to all stats, allies gain +2 Initiative whenever an enemy is defeated
fields.perks:skill_perks:bedrock#desc: Passive. You and allies standing on earth or stone terrain gain +5% Armor and +5% resistance to forced movement.
fields.perks:skill_perks:between_the_ribs#desc: Dagger attacks ignore 25% of target's Armor.
fields.perks:skill_perks:black_ice#desc: Active (6 Mana). Create ice terrain in a 2-tile radius for 3 turns. Enemies moving through it must pass a Finesse save or fall prone. Allies are unaffected.
fields.perks:skill_perks:black_market_contacts#: Access a special merchant with rare and restricted items. Buying and selling prices are 15% better than normal merchants.
fields.perks:skill_perks:blazing_mind#desc: Charmed or berserk enemies gain 30% Fire vulnerability.
fields.perks:skill_perks:blend_in#desc: You can enter stealth in combat (costs 1 action) and attempt stealth-based decisions in dialogue.
fields.perks:skill_perks:blink_reflex#desc: Instant movement spells (blink, short teleport) gain +2 tiles range.
fields.perks:skill_perks:blood_in_the_wind#desc: +1 Movement and +10% Dodge when any enemy within line of sight is bleeding or poisoned.
fields.perks:skill_perks:body_blow#desc: Active (3 Stamina). A heavy strike that knocks an enemy prone for 1 turn (Constitution save negates).
fields.perks:skill_perks:bomb_maker#desc: Can craft basic grenades (fire, acid, smoke) from common materials.
fields.perks:skill_perks:bone_breaker#desc: Enemies who fail a stun save from your mace attacks also suffer -1 Movement for 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:booster_shot#desc: Active (4 Stamina). Grant an ally +25% resistance to the next status effect applied to them (lasts until triggered or 3 turns).
fields.perks:skill_perks:borrowed_force#desc: Passive trigger. When you Dodge a melee attack, your next attack gains +30% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:borrowed_opening#desc: Passive. When an enemy's melee attack misses you, your next unarmed attack gains +20% crit chance.
fields.perks:skill_perks:borrowed_opening#flavo: You learn the shape of the miss.
fields.perks:skill_perks:brace_for_impact#desc: Active (free action, 3-turn cooldown). Until your next turn, reduce the next incoming hit by 30%.
fields.perks:skill_perks:break_through#desc: Active (4 Stamina). Move through enemy-occupied tiles this turn, pushing enemies 1 tile to the side.
fields.perks:skill_perks:breaking_point#desc: Passive. Axe attacks that deal more than 30% of target max HP in one hit reduce the target's armor by 15% for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:breath_control#desc: Regenerate 5% of max Stamina per turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:breath_easy#desc: Active (once per combat, 12 Mana). For 1 turn, all allies take 90% reduced damage and are immune to status effects.
fields.perks:skill_perks:bulk_discount#desc: When buying 3+ items from a merchant, gain an additional 10% discount.
fields.perks:skill_perks:burn_away_impurity#des: Cleansing spells also reduce the target's worst karma realm by a small amount (hidden). The impurity of the world is slightly lifted.
fields.perks:skill_perks:burn_the_breath#desc: Active. The next spell gains +100% Spellpower, but you take damage equal to 25% of the mana cost as HP loss. (Additive with other overcast effects.)
fields.perks:skill_perks:burning_blood#desc: Taking damage from a ranged attack grants +50% Movement for 1 turn (non-stackable).
fields.perks:skill_perks:calculated_intensity#d: Passive. Casting a spell without moving that turn grants +8% spellpower to the next spell this turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:call_the_shot#desc: Active (free action, once per turn). Mark an enemy. The first ally to attack that enemy gains +15% accuracy and +15% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:carry_the_world#desc: +30% weight limit and halve penalties from heavy equipment.
fields.perks:skill_perks:cascading_effect#desc: Passive. If a spell hits 2 or more targets in one cast, each additional target beyond the first takes +10% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:cascading_effect#flavo: The resonance spreads across the web of causation.
fields.perks:skill_perks:cats_landing#desc: Fall damage reduced by 50%. When jumping down from height, gain +10% accuracy and +10% damage on your next attack.
fields.perks:skill_perks:centered_stance#desc: Passive. +10% Initiative and +15% resistance to mental effects while wielding a sword.
fields.perks:skill_perks:chain_of_command#desc: Leadership buffs jump to a second nearby ally at 50% strength.
fields.perks:skill_perks:chain_reaction#desc: When a grenade kills an enemy, 30% chance to trigger a secondary explosion at the same location for 50% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:chain_spark#desc: Lightning spells have a 30% chance to chain to 1 additional target within 2 tiles for 50% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:chains_of_suffering#de: Enemies currently affected by any debuff take +15% damage from Black spells.
fields.perks:skill_perks:cheap_shot#desc: Your first attack against each enemy in a combat gains +15% crit chance.
fields.perks:skill_perks:choking_heat#desc: Enemies inside smoke suffer -15% Attack and -10% Dodge.
fields.perks:skill_perks:chorus_of_birds#desc: All Air spells have a 20% chance to summon a Songbird (1 HP, high Dodge, non-attacking). Each turn, a Songbird sings, granting a random buff to one nearby ally: +3 Initiative, +1 Movement, +5% Dodge, or +5% Armor. Lasts 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:circle_of_embers#desc: Fire enchantments affect all allies or all enemies in line of sight (chosen at cast time).
fields.perks:skill_perks:clean_line#desc: +10% crit chance against enemies not adjacent to any ally.
fields.perks:skill_perks:clear_light#desc: Passive. White spells you cast cannot be interrupted by damage on the turn they are cast. Any damage taken that turn resolves after the spell completes.
fields.perks:skill_perks:clear_light#flavor: The light does not wait to be asked.
fields.perks:skill_perks:cleave#desc: When you kill an enemy with an axe, immediately make a free attack against another adjacent enemy.
fields.perks:skill_perks:close_and_personal#des: +15% Attack and +15% Damage when adjacent to exactly one enemy.
fields.perks:skill_perks:cloud_step#desc: Active (3 Stamina). Move through enemies and difficult terrain this turn without penalty.
fields.perks:skill_perks:combat_surgeon#desc: Field Medic becomes a free action once per turn (additional uses still cost an action).
fields.perks:skill_perks:comic_relief#desc: 20% chance to convert a critical hit against an ally within 3 tiles into a normal hit.
fields.perks:skill_perks:comic_timing#desc: 15% chance to distract an enemy attempting a melee attack against you, cancelling the attack. The enemy wastes their action.
fields.perks:skill_perks:command_presence#desc: All allies in line of sight gain passive bonuses: +5% accuracy, +5% resistance, and +5% morale. Each additional ally in line of sight adds +1% to all bonuses.
fields.perks:skill_perks:command_the_narrative#: Once per major dialogue, automatically succeed on a Performance-gated blue check.
fields.perks:skill_perks:commitment#desc: If you did not move before attacking, gain +20% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:compelling_proposal#de: Active. Attempt to control an enemy for 1 turn (Focus save negates). Costs 1 action.
fields.perks:skill_perks:concussive_force#desc: Mace hits have a 20% chance to apply Dazed (-10% accuracy, -10% Dodge) for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:conduit_of_rudra#desc: All allies' attacks deal an additional 5% of weapon damage as Air damage and have a 10% chance to stun for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:conduit_of_rudra#flavo: The roar of Rudra passes through the warrior's hands.
fields.perks:skill_perks:conduit_of_vayu#desc: All allies gain +1 Movement, +2 Initiative, and +5% Dodge passively while you are in combat.
fields.perks:skill_perks:conduit_of_vayu#flavor: Vayu moves through the one who has learned to stop resisting.
fields.perks:skill_perks:continuous_recitation#: Casting spells does not interrupt active mantras.
fields.perks:skill_perks:coordinated_assault#de: When you attack an enemy, all your summons gain +15% damage against that enemy until your next turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:coordinated_strikes#de: Passive (multi-arm species only). If an arm in the attack chain kills its target, reset the chain — the next arm rolls independently rather than stopping.
fields.perks:skill_perks:coordinated_strikes#fl: The body learns to celebrate without pausing.
fields.perks:skill_perks:cosmic_banana_peel#des: Enemies have a 10% chance each turn to suffer a random mishap: miss next attack, stumble (-1 Movement), or self-debuff (-5% Armor for 1 turn).
fields.perks:skill_perks:counterstrike#desc: Active (6 Stamina, 3-turn cooldown). Until your next turn, each melee attack against you triggers a counterattack (once per attacker per round).
fields.perks:skill_perks:crack_the_line#desc: Enemies hit by axe critical hits must pass a Focus save or become Feared for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:creeping_cold#desc: Ice spells that deal damage also apply -1 Movement for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:critical_combustion#de: Passive. Fire spell crits cause the target to take double Burning damage on their next turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:critical_combustion#fl: We offer this world of grass to the hungry mouth of Agni!
fields.perks:skill_perks:crossdisciplinary_insi: Active (6 Mana, 3-turn duration). Grant an ally +2 to one of the caster's trained skills (caster must have at least 3 in that skill).
fields.perks:skill_perks:crowd_influence#desc: Active (once per combat). All allies gain +3 Initiative and +10% Armor. All enemies in line of sight who fail a Focus save suffer -3 Initiative and -10% Armor for 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:crowded_mind#desc: Enemies affected by illusion effects suffer -20% resistance to mental status effects for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:crumbling_avalanche#de: Active. Destroy one of your stone walls. All enemies within 2 tiles take Earth damage (50% Spellpower) and are knocked prone (Constitution save negates knockdown).
fields.perks:skill_perks:crushing_depths#desc: Enemies standing on water or ice terrain, or affected by 2+ Water debuffs, suffer -15% to all saves.
fields.perks:skill_perks:crushing_gravity#desc: Enemies in a Gravity Well also take 10% Spellpower as Earth damage per turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:crystalline_edge#desc: Earth damage spells have a 20% chance to apply Brittle (-15% Armor) for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:cutting_remark#desc: Active (1 action). Inflict -10% morale and -10% accuracy on a visible enemy for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:cyclone_mastery#desc: Push effects are 50% stronger (push 1 extra tile) and knockdown chance increases to 40%.
fields.perks:skill_perks:dabbler#desc: Unlock all level 1 spells from every school.
fields.perks:skill_perks:damage_control#desc: When you take damage, reduce it by an additional flat amount equal to 10% of your max HP.
fields.perks:skill_perks:dance_of_the_river#des: Active (once per combat, 6 Stamina). For 1 turn, all attacks against you suffer -30% accuracy and you may move freely between your actions (total movement equal to 2x your Movement).
fields.perks:skill_perks:deceptive_reach#desc: Illusion spells that target a single entity gain a 1-tile AoE around the target.
fields.perks:skill_perks:deep_freeze#desc: Enemies whose Movement is reduced to 0 by ice effects become Frozen (incapacitated) for 1 turn (no save).
fields.perks:skill_perks:deep_roots#desc: Buffs you cast are 25% harder to dispel or overwrite.
fields.perks:skill_perks:deflection#desc: 15% chance to completely block an incoming attack (reduce damage to 0). Requires a shield.
fields.perks:skill_perks:derealization#desc: Passive. Space magic debuffs applied to enemies reduce their Initiative by 2 for the duration.
fields.perks:skill_perks:derealization#flavor: What confuses the mind slows the body.
fields.perks:skill_perks:diagnosis#desc: Active (free action). Examine an ally to reveal all active status effects and their remaining durations. Examining an enemy reveals their HP and any vulnerabilities.
fields.perks:skill_perks:diamond_nail_mantra#de: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, enemies suffer stacking -1 Movement, -10% teleport success, and -5% Dodge (stacks up to 5 times). Deity Yoga — Pierce the Obstructors: All enemies in a 4-tile radius take major Space damage (50% Spellpower) each turn in addition to the movement penalties.
fields.perks:skill_perks:disarming_humor#desc: Before some combat encounters, a Comedy check may cancel the fight entirely (Charm + Comedy vs encounter difficulty).
fields.perks:skill_perks:disciplined_formation#: While adjacent to an ally, gain +10% Attack and +10% Armor.
fields.perks:skill_perks:disrupting_palm#desc: Active (4 Stamina). Make an unarmed or light-weapon attack. On hit, choose one: -15% Armor, -15% Focus, or -3 Initiative for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:diversified_portfolio#: Maintain up to 3 investments simultaneously. Returns increased to 200%.
fields.perks:skill_perks:dont_lose_the_momentum: Passive. While you successfully parried last turn, sword attacks cost 1 less Stamina and your Parry threshold is treated as 5% higher.
The guard doesn't lower until it's decided to.
fields.perks:skill_perks:dooming_presence#desc: Debuff spells target all enemies in line of sight.
fields.perks:skill_perks:drowning_pressure#desc: Active (once per combat, 15 Mana). All enemies in a 3-tile radius take crushing Water damage (75% Spellpower) and are Silenced for 2 turns (Focus save negates silence, damage still applies).
fields.perks:skill_perks:dual_aspect#desc: Buffs that affect a single stat also grant a +5% bonus to a related stat (Armor buff also grants Dodge; Attack buff also grants Initiative; etc.).
fields.perks:skill_perks:earthquake#desc: Ground Slam affects a 2-tile radius and creates difficult terrain for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:efficient_salvage#desc: Recover 75% of material value and gain a 20% chance to extract a rare component.
fields.perks:skill_perks:elemental_infusion#des: When casting a summoning spell, choose an element. The summon gains +20% damage of that element and +15% resistance to that element.
fields.perks:skill_perks:emergency_flask#desc: Once per combat, use a potion as a free action (instead of costing an action).
fields.perks:skill_perks:empty_center#desc: Passive. +20% resistance to mental effects. +25% to saving throws against forced movement, stuns, and knockdowns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:empty_hand_full_world#: Passive. While carrying no weapon in either hand, gain +1 action per turn, and unarmed strikes count as magical for resistance purposes.
Nothing in the hands. Nothing needed in them.
fields.perks:skill_perks:every_opening_is_an_in: +15% Attack and +10% crit chance against enemies suffering from any status effect.
fields.perks:skill_perks:everyone_is_somewhere_: Active (20 Mana, once per combat). A teleport spell affects all allies _or_ all enemies in line of sight.
fields.perks:skill_perks:everything_is_carried_: Passive. Theft and lockpicking attempts cannot critically fail. Once per location, you may take one item you could not otherwise afford or reach, and nobody notices it is gone until you are elsewhere.
It was not nailed down. Very few things are, on inspection.
fields.perks:skill_perks:experimental_batch#des: When crafting, 20% chance to create an enhanced version with a random bonus effect (extra healing, longer duration, splash radius, etc.).
fields.perks:skill_perks:exposed_target#desc: Ranged critical hits apply -15% Dodge for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:extended_binding#desc: Single-target binding effects gain a 1-tile AoE.
fields.perks:skill_perks:extended_march#desc: Party can take one additional overworld action per day before fatigue penalties apply.
fields.perks:skill_perks:fear_is_the_mindkiller: When you land a Black debuff on an enemy already carrying 2+ debuffs, they must save or become Feared (once per enemy per combat).
The mind consumes itself long before the body fails.
fields.perks:skill_perks:feed_the_fire#desc: Enemies suffering from Burning take +20% damage from Fire spells.
fields.perks:skill_perks:fence#desc: Sell stolen goods at full price instead of the usual penalty. Black market merchant restocks more frequently.
fields.perks:skill_perks:field_kitchen#desc: Food items provide +10% bonus to their effects (healing, stat buffs, morale).
fields.perks:skill_perks:field_medic#desc: Active (1 action). Heal an adjacent ally for 25% of your Awareness as HP.
fields.perks:skill_perks:field_repair#desc: Active (1 action in combat, 3-turn cooldown). Restore 25% of an ally's Armor value, countering sunder effects.
fields.perks:skill_perks:field_surgeon#desc: Using a medicine item in combat triggers a Medicine skill check (d20 + Medicine vs DC 14). On success, one wound on the user is treated.
fields.perks:skill_perks:final_cut#desc: Active (8 Stamina). A precise strike that ignores 50% of Armor and 50% of Resistances. If it kills the target, refund 4 Stamina.
fields.perks:skill_perks:final_cut#flavor: Conflict ends when the line is drawn cleanly.
fields.perks:skill_perks:find_the_beat#desc: Inspired allies have their critical failure range reduced by 1 (nat 1 only instead of nat 1-2).
fields.perks:skill_perks:find_the_gap#desc: Passive. If an axe attack misses, the next axe attack this turn gains +25% accuracy.
fields.perks:skill_perks:find_the_gap#flavor: Study the misses no less than the hits.
fields.perks:skill_perks:fire_sees_through_smok: Your Fire spells ignore line-of-sight penalties caused by smoke.
fields.perks:skill_perks:first_impression#desc: Passive. The first dialogue check of each encounter automatically succeeds regardless of the roll. (Once per dialogue.)
fields.perks:skill_perks:first_impression#flavo: How you enter the room is half the conversation.
fields.perks:skill_perks:first_to_strike#desc: When an enemy enters your reach (2 tiles), make a free reaction attack (once per enemy per round).
fields.perks:skill_perks:flowing_evasion#desc: After successfully dodging an attack, gain +10% Dodge until end of turn (stacks up to 3 times).
fields.perks:skill_perks:flowing_footwork#desc: Passive. +1 Movement and +10% Dodge while unarmored or in light armor.
fields.perks:skill_perks:flowing_footwork#flavo: The fight begins with how you stand.
fields.perks:skill_perks:flowing_tide#desc: After killing an enemy, gain +2 Movement and may immediately reposition up to 2 tiles (free action).
fields.perks:skill_perks:focused_diagram#desc: Casting a spell inside a ritual circle grants +25% Spellpower.
fields.perks:skill_perks:fog_of_war#desc: Active (5 Mana). Create a fog bank in a 2-tile radius. Enemies inside suffer -20% accuracy. Ranged attacks and targeted spells cannot pass through fog. Lasts 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:follow_through#desc: If a mace attack reduces an enemy below 50% HP, immediately make a free attack against the same or an adjacent enemy at -25% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:forage#desc: Active (overworld). Search the current area for supplies. Yield depends on terrain: food in forests, herbs in meadows, minerals in mountains.
fields.perks:skill_perks:forced_translation#des: Teleport spells may now target enemies (Focus save to resist). On success, enemies are displaced to a random adjacent tile rather than freely placed.
fields.perks:skill_perks:formation_discipline#d: Adjacent allies gain +5% Armor and +5% resistance. Bonus increases by +2% per additional adjacent ally.
fields.perks:skill_perks:fortified#desc: +15% Armor when wearing a complete set (head, chest, and legs all equipped).
fields.perks:skill_perks:fortify_position#desc: Allies adjacent to your stone walls gain +10% Armor and +10% resistance to ranged attacks.
fields.perks:skill_perks:fortune_favors#desc: Once per encounter, guarantee a rare drop from a defeated enemy.
fields.perks:skill_perks:found_the_rhythm#desc: Passive. Against enemies you have already hit once this combat, sword accuracy is treated as 10% higher.
fields.perks:skill_perks:found_the_rhythm#flavo: Familiarity is already half the fight.
fields.perks:skill_perks:fractured_perception#d: Illusion spells that already affect an AoE now affect all enemies in line of sight.
fields.perks:skill_perks:fullbody_strike#desc: Active (5 Stamina). Double the Strength bonus on your next melee attack.
fields.perks:skill_perks:gadgeteer#desc: Grenades and oils are 50% more effective (damage, duration, and area).
fields.perks:skill_perks:generous_spirit#desc: Single-target buffs can be split between 2 targets at 75% effectiveness each.
fields.perks:skill_perks:gentle_removal#desc: Cleansing spells also heal the target for 20% of the caster's Spellpower.
fields.perks:skill_perks:golden_tongue#desc: Once per settlement, recruit one mercenary for free.
fields.perks:skill_perks:golden_wheel_mantra#de: Ongoing effect (line of sight): Each turn, enemies who attacked last turn suffer stacking -5% Attack and -5% Damage (stacks up to 5 times). Deity Yoga — Turning the Law: - Enemies who attack take 30% of their dealt damage as reflected White damage - Allies gain +20% Attack against enemies affected by the Wheel - Status effects applied by allies cannot be resisted for 1 round
fields.perks:skill_perks:gone_before_the_body_f: Killing an enemy with a dagger attack grants a free action (move or re-enter stealth).
fields.perks:skill_perks:good_with_a_crowd#desc: +10% to social rolls when 2+ NPCs are present.
fields.perks:skill_perks:grand_working#desc: Active (must be in a ritual circle, 1 full turn of preparation). The next spell gains +100% Spellpower (additive with other overcast effects).
fields.perks:skill_perks:gravity_well#desc: Active (8 Mana). Create a 2-tile radius zone for 3 turns. Enemies inside suffer -2 Movement and -15% Dodge.
fields.perks:skill_perks:ground_slam#desc: Active (5 Stamina). Strike the ground, dealing 60% damage to all enemies within 1 tile. Enemies must pass a Finesse save or be knocked prone.
fields.perks:skill_perks:grounded#desc: +15% Armor when you do not move before attacking.
fields.perks:skill_perks:guardian_instinct#desc: Summons within 2 tiles of you have a 25% chance to intercept attacks targeting you (redirecting the attack to themselves).
fields.perks:skill_perks:guided_practice#desc: Active (out of combat). Teach a known spell to another character who meets the basic school requirements.
fields.perks:skill_perks:gust_step#desc: Jump, Levitate, and Fly spells also grant +1 Movement and +2 Initiative for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:halftruth#desc: Failed dialogue checks involving lies or persuasion have 50% reduced negative consequences.
fields.perks:skill_perks:hands_already_moving#d: Using a consumable item is a free action once per turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:hands_like_iron#desc: Unarmed attacks count as magical for overcoming damage resistances.
fields.perks:skill_perks:hard_knuckles#desc: Unarmed attacks ignore 25% of target's Armor.
fields.perks:skill_perks:hardened#desc: Passive. When a critical hit would inflict a persistent wound, 50% chance the wound is negated entirely. Applies to every arm of a multi-arm attack.
fields.perks:skill_perks:headhunter#desc: Access to higher-quality mercenaries. Recruited companions start with 10% more XP.
fields.perks:skill_perks:heavenly_counterflow#d: Active (8 Stamina, once per combat). Until your next turn, the first melee attack against you is automatically Dodged, and you immediately reposition up to 2 tiles and counterattack with +30% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:heavy_armor_training#d: Reduce movement and dodge penalties from heavy armor by 50%.
fields.perks:skill_perks:heavy_swing#desc: Successful axe hits reduce the target's Armor by 5% until end of turn (stacks with multiple hits).
fields.perks:skill_perks:heckle#desc: Taunted or confused enemies suffer -15% Attack for the duration.
fields.perks:skill_perks:heckle_the_will#desc: Demoralized enemies have a 20% chance each turn to waste their action (hesitate, reposition poorly, or fumble).
fields.perks:skill_perks:hired_help#desc: Mercenary companions cost 15% less to recruit.
fields.perks:skill_perks:hit_back_harder#desc: After taking damage, your next melee attack deals +20% damage. Lasts until your next turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:hold_the_line#desc: Enemies have -25% success when attempting to push, knockback, or reposition you.
fields.perks:skill_perks:horde_master#desc: You may maintain 2 additional summons. Summoning spells cost 15% less mana.
fields.perks:skill_perks:host_of_the_faithful#d: Passive. You may maintain twice your normal number of summons. When a summon of yours dies, the next one you call this combat arrives with full HP and an extra action.
fields.perks:skill_perks:host_of_the_faithful#f: They come because they were asked properly, and they stay for the same reason.
fields.perks:skill_perks:host_of_the_winds#desc: Passive. Your active Air summons also provide +5% Dodge and +2 Initiative to allies within 2 tiles.
fields.perks:skill_perks:hot_blooded#desc: Fire summons gain +15% Attack and +1 Movement.
fields.perks:skill_perks:hungry_flames#desc: Burning enemies have a 25% chance per turn to spread Burning (1 stack) to enemies within 1 tile.
fields.perks:skill_perks:hunters_eye#desc: Passive. Ranged attacks against enemies with no adjacent allies deal +15% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:hunters_eye#flavor: Alone and exposed, just as I like it.
fields.perks:skill_perks:hurry_betrays_distract: At the start of combat, all allies begin with +5% Stamina and +5% Mana (from proper pre-battle preparation).
fields.perks:skill_perks:immovable_light_mantra: Ongoing effect: Each turn, the caster gains stacking +5% Armor, +5% all resistances, and immunity to forced movement (stacks up to 5 times). Deity Yoga — Pillar of the World: - The caster cannot drop below 1 HP - Allies within 3 tiles gain +30% all resistances - Area denial and corruption terrain effects are suppressed within 4 tiles
fields.perks:skill_perks:immune_system#desc: Allies within 2 tiles have a 15% passive chance each turn to shrug off poison, bleed, or disease effects.
fields.perks:skill_perks:impaling_strike#desc: Active (6 Stamina). Attack in a line, hitting up to 2 enemies. Full damage to the first, 60% to the second.
fields.perks:skill_perks:improved_parry#desc: Passive. 40% of your Attack is added to Armor. Parry applies against the first melee hit each round even if flanked.
fields.perks:skill_perks:improvised_barricade#d: Active (1 action). Create a 1-tile barricade at an adjacent position. Provides half cover (+15% Armor) for anyone behind it. Lasts 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:improvised_masterpiece: Active (1 action). Choose one: Inspire (allies gain +10% all stats), Demoralize (enemies suffer -10% all stats), or Distract (enemies suffer -15% accuracy). Affects all valid targets within 3 tiles for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:inner_focus#desc: Reduce the duration of all debuffs on you by 1 turn (minimum 1).
fields.perks:skill_perks:inscribed_circle#desc: Active (1 action). Create a ritual circle on your tile. While standing in it, -25% mana cost on all spells.
fields.perks:skill_perks:intimidating_force#des: Enemies adjacent to you suffer -3 Initiative and -10% Dodge.
fields.perks:skill_perks:intimidating_stance#de: Active. Stun enemies in a 2-tile radius who fail a Focus save for 1 turn. Also functions as a blue option in intimidation dialogue events.
fields.perks:skill_perks:investment#desc: Active (overworld). Invest gold in a settlement. Returns 150% of the invested amount after several in-game days.
fields.perks:skill_perks:iron_cortex#desc: Passive (multi-arm species and dual-wielders). Your second arm always fires in the multi-arm chain — no roll — so arms 1 and 2 always attack. Arms 3+ still roll their normal Finesse-based chance, and the chain still stops at the first arm that fails.
fields.perks:skill_perks:iron_shirt_technique#d: 30% of your Unarmed Attack value is added to your Armor while unarmored.
fields.perks:skill_perks:iron_shirt_training#de: Earth defensive spells (Stone Skin, Iron Will, etc.) gain +15% effectiveness.
fields.perks:skill_perks:it_was_a_joke#desc: Before engaging in combat, see all enemy stats. You may choose to avoid the fight entirely, keeping partial rewards (scouting info, a small item, XP equal to 25% of the encounter).
fields.perks:skill_perks:journeymans_touch#desc: Crafted items gain a random minor bonus (+5% to one stat).
fields.perks:skill_perks:juggernaut#desc: While at or above 50% HP, immune to slow, knockback, and forced movement from enemies.
fields.perks:skill_perks:keep_hitting#desc: Each consecutive unarmed hit increases damage by +10% (resets on miss or turn without attacking, cap: +50%). At maximum stacks, your next unarmed attack also stuns for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:kill_zone#desc: Active (7 Stamina). End your turn. Until your next turn, make a free ranged attack against each enemy that moves within your weapon range (max 3 attacks).
fields.perks:skill_perks:knife_storm#desc: Each successful dagger hit has a 25% chance to trigger one free extra attack (max 1 extra per turn).
fields.perks:skill_perks:know_the_market#desc: See the true value of all items. Overpriced items are highlighted in shops.
fields.perks:skill_perks:know_the_pattern#desc: After examining an enemy, all allies gain +10% Attack and +10% to saves against that enemy for the rest of combat.
fields.perks:skill_perks:know_the_symptoms#desc: After diagnosing an ally, gain +20% effectiveness when healing or curing that ally's conditions for the rest of combat.
fields.perks:skill_perks:lady_of_the_turquoise_: Ongoing effect: Each turn, the caster gains stacking +5% Dodge and +5% magic resistance (stacks up to 5 times). Deity Yoga — Hall of Reflections: All attacks and single-target spells targeting the caster have a 60% chance of reflecting fully to the attacker. Dodge bonuses are shared with allies within 3 tiles.
Lady of the Turquoise Mirror Mantra
fields.perks:skill_perks:last_man_standing#desc: While at or below 25% HP, gain +50% Armor and +25% to all saves. Cannot be killed by damage-over-time effects.
fields.perks:skill_perks:lasting_bond#desc: Summons last 2 additional turns before expiring.
fields.perks:skill_perks:laughing_at_the_abyss#: Immune to fear, despair, and intimidation effects. Allies within 2 tiles gain +25% resistance to these effects.
fields.perks:skill_perks:lay_of_the_land#desc: Scouting also reveals terrain types, enemy compositions, and optimal routes. Entering a scouted encounter grants +3 Initiative to the party for the first round.
fields.perks:skill_perks:layered_enchantments#d: You can maintain 1 additional concentration buff simultaneously.
fields.perks:skill_perks:layered_meaning#desc: Spells that apply a status effect gain a secondary rider (choose one at time of casting): -1 Movement, -10% to one resistance, or -2 Initiative for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:legendary_artisan#desc: Once per rest, craft an item of rare quality with a unique name and enhanced bonuses.
fields.perks:skill_perks:legion_tactics#desc: Black summons gain +3 Initiative and +10% Attack.
fields.perks:skill_perks:lessons_learned#desc: After a difficult encounter, the party gains a temporary buff for the next encounter based on what was fought: +10% damage resistance, +10% accuracy, or +10% to saves (whichever is most relevant).
fields.perks:skill_perks:lift_the_chorus#desc: When you apply an inspiration effect to one ally, allies within 2 tiles gain a 50%-strength version.
fields.perks:skill_perks:light_touch#desc: Can attempt to pickpocket NPCs in dialogue. Success based on Finesse + Thievery vs target's Awareness.
fields.perks:skill_perks:lingering_touch#desc: Buffs you cast last 1 additional turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:lingering_warmth#desc: Healing spells apply a regeneration effect: 15% of the spell's healing over 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:living_fortress#desc: While in heavy armor, immune to critical hits. All hits against you are treated as normal hits.
fields.perks:skill_perks:long_memory#desc: Reaction attacks (from First to Strike, Set for Charge, etc.) gain +15% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:look_at_me#desc: Active (1 action). For 2 turns, enemies within 3 tiles have +25% chance to target you.
fields.perks:skill_perks:lotus_refuge_mantra#de: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, allies gain stacking regeneration (+3% max HP/turn, stacks up to 5 times) and +10% resistance to fear and despair. Deity Yoga — Field of Refuge: - All allies automatically succeed morale and fear saves - 30% of incoming damage to allies is redirected to the caster - All healing effects are maximized (no variance, full value)
fields.perks:skill_perks:lucid_rest#desc: During any rest, quietly accumulates mantra at half your Yoga level (minimum 1). Does not require a Mantra Recitation activity slot.
fields.perks:skill_perks:lunge#desc: Active (4 Stamina). Leap up to 2 tiles toward an enemy and make a sword attack with +25% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:luxury_goods#desc: Access to a special tier of high-quality equipment at each merchant not normally available.
fields.perks:skill_perks:magnetism#desc: Active. Attempt to recruit an enemy. Target makes two Charm saves. Fail both: joins your party. Fail one: becomes Pacified for 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_interdepende: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, the caster and allies regain 2% max Mana (increases by 1%/turn, up to 5%). Deity Yoga — The Rainbow Web: All spell costs reduced by 50% and Spellpower increased by 50% for all allies.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_multiplying#: Ongoing effect: Each turn, the caster gains a stacking +5% Spellpower bonus (stacks up to 5 times). Deity Yoga — Bottomless Well: All spells are cast as if the caster has level 5 in the relevant skill. If they already do, +50% Spellpower.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_binding_: Ongoing effect (line of sight): Each turn, enemies suffer a random minor debuff (-5% to a random stat). Debuffs are stacking and persist until the mantra ends. Deity Yoga — Nothing Escapes the Word: All enemies suffer -25% to all stats. Debuffs on enemies cannot be cleansed. All enemy buffs are suppressed for the duration.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_blood_dr: Ongoing effect (line of sight): Enemies suffer stacking Black damage (5% Spellpower/turn, stacks up to 5 times). Damage dealt is reflected as healing to the caster and allies within 2 tiles. Deity Yoga — Wrathful Dance: - All damage dealt to enemies by any source is reflected as healing to allies in line of sight (50% of damage dealt) - Enemies suffer -20% Armor
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_earth_st: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, allies gain stacking +3% Armor and +3% physical damage resistance (stacks up to 5 times). The ground beneath allies becomes blessed, granting 2% max HP regeneration per turn. Deity Yoga — He Who Bears the Weight of All Worlds: All allies gain +40% Armor and immunity to all forced movement and knockdown. Enemies in contact with the ground take Earth damage (20% Spellpower) per turn. Allies cannot be reduced below 1 HP for the duration.
Mantra of the Earth Store Bodhisattva
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_four_gua: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, summon a minor spirit guardian (1 HP, high Dodge, non-attacking). Each guardian provides +3% Armor to the nearest ally. Up to 4 spirit guardians can exist simultaneously. Deity Yoga — The Four Walls of Heaven: Summon 4 powerful Guardian Kings at the cardinal points around the caster. Each has high HP, high Armor, moderate damage, and provides +10% Armor and +10% resistance to one element (one per King) for all allies within 3 tiles. They last until destroyed.
Mantra of the Four Guardian Kings
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_great_bl: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, enemies suffer stacking -5% Armor and -5% resistance, and lose 3% of max Stamina and Mana (stacks up to 5 times). Deity Yoga — Abyssal Gaze: All enemies in line of sight suffer -20% Attack, -20% Armor, -5 Initiative, and lose 8% of max Stamina and Mana each turn.
Mantra of the Great Black One
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_green_sa: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Allies gain a stacking +1 bonus to all d20 rolls (stacks up to +5). Deity Yoga — All-Accomplishing Wisdom: All of the caster's rolls gain +10 and cannot critically fail.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_horse_lo: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Caster and allies gain stacking +2 Initiative and +1 Movement per turn (stacks up to 5 times). Deity Yoga — The Neigh that Shakes the Steppe: All allies gain the full Initiative/Movement bonus plus +20% Attack and +20% Damage, and all melee attacks apply 1 stack of Burning.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_jeweled_: Ongoing effect: Each turn, crystal formations grow on 1 random tile within 3 tiles of the caster (blocks movement, has moderate HP). Allies adjacent to crystals gain +5% to all stats per adjacent crystal. Deity Yoga — The Mountain That Does Not Bend: Create a crystalline barrier encompassing all allies within 4 tiles. The barrier absorbs all incoming damage from outside (total HP = 200% of caster's Spellpower). While the barrier holds, allies inside gain +20% to all stats.

Ongoing effect: Each turn, the caster's Spellpower for summoning increases by +5% (stacks up to 5 times). All active summons gain +3% to all stats per stack. Deity Yoga — The Tower That Contains All Realms: Your next summoning spell calls the most powerful version of that creature. The summon has triple HP, double damage, and radiates an aura (2-tile radius) that grants allies +10% to all stats and inflicts enemies with -10% to all stats.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_lionhead: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, allies gain stacking +5% magic damage resistance and +5% chance to negate incoming debuffs (stacks up to 5 times). Deity Yoga — She Would Drink the Blood of the World: Calculate the average percentage of HP lost across all allies. Deal that percentage of max HP as Sorcery damage to all enemies. Transfer all debuffs from allies to enemies, distributed randomly.
Mantra of the Lion-Headed Curse Devourer
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_lord_of_: Ongoing effect (4-tile radius): Each turn, Black summons regain 10% max HP and enemies in the area take stacking Black damage (3% Spellpower/turn, stacks up to 5 times). Deity Yoga — Nowhere to Run: - Summons act immediately at the start of each turn with +30% damage - Any enemy killed in the area has a 40% chance to rise as a temporary Black summon
Mantra of the Lord of Death
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_lotus_bl: Ongoing effect (line of sight): All enemies must pass increasingly difficult Constitution saves (starting DC 10, +2 per turn) or gain 1 stack of Burning. Deity Yoga — Body of the Lotus Sun: At the start of each turn, all burning enemies explode, dealing Fire damage in a 1-tile radius equal to 10% of their max HP per Burning stack.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_lotus_pi: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, raise all resistances of allies by +3% (stacks up to +15%). Deity Yoga — Immovable Spirit: Every turn, all enemies in line of sight make a Focus save. On failure: Pacified. On success: -50% Attack and Damage (non-stackable) until next turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_medicine: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, the ally with the lowest HP% in radius regains increasing HP (5% Spellpower per stack, stacks up to 5). All allies gain +5% resistance to poison and disease per stack. Deity Yoga — The Healing That Asks Nothing: All allies are healed for 50% of max HP and cleansed of all negative status effects. For 2 turns, all healing effects on allies are tripled.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_red_lotu: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): All enemies must pass increasingly difficult Focus saves (starting DC 10, +2 per turn) or become Charmed for 2 turns. Deity Yoga — The Dance that Magnetizes the World: Enemies who critically fail the Focus save become Dominated instead of Charmed. Any enemy targeting the caster must pass a Focus save or lose their action.
Mantra of the Red Lotus Lady
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_roaring_: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, allies gain stacking +1 Movement and +3% crit chance (stacks up to 5 times). Deity Yoga — Lord of Hosts: Each turn, summon 1-3 Rudras (low HP, high Speed and damage, Air/Sorcery-tagged). They act immediately.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_unshakea: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, enemies suffer stacking cold damage (3% Spellpower, stacks up to 5) and -1 Movement per stack. Allies gain +3% resistance to all damage per stack. Deity Yoga — Mirror of Still Water: All incoming damage to the caster and allies within 3 tiles is reflected back at 50%. All enemies in line of sight are Frozen for 1 turn (no save).
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_white_sa: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, the caster and allies regain 2% max HP, 2% max Mana, and 2% max Stamina (increases by 1% each turn, up to 5%). Deity Yoga — Tranquil Flow: All allies gain immunity to mental effects and 50% chance to resist all debuffs.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mantra_of_the_wishfulf: Ongoing effect (3-tile radius): Each turn, allies gain a random minor buff (+5% to one of: Attack, Armor, Dodge, Spellpower, Initiative). Buffs are stacking and persist until the mantra ends. Deity Yoga — The Gem That Grants All Prayers: All allies gain +25% to all stats. Buffs on allies cannot be dispelled or overwritten for the duration.
fields.perks:skill_perks:master_brewer#desc: Crafted potions have double duration and +25% effectiveness. Potions you craft never fail.
fields.perks:skill_perks:master_craftsman#desc: Choose the bonus on crafted items instead of random. Crafted items have +15% better stats overall.
fields.perks:skill_perks:master_locksmith#desc: +25% lockpicking success. Can attempt locks one tier above your normal skill level.
fields.perks:skill_perks:master_of_shadows#desc: Black summons gain +20% Attack, +20% Damage, and a status effect on hit: poison (zombies), curse (skeletons), lifesteal (vetalas).
fields.perks:skill_perks:master_of_the_supply_l: All party consumables are 25% more effective. Once per day, refill one depleted basic supply (bandage, ration, torch).
fields.perks:skill_perks:master_orator#desc: Critical dialogue successes have amplified effects: price reductions are 50% larger, reputation gains are doubled.
fields.perks:skill_perks:masterwork#desc: Active (8 Mana, once per combat). Double the effectiveness of all active buffs on one ally for 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:masterwork_enhancement: Socketed items gain double the benefit from their gems and essences. Can add a second socket to one item.
fields.perks:skill_perks:measured_distance#desc: Ranged attacks suffer 50% reduced penalties from distance and cover.
fields.perks:skill_perks:measured_radiance#desc: White damage spells have a 25% chance to blind enemies for 1 turn (Focus save negates).
fields.perks:skill_perks:measured_strike#desc: Active (3 Stamina). Make an attack with +20% accuracy. On hit, gain +15% Armor for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:measured_strike#flavor: The sword teaches restraint before aggression.
fields.perks:skill_perks:mental_aftershock#desc: Enemies hit by Space damage spells suffer -10% Focus and -3 Initiative for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:merchant_prince#desc: All party members benefit from 10% better prices when trading, even when the Trade specialist isn't doing the talking.
fields.perks:skill_perks:miraculous_recovery#de: Active (once per combat). Revive a bleeding-out ally to 30% HP and cleanse all negative status effects.
fields.perks:skill_perks:misdirection#desc: While drawing enemy attention (Look at Me active), gain +15% Dodge and +15% resistance to ranged attacks.
fields.perks:skill_perks:momentum#desc: Each consecutive axe hit increases damage of the next by +10% (resets on miss or turn without attacking, cap: +50%). At maximum stacks, your next axe attack is a guaranteed hit.
fields.perks:skill_perks:momentum_shift#desc: When you dodge a melee attack, you may immediately reposition 1 tile in any direction (free action).
fields.perks:skill_perks:mountain_falls#desc: Active (10 Stamina, once per combat). Devastating overhead strike dealing 200% damage. Target must pass a Constitution save at -20% or be Stunned for 2 turns. All enemies within 1 tile take 50% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:natural_remedies#desc: Healing potions used by party members are 25% more effective.
fields.perks:skill_perks:netineti#desc: Passing a saving throw against a status effect has a 50% chance to reflect it back to the caster.
fields.perks:skill_perks:never_was_anyone#desc: Passive. You may enter stealth in plain sight, once per combat, even while observed. Enemies who lose track of you forget you were present at all and revert to their pre-combat behaviour.
fields.perks:skill_perks:never_was_anyone#flavo: The trick is not hiding. The trick is not having been there.
fields.perks:skill_perks:nihil_novi#desc: The +10% Attack and +10% save bonuses against examined enemies persist across encounters with the same enemy type.
fields.perks:skill_perks:nimble_fingers#desc: Can attempt to pick locks. Success based on Finesse + Thievery vs lock difficulty.
fields.perks:skill_perks:no_escape#desc: Bound enemies suffer -20% to saving throws against magic.
fields.perks:skill_perks:no_follow_up_needed#de: Killing an enemy with a Sorcery spell refunds 50% of the mana cost.
fields.perks:skill_perks:no_followup_needed#des: Killing an enemy with a Sorcery spell refunds 50% of the mana cost.
fields.perks:skill_perks:no_one_left_behind#des: Allies below 30% HP gain +20% Armor and +20% healing received. Allies who disengage or reposition do not provoke opportunity attacks.
fields.perks:skill_perks:no_safe_angle#desc: Active (once per combat). Your next ranged attack is a guaranteed critical hit.
fields.perks:skill_perks:no_time_to_breathe#des: Enemies hit by unarmed attacks suffer stacking -5% Dodge and -2 Initiative (stacks up to 3 times, lasts 2 turns).
fields.perks:skill_perks:no_warning#desc: Sorcery spells cast on your first turn of combat deal +30% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:nobody_wants_to_be_the: A cancelled combat opens a trade screen with the option to recruit the earlier enemies at normal prices.
Nobody Wants to Be the Straight Man
fields.perks:skill_perks:none_shall_pass#desc: Active. End your turn. Until your next turn, enemies cannot move through your threatened area (2-tile reach) without taking a free attack and suffering -2 Movement for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:nothing_burns_alone#de: When a burning enemy dies, all enemies within 1 tile gain Burning (stacks equal to half the dead enemy's stacks, minimum 1).
fields.perks:skill_perks:nothing_is_beyond_mend: Passive. Your healing spells also cure one wound or disease from the target, lowest cure level first. An ally you heal from below 10% HP additionally recovers a spent action.
The body is very willing. It mostly needs to be told it is allowed.
fields.perks:skill_perks:nothing_is_locked#desc: All locks below maximum difficulty are automatically opened. Maximum-difficulty locks gain +30% success.
fields.perks:skill_perks:nothing_is_withheld#de: Passive. Skill checks that use Learning may be attempted twice, taking the better result. XP costs for all skills are reduced by 15%, and you may read any text in any realm regardless of language or age.
fields.perks:skill_perks:nothing_is_withheld#fl: Everything was always going to be legible. It was only ever a question of sitting down with it.
fields.perks:skill_perks:nothing_left_standing#: Passive. When an axe attack kills, immediately make a free axe attack against any other enemy within reach. This can chain up to twice per turn.
The problem with stopping is deciding when.
fields.perks:skill_perks:nothing_surprises_me_t: Once an enemy type has been examined, all future encounters with that type start partially revealed (basic stats visible from turn 1).
fields.perks:skill_perks:nothing_wasted#desc: When you kill an enemy with overkill damage, 50% of the excess carries over as damage to another adjacent enemy.
fields.perks:skill_perks:now_im_there#desc: After casting an instant movement spell, gain +15% Dodge and +3 Initiative until next turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:now_you_see_it#desc: Distracted enemies cannot benefit from flanking bonuses or coordinated attacks.
fields.perks:skill_perks:now_you_see_me#desc: Entering stealth removes all minor debuffs (1-turn duration) and breaks enemy targeting.
fields.perks:skill_perks:observe_carefully#desc: Active (free action). Examine an enemy to reveal basic stats (HP, Armor, top 2 resistances) and one weakness.
fields.perks:skill_perks:offhand_jab#desc: Off-hand dagger attacks gain +10% accuracy and +5% crit chance.
fields.perks:skill_perks:one_breath_one_arrow#d: First ranged attack each turn gains +15% accuracy. If it crits, ignore all armor for that hit.
fields.perks:skill_perks:one_breath_one_kill#de: Active (once per combat, 6 Stamina). Spend your whole turn aiming. The shot ignores cover, line of sight, and Armor entirely, and critically hits if the target is below half HP.
fields.perks:skill_perks:one_breath_one_kill#fl: The arrow was released a long time before it left the string.
fields.perks:skill_perks:one_inch#desc: Active (once per combat, 8 Stamina). Deal triple damage with an unarmed strike that cannot be Dodged or blocked by Armor.
fields.perks:skill_perks:one_line_one_breath#de: Passive. The first sword attack each combat has +25% accuracy and cannot critically fail.
fields.perks:skill_perks:one_perfect_sentence#d: Active (once per combat). The next spell gains +200% Spellpower and costs double mana. (Additive with other overcast effects.)
fields.perks:skill_perks:open_the_gate#desc: Passive. Attacks made after moving at least 1 tile gain +15% crit chance.
fields.perks:skill_perks:opportunist#desc: Passive. While wielding a sword, enemies cannot move through your tile or any tile adjacent to you without provoking a free sword attack (once per enemy per turn).
fields.perks:skill_perks:opportunist#flavor: The line is not drawn on the ground. It passes through you.
fields.perks:skill_perks:opportunist_daggers#de: Enemies that miss you in melee provoke a free dagger counterattack.
fields.perks:skill_perks:opportunistic_grab#des: When an enemy dies, 20% chance to find an additional item beyond normal loot.
fields.perks:skill_perks:overhead_chop#desc: Active (3 Stamina). A slow attack with +30% damage and +15% armor penetration, but you suffer -15% Dodge until next turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:overwhelming_blow#desc: Active (3 Stamina). Make an attack that pushes the enemy 1 tile. If they can't be pushed (wall, another unit), they take +25% damage instead.
fields.perks:skill_perks:pacify_the_confused#de: Active. Target enemy makes a Focus save. On failure, stops fighting for 2-4 turns. If combat ends during this time, the enemy does not re-engage. Full XP still granted.
fields.perks:skill_perks:pack_tactics#desc: Summons gain +10% Attack when adjacent to another summon or to you.
fields.perks:skill_perks:pain_is_just_informati: +25% resistance to Stun, Knockdown, and Exhaustion effects.
fields.perks:skill_perks:parry#desc: Passive. 20% of your Attack is added to Armor while wielding a sword. Does not apply if flanked.
fields.perks:skill_perks:patient_aim#desc: Passive. If you didn't move last turn, ranged attacks gain +8% accuracy.
fields.perks:skill_perks:patient_aim#flavor: Still ground is the first lesson.
fields.perks:skill_perks:patron_of_the_arts#des: Donate gold to gain reputation. Higher reputation unlocks exclusive dialogue options, quests, and shop tiers.
fields.perks:skill_perks:perfect_balance#desc: Cannot be knocked prone, tripped, or knocked down. Immune to ice and slippery terrain effects.
fields.perks:skill_perks:perfect_correspondence: When using a charm aligned with the spell's element: +30% Spellpower and -25% mana cost.
fields.perks:skill_perks:perfect_execution#desc: Role synergies are guaranteed and enhanced (doubled). Once per combat, all allies act as perfectly coordinated for 1 full round: synergies trigger on every action.
fields.perks:skill_perks:perfect_pressure#desc: Passive. After hitting the same target 3 or more times in a combat, your attacks against them ignore 20% of their armor permanently for that fight.
fields.perks:skill_perks:perfect_pressure#flavo: Enough repetition and the shape of a thing becomes known.
fields.perks:skill_perks:perfect_volley#desc: Active (8 Mana). Allies within 2 tiles gain +15% ranged Attack and +10% crit chance for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:permafrost#desc: Frozen enemies take +30% damage from all sources. Shattering a Frozen enemy (killing them while Frozen) deals 25% of the kill damage to all enemies within 1 tile.
fields.perks:skill_perks:persistent_coating#des: Weapon coatings last for 5 hits and their effects are 25% stronger.
fields.perks:skill_perks:petrify#desc: Active (once per combat, 12 Mana). Target enemy must pass a Constitution save at -20% or be turned to stone for 3 turns (incapacitated, immune to damage, +50% Armor). On save, Slowed for 2 turns instead.
fields.perks:skill_perks:philosophers_approach#: Can break down magical items into crafting components (reagents, essences, elemental residue).
fields.perks:skill_perks:pinning_shot#desc: Active (5 Stamina). Make a ranged attack. On hit, target's Movement is reduced to 0 for 1 turn (Constitution save negates the pin, damage still applies).
fields.perks:skill_perks:pinning_thrust#desc: Active (5 Stamina). Make a spear attack. On hit, target's Movement is reduced to 0 for 2 turns (Constitution save negates the pin, damage still applies).
fields.perks:skill_perks:play_dirty#desc: Successful hits have a 20% chance to apply a random minor debuff for 1 turn: blind (-25% accuracy), slow (-1 Movement), pin (can't move), or bleed (5% max HP).
fields.perks:skill_perks:play_to_the_crowd#desc: Gain +2% Luck for each unit (ally or enemy) within 3 tiles.
fields.perks:skill_perks:point_control#desc: Enemies within your reach also suffer -1 Movement and -10% Dodge.
fields.perks:skill_perks:potent_mixture#desc: Potions you craft have +1 turn duration and +15% effectiveness beyond the base Consumable Power bonus.
fields.perks:skill_perks:predictive_model#desc: Examination also reveals the enemy's likely next action (attack target, spell, or movement).
fields.perks:skill_perks:preferred_customer#des: Merchants restock faster and occasionally offer exclusive items to you.
fields.perks:skill_perks:prepared_ground#desc: Active (once per combat, before first turn). Place 3 tiles of terrain: barricade (half cover), caltrops (movement damage), or blessed ground (minor healing).
fields.perks:skill_perks:prepared_implements#de: You may have 2 charged implements prepared at once (instead of 1).
fields.perks:skill_perks:press_the_advantage#de: When an enemy is defeated, allies within 3 tiles gain +3 Initiative and +10% Attack for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:pressure_before_impact: Passive. If a Fire spell deals no Burning but hits successfully, it still pushes the target 1 tile away from you.
The pressure arrives before the heat.
fields.perks:skill_perks:pressure_points#desc: Melee attacks against biological enemies have a 15% chance to apply a random debuff: -10% Attack, -10% Dodge, or -1 Movement for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:preventive_care#desc: At the start of combat, all allies gain a damage shield equal to 10% of their max HP.
fields.perks:skill_perks:punchline#desc: When a random effect benefits you (lucky loot, random buff, etc.), increase its magnitude by 25%.
fields.perks:skill_perks:purifying_stream#desc: Water healing spells that restore HP also remove 1 negative status effect.
fields.perks:skill_perks:push_the_words#desc: Active. The next spell gains +100% Spellpower but costs 50% more mana. (Additive with other overcast effects.)
fields.perks:skill_perks:put_your_weight_into_i: Melee attacks have a 15% chance to knockback 1 tile or stun for 1 turn (Constitution save negates).
fields.perks:skill_perks:quartermaster#desc: Equipment degradation reduced by 30%. Consumables with limited uses gain +1 use.
fields.perks:skill_perks:quick_brew#desc: Craft potions in half the normal time between encounters.
fields.perks:skill_perks:quick_escape#desc: Active (free action, 3-turn cooldown). Move up to 3 tiles immediately, ignoring reaction attacks and terrain penalties.
fields.perks:skill_perks:raise_wall#desc: Active (6 Mana). Create a stone wall (3 tiles long, blocks movement and line of sight). Destructible (moderate HP). Lasts 4 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:rally_the_banner#desc: Active (1 action, 3-turn cooldown). Remove mental status effects and Stun from allies within 3 tiles. Grant +3 Initiative for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:rattle_the_cage#desc: Critical unarmed hits apply Stun for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:reactive_shielding#des: When a buffed ally takes damage, 15% chance that the buff absorbs 25% of the damage instead.
fields.perks:skill_perks:read_the_flow#desc: +15% to saves against AoE effects (dodging out of the blast).
fields.perks:skill_perks:read_the_line#desc: Passive. Sword attacks against enemies who moved toward you this turn gain +15% damage and +10% accuracy.
fields.perks:skill_perks:read_the_line#flavor: The sword knows where the enemy will be.
fields.perks:skill_perks:read_the_room#desc: Failed social checks reveal partial information about what would have succeeded. Retries suffer only half the normal penalty.
fields.perks:skill_perks:red_harvest#desc: Active (8 Stamina). Attack all enemies in a 180-degree arc for full damage with +15% crit chance.
fields.perks:skill_perks:reinforce#desc: Active (out of combat). Upgrade an existing piece of equipment, granting +10% to its primary stat permanently.
fields.perks:skill_perks:relentless#desc: Gain a free unarmed attack after scoring a critical hit.
fields.perks:skill_perks:relentless_advance#des: After hitting an enemy, gain +1 Movement for 1 turn. Taking damage does not reduce your Movement.
fields.perks:skill_perks:remember_this#desc: When a character fails a specific roll type (attack, save, etc.) in combat, the next roll of that type by any party member gains +25%.
fields.perks:skill_perks:residual_power#desc: After casting a spell, regain 5-10% of the mana spent (random within range).
fields.perks:skill_perks:riposte#desc: Passive trigger. When you successfully Dodge or Parry a melee attack, your next sword attack costs 2 less Stamina and gains +25% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:riptide#desc: Spells that push or pull enemies gain +1 tile of displacement. Displaced enemies must pass a Constitution save or be knocked prone.
fields.perks:skill_perks:roles_assigned#desc: At combat start, designate each ally as **Vanguard** (+10% Armor, +10% HP), **Striker** (+10% Damage, +5% Crit), **Support** (+10% Spellpower, +10% Healing), or **Control** (+10% Status Chance, +10% Duration).
fields.perks:skill_perks:root_and_summit#desc: Passive. While standing on earth, stone or ground you have shaped, you cannot be moved against your will and gain +30% to all Resistances. Your Earth spells treat the battlefield's terrain as one tier more favourable.
fields.perks:skill_perks:root_and_summit#flavor: The mountain is not stubborn. It simply has nowhere it would rather be.
fields.perks:skill_perks:roots_of_the_world#des: Active (once per combat, 15 Mana). All allies gain +25% Armor, +25% to all saves, and immunity to knockdown and knockback for 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:rousing_display#desc: When combat starts, allies within 3 tiles gain +2 Initiative for the first round.
fields.perks:skill_perks:safe_campsite#desc: Ambush chance during rest reduced by 30%. Party heals +15% more HP during rest.
fields.perks:skill_perks:salvage#desc: Break down unwanted items for materials, recovering 50% of the item's material value.
fields.perks:skill_perks:sapping_touch#desc: Debuff spells also drain 5% of the target's max Mana or Stamina (whichever is lower).
fields.perks:skill_perks:say_it_like_you_mean_i: +10% to social checks in dialogue involving deception, negotiation, or intimidation.
Say It Like You Mean It
fields.perks:skill_perks:say_it_louder#desc: Overcast Sorcery spells gain a secondary effect (choose one): knockback 2 tiles, Burning 1 stack, Stun 1 turn, or Freeze 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:say_something_stupid#d: Comedy dialogue options may allow you to exit a situation without combat, though rewards may be reduced or altered.
fields.perks:skill_perks:scattering_gust#desc: Spells that push enemies also have a 25% chance of knockdown (Constitution save).
fields.perks:skill_perks:scout_ahead#desc: Active (overworld). Reveal nearby points of interest and dangers within a moderate radius.
fields.perks:skill_perks:second_wind#desc: Active (3-turn cooldown). Recover 30% of max Stamina and gain +10% damage resistance for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:see_stars#desc: Unarmed hits against enemies already suffering from a status effect have a 25% chance to apply a random additional effect: Stun, Knockdown, or Blind for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:set_for_charge#desc: Active. End your turn. If an enemy moves into your reach before your next turn, your reaction attack deals double damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:shady_dealings#desc: Only melee attacks break stealth automatically. Ranged attacks, spell casting, and item use trigger an Awareness check (+5 bonus) for enemies within 2 tiles instead of automatically revealing you.
fields.perks:skill_perks:shared_heat#desc: Fire enchantments (Burning Weapon, Bloodlust, Fan the Flames) gain a 1-tile AoE around the target.
fields.perks:skill_perks:shared_hunger#desc: Vampiric/lifesteal buffs also affect allies within 2 tiles at 50% effectiveness.
fields.perks:skill_perks:shared_shelter#desc: Single-target protection or blessing spells also affect allies within 1 tile of the target at 50% effectiveness.
fields.perks:skill_perks:shared_step#desc: Single-target teleport spells also affect allies within 1 tile of the original target.
fields.perks:skill_perks:shared_strength#desc: Earth buff spells that target a single ally also grant +5% of the buff's value to adjacent allies.
fields.perks:skill_perks:shared_vitality#desc: When a summon dies, 20% of its max HP is distributed as healing to you and allies within 2 tiles.
fields.perks:skill_perks:sharpened_aim#desc: Active (3 Mana). Buff the caster's Attack by +15% and crit chance by +10% for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:shield_bash#desc: Active (3 Stamina). Requires shield. Push an enemy 1 tile and apply -10% accuracy for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:shield_mastery#desc: Shields grant +10% more Armor than their base value.
fields.perks:skill_perks:shield_wall#desc: Active. End your turn. Until next turn, gain +25% Armor and adjacent allies gain +10% Armor.
fields.perks:skill_perks:shieldbreaker#desc: Mace attacks reduce target's Armor by 10% per hit (stacks, lasts 3 turns).
fields.perks:skill_perks:short_words_sharp_mean: Sorcery spells can critically hit (15% chance, +50% damage).
fields.perks:skill_perks:shoulder_to_shoulder#d: When an ally takes damage, 15% is redistributed among allies within 2 tiles (each absorbs an equal share).
fields.perks:skill_perks:skull_crack#desc: Stunned or Dazed enemies take +20% damage from all sources.
fields.perks:skill_perks:slapstick_interruption: When an enemy misses an attack within 2 tiles of you, 25% chance they fall prone (knockdown for 1 turn).
fields.perks:skill_perks:slippery#desc: +15% chance to escape grapples, bindings, and movement-restricting effects at the start of your turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:smoke_and_mirrors#desc: Active (5 Stamina). Create 1-3 false images around you. Images have 1 HP, high Dodge, and draw enemy attention. They move randomly but do not attack. Last 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:snap_decision#desc: Enemies hit by Sorcery spells suffer -25% Initiative for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:socket#desc: Add a gem socket to a piece of equipment. Sockets hold gems, charms, or essences for additional bonuses.
fields.perks:skill_perks:soft_step#desc: While stealthed, enemy detection checks only trigger when passing within 1 tile (instead of 2).
fields.perks:skill_perks:soothing_presence#desc: +10% success chance on rolls for non-violent solutions in dialogue.
fields.perks:skill_perks:soul_feast#desc: Damage from Black spells heals the caster for 15% and allies within 3 tiles for 10% of the damage dealt.
fields.perks:skill_perks:spell_like_a_knife#des: If a single-target Sorcery spell kills the target, your next spell gains +50% Spellpower.
fields.perks:skill_perks:splash_zone#desc: Thrown potions (healing, buff) also affect allies within 1 tile of the target at 50% effectiveness.
fields.perks:skill_perks:split_attention#desc: Distracted enemies suffer -10% accuracy against all targets, not just the performer.
fields.perks:skill_perks:spreading_flame#desc: Fire summons gain a burning aura: enemies within 1 tile take 2 fire damage per turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:spreading_heat#desc: Passive. When a Fire spell kills a target that was Burning, all other Burning enemies within 2 tiles take 20% more fire damage for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:spreading_heat#flavor: The air itself starts to boil.
fields.perks:skill_perks:spreading_warmth#desc: Buffs you cast affect all allies within 2 tiles at 60% effectiveness.
fields.perks:skill_perks:spring_of_life#desc: Once per combat, when an ally would begin bleeding out, automatically cast a free heal on them (30% of your Spellpower as HP).
fields.perks:skill_perks:spring_step#desc: Active (3 Stamina). After taking an action, immediately move up to 2 tiles (free action, does not provoke).
fields.perks:skill_perks:stage_fright#desc: Enemies affected by fear or morale loss suffer -3 Initiative and -10% reaction speed for the duration.
fields.perks:skill_perks:stalwart_guardian#desc: Active (1 action). Choose an adjacent ally. Until your next turn, attacks targeting that ally have a 50% chance of targeting you instead. You gain +15% Armor while guarding.
fields.perks:skill_perks:stand_in_the_gap#desc: Active. End your turn. Until your next turn, enemies moving past or attacking allies within 1 tile of you provoke a free sword attack.
fields.perks:skill_perks:static_edge#desc: All your attacks deal an additional 10% of weapon damage as Air damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:steadfast_spirit#desc: Passing a saving throw against a debuff grants 50% resistance to that damage/effect type for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:steady_aim#desc: If you did not move this turn, +10% damage on ranged attacks.
fields.perks:skill_perks:steady_hands#desc: +20% success when stabilizing bleeding-out allies. Stabilized allies regain 5% of max HP.
fields.perks:skill_perks:steal_the_scene#desc: Once per dialogue, convert a failed social roll into a partial success.
fields.perks:skill_perks:step_between_moments#d: Active (6 Stamina). Teleport up to 3 tiles. Your next attack this round has +20% crit chance and ignores Dodge. After teleporting, gain +15% Dodge until your next turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:sticky_fingers#desc: +20% pickpocketing success. Can steal equipped items (not just carried inventory) with a harder check.
fields.perks:skill_perks:still_standing#desc: Once per combat, an attack that would reduce you to 0 HP instead leaves you at 1 HP.
fields.perks:skill_perks:still_the_troubled_wat: Passive. White healing spells cast on a target that currently has a negative status effect restore 15% more HP.
The suffering appreciate kindness more deeply.
fields.perks:skill_perks:stone_body#desc: +25% resistance to bleed, poison, and other effects that bypass armor.
fields.perks:skill_perks:strategic_withdrawal#d: Active. Once per encounter, the party may retreat from combat without penalty (no lost items, no reputation loss). Must be used before any ally begins bleeding out.
fields.perks:skill_perks:strength_in_numbers#de: You may maintain 1 additional summon active simultaneously.
fields.perks:skill_perks:stubborn_body#desc: Passive. Every wound and disease that worsens with rest takes 1 additional untreated rest before it escalates to a worse form.
fields.perks:skill_perks:stubborn_body#flavor: It takes longer to break what refuses to stay broken.
fields.perks:skill_perks:sudden_end#desc: Your first attack made from stealth deals +100% crit damage and applies a severe bleed (10% max HP/turn for 3 turns).
fields.perks:skill_perks:sudden_silence#desc: Sorcery damage spells reduce the target's Spellpower by 25% for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:summoners_bond#desc: Gain +5% to all saves while you have at least one summon active.
fields.perks:skill_perks:summoners_command#desc: Active (free action). Direct one summon to immediately move up to its full Movement and make one attack.
fields.perks:skill_perks:sundering_blow#desc: Active (4 Stamina). Make an attack that reduces target's Armor by 30% for 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:supply_and_demand#desc: Active (overworld). Check available trade goods between known settlements. Buying low and selling high grants triple the normal gold difference.
fields.perks:skill_perks:supply_cache#desc: Once per area, stash supplies that can be retrieved later. Stashed items don't count toward weight limit.
fields.perks:skill_perks:sure_step#desc: Broken ground no longer slows the party: forest, hills and ruins are crossed at open-road pace.
fields.perks:skill_perks:sure_step#flavor: Knowing where to put your feet is most of knowing where you are going.
fields.perks:skill_perks:surgical#desc: Passive. Sword attacks against targets below 40% HP deal +20% damage and cannot be parried.
fields.perks:skill_perks:surgical#flavor: The clean ending is its own technique.
fields.perks:skill_perks:sustained_performance#: Performance effects intensify by +5% for each consecutive turn the performer is uninterrupted (no damage taken). Stacks up to 3 times.
fields.perks:skill_perks:sweeping_strike#desc: Active (4 Stamina). Attack all enemies within reach in a 180-degree arc at 75% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:swift_zephyr#desc: Buffs that increase Movement also grant +10% Dodge for their duration.
fields.perks:skill_perks:symbolic_weight#desc: Status effects applied by your spells last 1 additional turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:sympathetic_bond#desc: When you cast a buff on an ally, you gain a 30%-strength version of that buff on yourself.
fields.perks:skill_perks:tactical_assessment#de: Before combat, see a summary of enemy types and approximate threat level. Choose your starting formation from 3 preset options.
fields.perks:skill_perks:tactical_synergy#desc: When allies of different roles interact, bonus effects trigger: Control debuff then Striker attack gains +15% damage; Support buff then Vanguard gains +10% Armor for 1 turn; etc.
fields.perks:skill_perks:taunt#desc: Active. Force an enemy to focus attacks on you for 2 turns (Focus save negates).
fields.perks:skill_perks:terms_of_engagement#de: Active (once per combat). Name terms before blood is drawn. Enemies below half HP must save or withdraw from the fight entirely; those who stay take −15% damage for 2 turns from having heard you out.
fields.perks:skill_perks:terms_of_engagement#fl: Most fights continue because nobody thought to offer an alternative.
fields.perks:skill_perks:terrain_mastery#desc: +1 Movement when starting your turn on elevated terrain.
fields.perks:skill_perks:that_was_supposed_to_m: Active (once per combat). Force an enemy's attack to miss. That enemy loses their remaining action for the turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_binding_holds#desc: Passive. Buffs you cast have no duration — they last until dispelled or the combat ends. Debuffs you cast cannot be cleansed by anything short of a dispel.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_binding_holds#flav: An enchantment is a sentence the world has agreed to finish.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_blade_decides#desc: Passive. When you parry, riposte, or land a critical sword hit, gain a Measure stack (max 3). Each stack adds +10% sword damage and +5% Armor. Stacks persist until you take damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_blade_decides#flav: There is a moment in the exchange where it stops being a contest.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_company_you_keep#d: Passive. All allies gain +2 to every derived stat while you are conscious. When you fall in combat, allies immediately gain an extra action rather than losing morale.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_company_you_keep#f: Eat last. Sleep where they can see you.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_crowd_carries_you#: Each inspired ally increases the strength and duration of your Performance effects by 5% (stacks up to +25% with 5 inspired allies).
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_door_stands_open#d: Active (once per combat, 15 Mana). Open a gate between any two tiles you can see. It persists for 3 turns; any unit may step through, and allies who do gain +2 Initiative.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_door_stands_open#f: Distance was always a courtesy, not a law.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_fire_that_does_not: Passive. Your Fire spells no longer damage allies or destroy terrain you wish to preserve. Burning you apply lasts until dispelled, and enemies killed while Burning explode for half the spell's damage.
It has learned the difference between burning and destroying. That took longer than the fire did.
The Fire That Does Not Consume
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_form_completes_its: Passive. Whenever you spend your entire turn on martial arts attacks, the last one costs no Stamina and knocks the target back 1 tile. Missing does not interrupt the sequence.
Halfway through, the form stops being something you are doing.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_gap_in_the_guard#d: Passive. Dagger attacks against a target that has not yet acted this combat, or that is unaware of you, ignore Armor entirely rather than 25%.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_gap_in_the_guard#f: Armour covers what a person expects to be hit.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_ground_of_being#de: Passive. Emotional pressure decays toward baseline at triple rate, and you are immune to crisis states in every element. Once per rest you may extend this immunity to the whole party until the next combat ends.
