fields.perks:skill_perks:the_ground_of_being#fl: Not calm because nothing is happening. Calm because something is.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_immovable_object#d: Once per combat, when reduced below 25% HP, gain +30% Armor, +30% Damage, and immunity to stun for 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_invisible_hand#des: Active (once per combat). Steal one consumable item or minor piece of equipment from an enemy. Does not break stealth.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_last_laugh#desc: Passive. Enemies that would land a critical hit on you must first save or lose the attack to a fit of something they cannot name. Once per combat, one enemy simply refuses to keep fighting you.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_last_laugh#flavor: The universe is not hostile. It is a very long joke with a slow delivery.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_laughter_turns#des: Active (once per combat). All demoralized enemies must make a Focus save or become Confused or Panicked for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_line_holds#desc: Passive. Your threatened area extends to 3 tiles. Enemies entering it are Slowed for 1 turn, and any reaction attack you make from a braced position cannot miss.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_line_holds#flavor: The spear does not need to move. That is the entire idea.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_lineage_continues#: Teach a spell to a character who doesn't meet the skill requirements. They can't cast it yet, but it's instantly available once they gain the appropriate skills.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_mountain_answers#d: Active (8 Stamina). Strike the ground rather than a target. Every enemy within 2 tiles is Knocked_Down and takes crushing damage equal to your Strength; structures and obstacles in the radius are destroyed outright.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_mountain_answers#f: You do not argue with a mace. You are simply, eventually, agreed with.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_perfected_solution: Passive. Potions and bombs you brew are always one rarity tier higher and cost no reagents on a Logistics-conserved step. Consumables you use affect the whole party at half strength.
Forty years of getting the proportions wrong, and then once of getting them right.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_performance_of_a_l: Active (once per combat). Hold the field. All enemies who can see you must save or spend their turn watching; allies gain +25% damage and immunity to fear for 2 turns.
They came to kill you and they stayed to find out how it ends.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_physician_of_the_d: Passive. You can treat any wound or disease regardless of its cure level, in the field, without supplies. A party member who would bleed out in combat instead stabilises at 1 HP once per combat.
There is no condition that cannot be attended to. There are only ones that cannot be reversed.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_rite_completes_its: Passive. Mandalas and ritual circles you create persist for the whole run rather than a single use, and any ritual you begin continues correctly even if you are interrupted, unconscious, or elsewhere.
The ceremony does not depend on the celebrant. That is rather the point of a ceremony.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_river_has_no_shape: Active (once per combat, 15 Mana). For 3 turns you cannot be Immobilized, Rooted, Grappled or Knocked_Down, you move through occupied tiles freely, and every Water spell you cast costs half.
Ask the river to hold still and see how the conversation goes.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_road_provides#desc: Passive. The party consumes no food on overworld movement. Rest restores an additional 25%, camp activities cost one fewer resource, and you always know the shortest safe route to any discovered location.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_road_provides#flav: Anyone can carry supplies. The art is needing fewer of them.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_room_agrees#desc: Passive. When you succeed on a Persuasion check with witnesses present, every other NPC in the scene shifts one step friendlier for the rest of the encounter — including ones who were hostile.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_room_agrees#flavor: You never have to convince everybody. Only enough of them, loudly.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_second_arrow#desc: Passive. Each turn, the first ranged attack that hits grants an immediate second shot at −25% damage against the same target or one adjacent to it.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_second_arrow#flavo: The first one tells you where the wind is.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_sky_leans_in#desc: Passive. Air spells you cast gain +1 tile of range and +1 tile of AoE size. Enemies pushed into walls, obstacles, or each other take crushing damage equal to half the tiles they were moved.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_sky_leans_in#flavo: It was already moving. You only asked it to move here.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_sun_does_not_ask#d: Dominate and Charm spells gain +20% success chance.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_universe_loves_a_g: Once per combat, force a reroll of any single failed roll and take the better result.
The Universe Loves a Good Joke
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_voice_carries_the_: Passive. Unarmed damage bonus equals 25% of your Spellpower in addition to normal attributes. The inner word speaks through the limb.
Where the mantra goes, force follows.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_water_finds_the_cr: Passive. You cannot be flanked, surrounded, or caught in an AoE you can see — you always slip to the nearest safe tile. Movement never provokes reactions.
You were not where the blow landed. You were not going to be.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_whole_arc#desc: Passive. Axe kills no longer end your momentum — momentum stacks persist through a kill and carry into the next turn. At 5+ stacks, every axe hit cleaves one adjacent enemy for full damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_whole_arc#flavor: The swing does not stop because something got in the way.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_word_and_the_silen: Passive. Once per combat, a single-target Sorcery spell may be cast with no mana cost and no chance of failure. If it kills its target, you recover the mana of the most expensive spell you have cast this combat.
Say it once. Correctly. Then stop talking.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_word_that_turns#de: Passive. Once per event, a failed Persuasion roll may be re-rolled. Blue Persuasion choices unlock two levels below their stated requirement, and hostile NPCs will always hear one sentence before acting.
fields.perks:skill_perks:the_word_that_turns#fl: Nobody has ever been argued out of anything. They have been given somewhere better to stand.
fields.perks:skill_perks:they_think_it_was_thei: Persuasion checks also benefit from your Guile skill bonus.
They Think It Was Their Idea
fields.perks:skill_perks:this_is_the_moment#des: Active (once per combat). Up to 4 allies immediately gain an extra action. That action cannot be interrupted, countered, or delayed.
fields.perks:skill_perks:this_place_is_fixed#de: Area control spells gain +2 turns duration and prevent all teleport-style movement within their area.
fields.perks:skill_perks:thousand_cuts#desc: Passive. Every dagger hit on a target that is already Bleeding refreshes and deepens the bleed instead of reapplying it (stacking to 5). At 5 stacks the target takes double bleed damage and cannot be healed above half HP.
fields.perks:skill_perks:thousand_cuts#flavor: No single one of them was the wound.
fields.perks:skill_perks:thunderous_impact#desc: Critical hits with maces knock the target prone (no save) and apply Dazed for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:tidal_patience#desc: Each consecutive turn you don't move, gain stacking +5% Damage and +5% Armor (stacks up to 3 times). Moving resets all stacks.
fields.perks:skill_perks:tidal_surge#desc: After casting a Water spell, gain +1 Movement for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:too_fast_to_count#desc: Once per turn, your first dagger attack is a guaranteed hit.
fields.perks:skill_perks:too_fast_to_react#desc: Active (once per combat). Your next Sorcery spell ignores all resistances.
fields.perks:skill_perks:touch_of_gloom#desc: Debuff spells also apply -1 Movement and -3 Initiative for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:touch_the_flame#desc: Passive. Your Fire spells have a 15% chance to apply 1 stack of Burning to the target even if the spell does not naturally cause Burning.
fields.perks:skill_perks:tough_flesh#desc: Black summons gain +15% HP and +10% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:tower_shield#desc: Block chance increases to 25%. Blocked ranged attacks are reflected back at the attacker for 30% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:trade_empire#desc: Passive income: gain gold at the end of each in-game day equal to 3% of your current gold (minimum 50).
fields.perks:skill_perks:transmuters_eye#desc: Identify unknown potions and substances without risk. Salvage 50% more materials when breaking down items.
fields.perks:skill_perks:trap_maker#desc: Active (1 action). Place a trap on an adjacent tile. The first enemy to enter takes damage equal to 30% of your Focus and is immobilized for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:trap_sense#desc: Passively detect traps within 3 tiles. Can attempt to disarm them (Finesse + Thievery vs trap difficulty).
fields.perks:skill_perks:tremor#desc: Earth AoE spells have a 25% chance to knock enemies prone (Finesse save negates).
fields.perks:skill_perks:triage#desc: Field Medic heals for 40% of Awareness and also removes 1 negative status effect.
fields.perks:skill_perks:tumble#desc: Active (2 Stamina). Move through enemy-occupied tiles without provoking reaction attacks this turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:turn_the_tables#desc: Disarmed traps can be re-armed facing the enemy. Enemies trigger your repositioned traps as if you placed them.
fields.perks:skill_perks:two_hands_no_regret#de: Two-handed axes gain +15% damage and cleave effects (Wide Arc, Cleave) deal 75% damage instead of 50%.
fields.perks:skill_perks:unavoidable_truth#desc: Enemies struck by White magic cannot benefit from invisibility, illusions, or stealth for 3 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:unbroken#desc: Passive. The first time each combat you would drop below 25% HP, you instead stop at 25% and all your Armor values double until end of turn. Wounds inflicted on you are downgraded one severity.
fields.perks:skill_perks:unbroken#flavor: Armour is a promise you make to the people standing behind you.
fields.perks:skill_perks:unbroken_circle#desc: As long as 2+ allies are standing, all allies gain +15% resistance to mental status effects. Each additional ally adds +3%.
fields.perks:skill_perks:undead_hunter#desc: Passive. Attacks from undead or diseased enemies cannot give you a disease or the Diseased status. Diseases from other sources still apply.
fields.perks:skill_perks:universal_refuge#desc: Healing spells that already affect an AoE now affect all allies in line of sight at 75% effectiveness.
fields.perks:skill_perks:universal_solvent#desc: Active (once per encounter). Destroy one magical barrier, lock, or environmental hazard using alchemical means.
fields.perks:skill_perks:unmovable_object#desc: Immune to all forced movement effects.
fields.perks:skill_perks:unraveling#desc: Active (4 Mana). Dispel one buff from an enemy. If successful, the buff's inverse is applied as a debuff for 2 turns.
fields.perks:skill_perks:vanishing_act#desc: Quick Escape also grants stealth and removes all enemy targeting on you.
fields.perks:skill_perks:voice_of_compassion#de: Non-violent dialogue successes also improve karma (small hidden reduction to negative karma) and grant 10% bonus rewards.
fields.perks:skill_perks:volatile_compounds#des: Grenades gain +1 tile radius and +25% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:volley#desc: Active (6 Stamina). Attack all enemies in a 2-tile-wide, 3-tile-long cone at 60% damage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:walk_the_pattern#desc: Passive. Each consecutive ranged attack against the same target this turn gains +8% accuracy (up to +24%).
fields.perks:skill_perks:wall_of_points#desc: Enemies within your reach suffer -10% accuracy on their attacks.
fields.perks:skill_perks:water_finds_the_gap#de: Spear attacks against enemies who moved this turn gain +15% accuracy and ignore 15% Armor.
fields.perks:skill_perks:water_over_stone#desc: For each enemy adjacent to you beyond the first, gain +5% Dodge (up to +20% with 5 adjacent enemies).
fields.perks:skill_perks:waters_memory#desc: Water spells that create terrain effects persist 1 additional turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:weakening_gaze#desc: Debuffs you cast are 10% more effective (higher penalties).
fields.perks:skill_perks:weapon_specialist#desc: Crafted weapons gain +10% Damage and +5% accuracy.
fields.perks:skill_perks:wear_it_well#desc: +5% Stamina recovery rate per piece of armor worn (up to +20% with 4 pieces).
fields.perks:skill_perks:web_of_words#desc: The effective DC of Persuasion checks in dialogue is halved. Checks that would already be trivial become automatic successes.
fields.perks:skill_perks:weight_of_the_mountain: Enemies damaged by Earth spells suffer -1 Movement for 2 turns (stacks up to -3).
fields.perks:skill_perks:well_rested#desc: After a full rest, grants the party Awareness +3, Constitution +2, and Initiative +5 until the next combat ends.
fields.perks:skill_perks:welltempered#desc: Passive. Crowd control effects on you last 1 fewer turn (minimum 1).
fields.perks:skill_perks:welltempered#flavor: Trust you can find your balance regardless of circumstances.
fields.perks:skill_perks:what_cannot_be_carried: Passive. No weight limit applies to you, and you may lift, drag, or break anything a party of four could. Enemies attempting to move, grapple, or knock you down fail automatically.
There is a point past which strength stops being about lifting.
fields.perks:skill_perks:what_the_mind_clings_t: Enemies affected by 2+ Black debuffs must pass a Focus save or become Feared for 1 turn (once per enemy per combat).
Samsara does not need chains. The mind provides its own.
fields.perks:skill_perks:where_i_meant_to_be#de: After leaving stealth, gain +15% Attack and +15% Dodge for 1 turn.
fields.perks:skill_perks:where_the_web_thins#de: AoE Sorcery spells gain +1 tile radius but cost 25% more mana.
fields.perks:skill_perks:where_the_web_thins#fl: The spell doesn't expand. The caster stops pretending the boundary was ever there.
fields.perks:skill_perks:where_there_is_smoke#d: Smoke areas deal 3 fire damage per turn and have a 20% chance per turn to ignite (become burning terrain).
fields.perks:skill_perks:where_you_thought_i_wa: When you successfully Dodge, 50% chance to reposition behind the attacker, dealing 50% of one dagger hit as damage on the way.
fields.perks:skill_perks:whirling_advance#desc: Active (4 Stamina). Move up to your full Speed and make a melee attack at any point during the movement.
fields.perks:skill_perks:wide_arc#desc: Axe attacks deal 50% damage to one adjacent enemy.
fields.perks:skill_perks:widened_grace#desc: Single-target healing spells also affect allies within 1 tile of the target at 50% effectiveness.
fields.perks:skill_perks:widened_space#desc: Passive. Your Space-tagged spells gain +1 tile of range. Movement and displacement effects carry targets or allies 1 additional tile.
fields.perks:skill_perks:widened_space#flavor: Space is not a container. It is a tendency.
fields.perks:skill_perks:wound_specialist#desc: Camp (Field Surgery): cures ALL wounds and diseases on the target regardless of their required Medicine level. Requires Field Surgery camp activity.
fields.perks:skill_perks:wound_specialist#flavo: Some cuts need more than a bandage.
fields.perks:skill_perks:zazouken#desc: False images now attack adjacent enemies for 30% of your damage. Still 1 HP.
fields.quests:cold_prisoner#description: A soul encased in ice begs for release. Somewhere in the cold hells lies the key.
fields.quests:ember_debt#description: A fire merchant claims a debt owed by a roaming demon. Collect it—by any means.
fields.quests:lost_mantra#description: A wandering hermit lost a scroll of protective mantras. Without it, the cold will claim him.
fields.skills:armor#desc: Proficiency with shields and protective gear
fields.skills:axes#desc: Proficiency with axes and heavy chopping weapons
fields.skills:comedy#desc: Wit, humor, and trickster dialogue options
fields.skills:daggers#desc: Proficiency with small blades and quick strikes
fields.skills:enchantment#desc: Status changes with duration - buffs like Stone Skin
fields.skills:leadership#desc: Inspire and command others in battle and beyond
fields.skills:learning#desc: Knowledge of the realms, monsters, and lore
fields.skills:logistics#desc: Reduces food consumption, increases overworld speed - consumes Food
fields.skills:maces#desc: Proficiency with blunt weapons and crushing strikes
fields.skills:martial_arts#desc: Transcendent fighting style - wuxia-inspired flying techniques
fields.skills:medicine#desc: Boosts party healing rate and potion effectiveness - consumes Herbs
fields.skills:might#desc: Physical feats of strength and endurance
fields.skills:performance#desc: Passionate artistic expression - song, dance, seduction
fields.skills:persuasion#desc: Convince others through words and presence
fields.skills:ranged#desc: Proficiency with bows, crossbows, and thrown weapons
fields.skills:ritual#desc: External ceremony - mandala creation, material components to enhance spells
fields.skills:smithing#desc: Passively repairs equipment and restores ammo - consumes Scrap
fields.skills:sorcery#desc: Direct magical power - instant effects like Fireball
fields.skills:space_magic#desc: Command over void, dimensions, and teleportation
fields.skills:spears#desc: Proficiency with spears, halberds, and polearms
fields.skills:summoning#desc: Calling creatures and objects into existence
fields.skills:swords#desc: Proficiency with bladed weapons - precision and clarity of strike
fields.skills:trade#desc: Negotiate better prices and find rare goods
fields.skills:unarmed#desc: Fighting with bare hands and natural weapons - passionate combat
fields.skills:yoga#desc: Internal cultivation, mantras, karma insight, pacifist dialogue options
fields.spells:a_vision_of_plenty#desc: Food enough for one good night, and herbs to go with it — topped up to exactly that and no further. It will not fill a storehouse; a caster who spends forty mana a night is not spending it elsewhere.
fields.spells:agnideva_lord#desc: Summon a powerful fire spirit lord
fields.spells:air:notes#general: Lightning spells have high damage, high cost, stun chance. Wind spells push/scatter enemies, dealing physical damage on impact. Buffs focus on ranged accuracy and speed.
fields.spells:air:notes#lightning_spells: Air damage with stun chance scaling with spellpower/upgrades
fields.spells:air:notes#stun_vs_freeze: Stun: 1 turn, save at end to break, no vulnerability. Freeze: can last longer, physical vulnerability, dispelled by fire.
fields.spells:air:notes#wind_spells: Physical damage from impacts/falls, scatter to random tiles
fields.spells:air_bomb#desc: Launch enemies into air, they take fall damage and scatter to random tiles
fields.spells:amrita#desc: Heal comparable to Greater Heal, death immunity for a few turns
fields.spells:ancestral_guidance#desc: Gain insight from ancestors, temporary Awareness and Focus buff
fields.spells:ancestral_spirit#desc: Summon an ancestral spirit to fight alongside you
fields.spells:ancestral_vengeance#desc: When an ally dies, gain attack and damage buff for several turns
fields.spells:apsara#desc: Summon an apsara that heals allies and charms enemies
fields.spells:aura_of_blessing#desc: Aura that grants Blessed to nearby allies
fields.spells:balefire#desc: Cursed fire that prevents resurrection, destroys corpse on kill
fields.spells:ball_lightning#desc: Persistent orb dealing lightning damage as it passes, explodes on obstacle or duration end
fields.spells:banishing_stake#desc: Extra damage to demons/spirits, instantly destroys summons
fields.spells:battle_chant#desc: +2 STR and +2 FIN for spellpower-based duration. A resonant chant that sharpens the body for combat.
fields.spells:bear#desc: Summon a great shaggy bear that has dwelt alone in the high peaks long enough to grow strange. High HP and physical damage; regenerates 1% max HP per turn.
fields.spells:begone#desc: The nearest creature is put somewhere else entirely — anywhere on this map. Gone from your road, and still in the world, possibly now across the one you meant to take.
fields.spells:behind_you#desc: Teleport directly behind target enemy. 'While you sit here making plans, the Lord of Death stands behind you, smacking his lips.'
fields.spells:bitter_word#desc: Speak a syllable of pure negation. Minor black damage; 50% chance to Silence for 1 turn (Focus save to resist). Against casters, this is harassment. Against mantras already in progress, it may be devastating.
fields.spells:black:notes#celestial_vulnerabili: Celestials have 50% black vulnerability (in race stats, not spell stats)
fields.spells:black:notes#curse_synergy: Many spells and upgrades benefit from debuffed targets
fields.spells:black:notes#general: Debuffs, undead/demon summons, and damage spells. Black and White are both natural parts of the world order.
fields.spells:black:notes#summons: Summoned from nothing, not from corpses
fields.spells:black_lightning#desc: Black damage + blind, like lightning but less damage
fields.spells:blazing_and_dripping#desc: +75% fire and water resistance, +3 FCS and +3 AWR for duration. The inner fire blazes from the secret chakra; the crown amrita melts and drips down into it, renewing the body.
fields.spells:blessed_shot#desc: Next ranged attack is guaranteed hit with boosted damage and critical
fields.spells:blessed_waters#desc: Remove burning, moderate heal in AoE
fields.spells:blessing_of_prithvi#desc: Boost Strength and Constitution, heal minor
fields.spells:blighted_ground#desc: Cursed ground debuffs all stats and poisons those standing on it
fields.spells:blizzard#desc: Ice damage + freeze chance in large AoE
fields.spells:blood_hunger#desc: Buff that grants lifesteal on all attacks
fields.spells:blur#desc: Shifting image grants dodge bonus, attacks have miss chance
fields.spells:boar#desc: Summon a spirit boar from the dreams of hunters. Charges on its first turn for heavy bonus damage, then fights as an aggressive melee attacker.
fields.spells:bone_chill#desc: Infuse the target with seeping cold. Reduces Dodge and Initiative — the chill reaches the marrow, slowing reflex and reaction alike.
fields.spells:bone_spike#desc: Bone erupts from ground, physical damage, bonus vs living creatures
fields.spells:breath_of_heaven#desc: Resurrect all fallen allies with partial HP
fields.spells:burning_weapon#desc: Add fire damage + burning to attacks
fields.spells:burrow#desc: Sink into the earth and surface beside the target, striking as you emerge.
fields.spells:camels_blessing#desc: Sand and hot stone carry you as a road would. Named for the only animal that crosses them without complaint.
fields.spells:cauterize#desc: Seal wounds with sacred fire. Deals minor fire damage and removes Bleeding and Poisoned.
fields.spells:chain_lightning#desc: Lightning that chains to nearby enemies, damage reduces per chain
fields.spells:chaos#desc: Target moves AND attacks/casts randomly - dangerous to everyone
fields.spells:chasm#desc: Damage and push enemies one tile, remains as obstacle
fields.spells:clarity#desc: Remove negative mental effects, boost Awareness
fields.spells:cleansing_fire#desc: A wave of purifying fire washes over the area. All allies are cleansed of every negative effect and gain the Cleansed status (2-turn immunity to debuffs). Enemies take minor fire damage.
fields.spells:clear_mind#desc: Clear all mental debuffs from target. Grant immunity to mental debuffs for 2–6 turns (scales with Enchantment skill and spellpower). Note: distinct from Clarity (Fire/White), which instead provides an Awareness buff.
fields.spells:cloud_gate#desc: Open a gate through the clouds. Teleports the entire party to the last teahouse, temple, or town visited. Works in and out of combat — a last resort as much as a convenience.
fields.spells:cloud_serpent#desc: Summon a cloud naga — a flying serpent of exceptional speed, initiative, and dodge. High damage output. Immune to ground effects.
fields.spells:cloudform#desc: The target's body disperses into cloud. Grants 100% immunity to physical and water damage; 50% vulnerability to fire damage. Duration scales with spellpower.
fields.spells:cloudstep#desc: Step through cloud. Instantly teleport to any tile within 5 tiles, ignoring height difference and line of sight. Cannot teleport into occupied tiles.
fields.spells:coil_of_the_naga#desc: A naga's coil closes on one body. The offended water spirits answer as Tibetan medicine says they do — with illness, and with the strength gone out of your limbs.
fields.spells:cone_of_frost#desc: Ice damage + freeze chance in cone
fields.spells:confusion#desc: Target moves randomly, can't act intentionally
fields.spells:crystal_diadem#desc: Crown the target with living crystal. Major Focus and Awareness bonus. 50% chance to shatter and be lost whenever the wearer takes damage.
fields.spells:crystal_guardian#desc: Grow an immobile crystal formation. High resistances to everything except crushing damage. Each turn it fires a space-damage laser at the nearest enemy.
fields.spells:crystal_light#desc: Flood the battlefield with pure crystal light. Instantly removes all stealth, invisibility, blur, smoke-form, and illusion effects from every unit on the field — allies and enemies alike.
fields.spells:cure#desc: Heal moderate HP and reliably remove one negative effect.
fields.spells:dagger_swarm#desc: Summon a swarm of ritual daggers that attack enemies
fields.spells:dampening_aura#desc: Aura reduces fire damage taken by allies, extinguishes burning
fields.spells:daughter_of_mara#desc: Summon a daughter of Mara - charms, dominates, casts mental debuffs and illusions
fields.spells:death_bolt#desc: Black damage, if it kills the target, raise them as allied zombie
fields.spells:death_rites#desc: Lay corpse to rest (prevents raising), nearby allies receive ancestor's blessing
fields.spells:death_shock#desc: Major black damage, if it kills, same damage to next nearest enemy
fields.spells:deathfog#desc: Cloud that instantly kills on failed Constitution save, damage otherwise
fields.spells:decoy#desc: Create illusory target that draws attacks, HP scales with spellpower
fields.spells:dimensional_anchor#desc: Lock down area - no teleportation, phasing, or fleeing for anyone
fields.spells:dimensional_rift#desc: Tear in space scatters enemies to random locations
fields.spells:dispel#desc: Remove all magical effects from target
fields.spells:divine_champion#desc: Considerably buff all of target's stats
fields.spells:divine_eye#desc: Target sees through all stealth, invisibility, blur, and illusion for the rest of combat. +50% range for ranged attacks and spells. Note: distinct from Crystal Light (Earth/Space), which dispels these effects once battlefield-wide rather than granting ongoing personal vision.
fields.spells:divine_inspiration#desc: Considerably buff target's two highest stats
fields.spells:divine_wrath#desc: Major AoE white damage, devastating to undead and demons
fields.spells:dominate#desc: If successful, target permanently joins party
fields.spells:doom#desc: Target dies after X turns unless cleansed
fields.spells:draw_out_the_venom#desc: Every affliction on an ally is drawn out whole and pressed into the nearest enemy — a cure that costs somebody else. Tibetan medicine holds that illness has an owner; this spell disagrees about who.
fields.spells:drown#desc: Trap in place for turns, sustained physical damage, dispellable
fields.spells:earthen_cross#desc: Physical damage in cross pattern, 5 tiles
fields.spells:earthen_pit#desc: Trap enemy for turns based on spellpower
fields.spells:eerie_dirge#desc: -2 CON and -2 FCS for spellpower-based duration. A low, sourceless tone that unsettles the body and mind.
fields.spells:eldritch_guardian#desc: Summon a powerful being from the Outer Night
fields.spells:eldritch_spawn#desc: Summon a mass of tentacles and eyes from the Outer Night
fields.spells:electrify_weapon#desc: Add air damage + stun chance to attacks
fields.spells:ember#desc: Re-ignite enemies who were burning recently (within 2 turns)
fields.spells:eternal_vow#desc: When target dies, they return next turn with 20% HP
fields.spells:exploit_weakness#desc: Black damage, bonus damage for each debuff on target
fields.spells:false_terrain#desc: Make area look different - hide traps, create illusory walls
fields.spells:fan_the_flames#desc: Increase burning damage dealt by target's attacks
fields.spells:favorable_wind#desc: Aura granting haste and precision to nearby allies
fields.spells:festering_wound#desc: Poison DoT that increases each turn
fields.spells:fire:notes#burning: Stacks. Small chance to spread in melee (spreads base level only, not full stack).
fields.spells:fire:notes#general: Moderate damage in big AoE with burning DoT. Charm/magnetizing effects from Padma (Lotus) family.
fields.spells:firestorm#desc: Large AoE, major fire damage + burning
fields.spells:flash_freeze#desc: A sudden snap of cold flash-freezes all enemies in the area. No damage — pure CC. Hard Finesse save to resist. Pairs with Permafrost and other freeze-damage synergies.
fields.spells:flash_of_radiance#desc: Remove all debuffs from self. Each debuff removed becomes a bolt of white radiance striking all enemies in a 2-tile radius for light white damage. CON save or blinded 1 turn.
fields.spells:flash_step#desc: Short-range teleport, leave fire damage at departure point
fields.spells:fluid_form#desc: Immunity to physical and water damage, vulnerable to fire
fields.spells:following_wind#desc: The wind turns and stays turned. The party crosses ground forty percent faster for as long as it holds — named for what you want, not for a headwind, which is the one against you.
fields.spells:fools_gold#desc: Illusion of treasure that lures enemies
fields.spells:forgetfulness#desc: Enemy can move but can't attack or cast for 1 turn
fields.spells:fragrant_sauna#desc: Envelop allies in healing steam — remove Burning and Poisoned, restore all stamina, heal a little HP
fields.spells:freedom#desc: Remove paralysis, slow, root, and earthbound effects
fields.spells:frog#desc: Summon a sleek servant of the serpent king. Weak in combat, but immune to poison and water; on death, it contaminates the tile with toxin for several turns.
fields.spells:funeral_pyre#desc: Corpse disappears in white/fire explosion, damages all enemies nearby, bonus vs undead
fields.spells:fungal_zombie#desc: Cast on corpse - rises as slow summon with high HP, low damage, poisons
fields.spells:gandharva_host#desc: Summon gandharvas that buff and heal allies
fields.spells:geyser#desc: Superheated geyser erupts at target location in a cross AoE — moderate fire damage and throws each target 2-3 tiles in a random direction; bonus damage if thrown into a wall
fields.spells:ghost_shoal#desc: 3-4 tile wide band of ghost fish sweeps battlefield, water damage + Confusion
fields.spells:glass_mine#desc: Place an invisible glass mine on the ground. Explodes on enemy contact: moderate slashing damage + guaranteed Bleeding to all within 2 tiles.
fields.spells:glass_shard#desc: Conjure a shard of glass and drive it into an enemy at melee range. Light slashing damage, guaranteed Bleeding.
fields.spells:globe_of_glass#desc: Encase an ally in a globe of conjured glass. Provides minor armor. When the target takes any damage, the globe shatters outward: moderate slashing damage + guaranteed Bleeding to all enemies within 2 tiles.
fields.spells:godling#desc: Summon a godling - small luminous humanoid in silks, heals and buffs, dissipates into light
fields.spells:golden_blade#desc: Strike with a blade of transmuted gold. Deals heavy physical damage. Kills leave the corpse gilded — adds bonus gold to post-combat loot.
fields.spells:golden_cage#desc: Imprison the target in a cage of living gold. When the cage breaks or the effect ends — gold dust falls. Adds a small gold bonus to post-combat loot.
fields.spells:grave_soil#desc: Curse the ground. Nothing happens while you stand here — but an enemy that falls on it gets up again on your side. A trap rather than a hazard: its value is deciding where the fighting goes.
fields.spells:guiding_light#desc: Summon minor spirit that provides vision and small buff
fields.spells:gust_of_wind#desc: Push enemies in cone, physical damage on obstacle impact
fields.spells:hail_storm#desc: Ice damage + freeze chance in AoE
fields.spells:hands_of_the_damned#desc: Black damage and fear in AoE
fields.spells:hands_of_the_drowned#desc: Hold enemies in AoE, water damage per turn, Strength save to escape, slowed after escape
fields.spells:healers_touch#desc: Lay hands on the target with focused intent. Restores moderate HP and 20% of max Stamina — useful for fighters who have spent themselves as much as those who've taken wounds.
fields.spells:heat_ray#desc: Line from caster, damages all in path
fields.spells:heat_transfer#desc: Transfer all burning stacks from all allies to enemies, distributed evenly. No stacks are lost.
fields.spells:herbal_remedy#desc: Heal minor HP, remove bleeding and poison
fields.spells:holy_light#desc: AoE white damage, bonus vs undead and demons
fields.spells:honored_dead#desc: Summon a host of buffed ancestral spirits
fields.spells:host_of_kinnaras#desc: Summon several kinnaras with healing, ranged, and melee capabilities
fields.spells:ice_age#desc: Global freeze and ice damage to all enemies
fields.spells:ice_totem#desc: Static turret that shoots ice bolts with low damage but freeze chance
fields.spells:ignite#desc: Set enemies in FoV on fire
fields.spells:imp#desc: Summon an imp - flying, high dodge, low damage, annoying
fields.spells:imp_collector#desc: Summon an imp collector that constantly spawns imps
fields.spells:implosion#desc: Massive single-target damage, scales heavily with spellpower
fields.spells:infect#desc: Enemy spawns Fungal Spawn after 3 turns dealing damage and bleed, cleansable
fields.spells:inner_flame#desc: +25% fire and water resistance for duration. While active, enemies that strike you in melee receive 1 burning stack — the body radiates heat.
fields.spells:insect_swarm#desc: 1 physical damage per turn, disrupts mantras/rituals with focus saves
fields.spells:intervention#desc: Something older than you takes an interest. The party is pulled to the nearest town, teahouse or market, however far that is.
fields.spells:invisibility#desc: Target becomes invisible, broken by offensive action
fields.spells:invulnerability#desc: Complete immunity to damage for short duration
fields.spells:jump#desc: Leap to target location, ignoring terrain
fields.spells:karmic_bond#desc: Link two allies, both receive 75% of any healing to either
fields.spells:kinnara#desc: Summon a kinnara - man-bird hybrid, fast, defensive, support
fields.spells:lava_walking#desc: Walk on molten stone as on a road. The only way across lava that is not flight, and the only mobility magic Fire has.
fields.spells:liberate#desc: Instant death on failed Focus save if below HP threshold (scales with spellpower), 50% max HP damage on passed save
fields.spells:lifelink#desc: Gain 50% of damage dealt as HP
fields.spells:lightning#desc: High air damage with stun chance
fields.spells:lightning_form#desc: Immunity to air, 50% physical immunity, 50% water vulnerability, flight, lightning aura damages and stuns nearby
fields.spells:magic_mirror#desc: Chance to reflect spells back to caster (spellpower vs spellpower)
fields.spells:magnetizing_aura#desc: Chance to charm enemies entering melee
fields.spells:mamo#desc: Summon a mamo hag that attacks with Black, Space, and poison magic
fields.spells:mana_drain#desc: Draw the mana out of another caster and keep it. Takes most of what they are holding, so a full reservoir is worth more than a spent one.
fields.spells:mana_flare#desc: Remove some mana and deal space damage
fields.spells:mantric_armor#desc: HP shield based on spellpower, 25% elemental resistance, must be destroyed before caster takes damage
fields.spells:mara#desc: Summon a mara - black devil with mental manipulation, illusions, and summoning
fields.spells:mark_for_death#desc: Mark a target with the sigil of ending. No damage — but the next time the target is struck, that hit deals 50% additional damage of its original type. Consumed on trigger. The mark lasts up to 3 turns.
fields.spells:marshtread#desc: Bog and snowdrift hold your weight. Ground that gives way stops costing you the day.
fields.spells:metal_to_mud#desc: Metal corrodes into useless mud. On failed Constitution save: reduces target's damage output and armor.
fields.spells:meteor_shower#desc: Massive fire and physical damage in large area
fields.spells:miasma#desc: Persistent poison cloud, damage + poisoned + slowed
fields.spells:midas_touch#desc: The target turns to soft gold from the inside. A hard Constitution save resists it entirely; failing it is death, and what is left is worth taking.
fields.spells:mindmuck#desc: Flood a single mind with filth and confusion. Major debuff to Awareness and Focus. No save.
fields.spells:mirror_image#desc: Create illusory copies, attacks may hit copies instead
fields.spells:mirror_scrying#desc: Hold up the melong and the whole country appears in it: ground, roads, every place and every creature on them. Space, because the mirror does not look out — it looks across.
fields.spells:misdirection#desc: Fold the ground under the nearest creature and it is somewhere else — five to eight tiles off, and you do not choose where.
fields.spells:mud#desc: Call up a patch of sucking mud. Characters moving through it are Slowed each turn they remain inside.
fields.spells:mudling#desc: Summon 3 Mudlings. High HP, physical resistance, slow on hit. Low damage.
fields.spells:mudra_of_touching_the_earth#desc: Earthquake damages all enemies, heals all allies, destroys random obstacles
fields.spells:nail_the_shadow#desc: Pin enemy's shadow - rooted, takes damage if they try to move
fields.spells:nail_the_sun#desc: Pin time itself in place. Every other combatant loses their next turn, so the caster acts again before anyone moves. As Tilopa once nailed the sun to the sky to drink till sundown.
fields.spells:nailing_dagger#desc: Summon a ritual dagger spirit that pins and binds enemies
fields.spells:pacify#desc: Chance to make enemy disengage from combat
fields.spells:pain_mirror#desc: Deal 50% of damage taken back to attacker
fields.spells:peace#desc: The nearest creature lies down and sleeps for five steps. It does not follow, and it does not wake when you walk past it.
fields.spells:pervasive_chill#desc: Slow and reduce dodge in AoE
fields.spells:pervasive_rot#desc: Debuff all attributes and deal black damage over time
fields.spells:petrify#desc: Disable enemy, resistible, lower cost than Midas Touch
fields.spells:phantasm#desc: Illusion of enemy's fear, space damage + fear
fields.spells:phase_wind#desc: Allies in area gain 25% physical damage negation
fields.spells:plague_waters#desc: Disease that spreads between adjacent enemies each turn, poison damage + diseased (stat penalties + DoT)
fields.spells:planar_shift#desc: The party falls sideways out of this world into another — any other, including ones they have no right to be in — and is pulled back after thirty steps. A way to see somewhere, or to stop being where you are.
fields.spells:poisonous_cloud#desc: Cloud that damages and poisons enemies inside
fields.spells:portal#desc: Open a way onto a plane the party has never reached, and leave it open. The realm is unlocked for good — the only means of reaching one without walking the road that leads there.
fields.spells:powdered_glass#desc: Scatter powdered glass in a cone in front of the caster. All enemies in the cone are Blinded for 3 turns.
fields.spells:precision#desc: Range, accuracy, and critical boost for ranged attacks
fields.spells:psychic_tremor#desc: Major space damage in large AoE
fields.spells:puppet#desc: Summon animated puppet with White and Black magic
fields.spells:radiance#desc: Aura heals allies, stuns enemies in melee
fields.spells:radiant_visage#desc: Radiate light in a 2-tile radius. Allies within are immune to mental debuffs, gain 2 Initiative, and carry 10 extra health while they stand in it.
fields.spells:rahulas_cloak#desc: Nothing on the road sees the party. Creatures do not notice them, those already hunting lose the trail, and walking into something starts no fight. It does not last.
fields.spells:rain#desc: Reduce movement and range in AoE
fields.spells:rain_of_mud#desc: A torrent of mud. Each enemy failing a Finesse save is blinded or slowed, and the ground stays mud afterwards — for everyone, which is the interesting half of casting it.
fields.spells:rain_of_revival#desc: Moderate heal, buff initiative, add one action in AoE
fields.spells:rainbow_cloak#desc: Wrap yourself in a mantle of prismatic light. Gain 50% resistance to all elemental damage. Each incoming hit has a 10% chance to reflect 50% of the damage back to the source.
fields.spells:rainbow_orb#desc: A shimmering orb of prismatic light. Each of four effects triggers independently at 25% chance: moderate damage of a random elemental type, Blind, Confuse, or Charm.
fields.spells:rainbow_spray#desc: A cone of prismatic light. Each target independently rolls each of four effects at 25% chance: moderate elemental damage of a random type, Blind, Confuse, or Charm.
fields.spells:rejuvenate#desc: Completely heal and remove all negative effects
fields.spells:resurrect#desc: Raise dead ally with full HP
fields.spells:ripple#desc: Push all around caster 2-3 tiles, minor damage
fields.spells:rot_wood#desc: Reduce ranged attack and damage by 50%
fields.spells:rust_metal#desc: Reduce melee attack and armor by 50%
fields.spells:sacred_ground#desc: Heals and blesses allies in area
fields.spells:sanctuary#desc: Target can't be targeted or target enemies, breaks on offensive action
fields.spells:scalding_fog#desc: Summon a persistent cloud of scalding fog. Each turn a creature spends inside it, the damage grows: turn_in_fog × 5 fire damage — light at first, searing by the end
fields.spells:scattered_light#desc: Shatter light into the eyes of all nearby enemies. Light space damage; 50% chance to Blind for 1 turn (Awareness save).
fields.spells:searing_orb#desc: Slow projectile, stays 3-4 turns, AoE fire damage + burning each turn
fields.spells:second_wind#desc: Grant one additional action this turn
fields.spells:sense_danger#desc: Every creature within sixteen tiles, seen or unseen. Turns a blind march into a decision.
fields.spells:shimmer#desc: Minor dodge buff, attackers are briefly dazzled (accuracy penalty on next attack)
fields.spells:shining_mirage#desc: Each enemy must make a FCS save at the start of their turn or be confused for 1 turn. Each passed save reduces that enemy's personal DC by 2 as they pierce the mirage.
fields.spells:shocking_grasp#desc: Melee-range air damage with stun chance
fields.spells:shroud_of_darkness#desc: Darkness that obscures both ways. Your people inside are cloaked in shadow; theirs cannot shoot what they cannot see.
fields.spells:singing_birds#desc: Summon singing birds that buff and boost morale
fields.spells:sleet#desc: A slashing sleet of ice crystals falls across the area, dealing water damage and coating the ground. Enemies moving over the terrain risk falling (Prone).
fields.spells:slow#desc: The weight of accumulated karma drags on the target's limbs. Reduces movement speed. (Displays: Slowed)
fields.spells:smite#desc: White damage, bonus vs undead and demons
fields.spells:smoke_form#desc: Target becomes smoke, gains evasion, can move through enemies, 25% water vulnerability
fields.spells:solar_form#desc: Blind and damage close enemies, fire immunity, water vulnerability
fields.spells:song_of_peace#desc: Strong pacify effect on all enemies in range
fields.spells:sonic_boom#desc: Moderate space damage in a 2-tile radius around the caster. CON save or stunned 1 turn.
fields.spells:soothing_presence#desc: Aura that heals allies each turn
fields.spells:soul_burn#desc: Fire DoT that deals more damage for each debuff on target
fields.spells:space:notes#dagger_theme: Phurba/Nailing Dagger spells - pinning, binding, subjugating hostile forces
fields.spells:space:notes#general: Utility with teleportation, mental manipulation crossovers, illusion spells, and basic reliable damage. Magic Missile style spells are moderate and useful for everyone.
fields.spells:space_swap#desc: Trade places with another character anywhere in sight — ally or enemy. The caster and the target swap tiles instantly.
fields.spells:spellstrike#desc: Strip magical defenses, damage increased per buff removed
fields.spells:spontaneous_combustion#desc: Burning enemy explodes, removes burning stacks
fields.spells:spore_explosion#desc: AoE - Infect on living creatures, Fungal Zombie on corpses
fields.spells:stake_the_threshold#desc: Place dagger on ground, enemies crossing take space damage and are slowed
fields.spells:steal_air#desc: Draw the vital wind (prana) out of the target's breath. Deals physical damage and drains Stamina.
fields.spells:steal_blessings#desc: Remove buffs from enemy and gain them yourself
fields.spells:steam_jet#desc: Blast of scalding steam in a 3-tile line from the caster toward the cursor — moderate fire damage to all in the path
fields.spells:stone_shell#desc: Protective HP barrier around target, traps but allows casting
fields.spells:storm_lord#desc: Lightning aura damages attackers, flight, immunity to ranged
fields.spells:suffocate#desc: Silence + physical damage over time, Constitution save
fields.spells:sunrise#desc: Major fire/white damage to all enemies, heal allies
fields.spells:surge#desc: Push one enemy in melee 1 tile, minor damage
fields.spells:survey_the_land#desc: Every place worth walking to within twenty-six tiles — shops, shrines, temples, portals and what has been left lying about.
fields.spells:teleport#desc: Step across up to fifteen tiles of the map to any ground you can stand on. In a fight it moves only the caster; out of one it takes the party.
fields.spells:thin_air#desc: Immunity to physical damage, cannot deal physical, major speed boost
fields.spells:thunderclap#desc: Air damage + stun chance in AoE around caster
fields.spells:thunderstorm#desc: Major air damage with stun chance in large AoE
fields.spells:tongues_of_fire#desc: Unleash 2–5 tongues of flame (count scales with spellpower). Each tongue is aimed separately at any enemy in range, dealing fire damage and applying Burning. Concentrate on one target or spread the pain.
fields.spells:tornado#desc: A tornado that will not stay where you put it. It wanders a tile a round, hurts everyone it touches — your people included — and throws whoever it catches.
fields.spells:trickster_mask#desc: Summon floating mask - low HP, high dodge, blinks around casting CC and mental spells
fields.spells:troupe_of_puppets#desc: Summon a troupe of animated puppets
fields.spells:tsunami#desc: Long vertical line, pushes far based on spellpower, moderate damage on obstacle hit
fields.spells:turn_undead#desc: Destroy weak undead, cause fear in strong undead (Focus save). Does not affect undead allies.
fields.spells:undead_host#desc: Summon a host of powerful undead
fields.spells:undead_yogi#desc: Summon an undead yogi - lich-like caster with Black and various elemental magic
fields.spells:unseen_servant#desc: Summon an invisible servant for utility tasks
fields.spells:up_to_eleven#desc: The sound hits everything. All enemies make a hard CON save or are stunned 1 turn. All allies take 1 turn of disorientation (−2 AWR, −2 Initiative) — no save. The caster is the source and feels nothing.
fields.spells:vajra_binding#desc: Target bound by vajra chains, rooted + silenced
fields.spells:vajra_gate#desc: Create a short-duration portal between two points marked by vajras
fields.spells:vajra_mandala#desc: A circle of orbiting vajras. Allies inside take a third less magic damage and cast with +3 spellpower from the consecrated circle; enemies pay crushing damage and a chance of freezing every time they cross the line.
fields.spells:vajra_rain#desc: Multiple vajras rain down, water damage + freeze + knockdown
fields.spells:vajra_strike#desc: A vajra falls like a meteor, water damage + stun
fields.spells:vampire_bats#desc: Summon a swarm of vampire bats
fields.spells:vaporize#desc: Massive fire damage to one target
fields.spells:venomous_tide#desc: Wave of poisonous water, poison damage + poisoned + push
fields.spells:venus_flytrap#desc: Summon a living, moving carnivorous plant
fields.spells:vetala#desc: Summon a vetala - casts Black, Fire, and one random element, has vampiric attacks
fields.spells:vine_trap#desc: Create a trap that roots enemies
fields.spells:vision_of_reality#desc: A flash of pure awareness. All allies receive a light heal and have all debuffs lifted. All enemies simultaneously receive the Rainbow Orb — each of its four effects rolling independently per target.
fields.spells:void_gust#desc: Wind carrying void energy, push + space damage
fields.spells:voidbolt#desc: Fire a bolt of void-darkness at the target. Reliable single-target black damage.
fields.spells:voidstorm#desc: Major black damage in large AoE
fields.spells:water:notes#general: Less damage than other schools, focuses on crowd control
fields.spells:water:notes#ice_spells: Have freeze chance, scaling with upgrades
fields.spells:water:notes#push_spells: Deal bonus physical damage if enemy hits obstacle
fields.spells:water:notes#vajra_spells: Water-Space crossover. Vajra (thunderbolt/diamond) themed spells with stun, binding, and portal effects
fields.spells:water_walking#desc: Ignore water terrain hazards, walk on water
fields.spells:wave#desc: 3 tiles wide, push based on spellpower, minor damage
fields.spells:wayfinding#desc: Find the nearest shelter — a town, a shop, a teahouse — however far it lies, and which way to walk.
fields.spells:white:notes#ancestral_theme: White-Black crossover focuses on respectful dealings with the dead, ancestor veneration
fields.spells:white:notes#anti_undead_demon: White damage is especially effective against undead and demons
fields.spells:white:notes#general: Healing and buffs primarily, with some damage spells effective against undead and demons who have white vulnerability. White and Black are both natural parts of the world order.
fields.spells:wilting_curse#desc: Major damage on failed Constitution save to all living enemies by evaporating water; 2x damage to water creatures, no damage to fire elementals/undead/constructs
fields.spells:witch_fire#desc: Fire that spreads to nearby cursed/debuffed targets
fields.spells:wrathful_binding#desc: Dagger orbits target, continuous damage, can't teleport or flee
fields.statuses:134#desc: Held in a grapple — cannot move; attackers get +30% accuracy.
fields.statuses:135#desc: The next attack made by this unit automatically misses.
fields.statuses:136#desc: Compelled to target the unit that applied this taunt.
fields.statuses:138#desc: Weapon torn from grasp — cannot make weapon attacks. Can still cast spells and move.
fields.statuses:139#desc: Mind clouded with filth — major penalty to Awareness and Focus.
fields.statuses:140#desc: Encased in a globe of conjured glass. Shatters on any damage received, dealing slashing AoE + guaranteed bleed to all within 2 tiles.
fields.statuses:141#desc: Crown of living crystal: major Focus and Awareness bonus. 50% chance to shatter and be lost whenever the wearer takes damage.
fields.statuses:148#desc: Reduced initiative, acts later in turn order.
fields.statuses:149#desc: All debuffs removed. Immune to new debuffs for 1 turn.
fields.statuses:150#desc: Immune to charm, fear, and confusion effects.
fields.statuses:152#desc: Marked target takes 25% more damage and is more vulnerable to critical hits.
fields.statuses:153#desc: Shimmering cloak of prismatic light grants resistance to all elements and a dodge bonus.
fields.statuses:169#desc: A standing light that mends companions and dazzles whoever comes close.
fields.statuses:170#desc: The caster's face shines; those near it are hard to frighten or deceive.
fields.statuses:171#desc: Pinned to this plane. Cannot blink, teleport, swap or be scattered — though a shove still works, because being nailed to the world does not make you heavy.
fields.statuses:172#desc: Inner heat. Fire and water both find less purchase, and whoever strikes you in close catches light.
fields.statuses:173#desc: The caster's outline swims and doubles. Those who look at it lose track of themselves — until they learn to look past it.
fields.statuses:174#desc: Held outside the moment. Not stunned, not held — simply not yet. Nothing shakes this off, because there is no time in which to do so.
fields.statuses:175#desc: Ears ringing, footing uncertain. Everything is a little harder for a moment.
fields.statuses:176#desc: The ground runs molten and does not care. Fire has no mobility magic of its own; this is the whole of it.
fields.statuses:177#desc: Ground that gives way holds you up. Bog and deep snow are the same problem.
fields.statuses:178#desc: Loose burning ground carries you as a road would.
fields.statuses:179#desc: The air moves with the party rather than against it. Ground goes by faster.
fields.statuses:180#desc: Nothing on the road notices the party pass. Rāhu swallows the sun and is not observed doing it.
fields.statuses:181#desc: Blade held ready. The first blow each attacker throws is answered.
fields.statuses:182#desc: Standing over someone. Whoever comes for them comes past you first.
fields.statuses:183#desc: Butt of the spear in the dirt. Whatever runs onto it runs onto it hard.
fields.statuses:184#desc: Ground you have already decided about. Three shots, and then you are reloading.
fields.statuses:185#desc: The blow arrives and finds nobody there. You are already elsewhere, and already answering.
fields.statuses:186#desc: The reach of a spear, declared as a rule rather than a threat.
fields.statuses:187#desc: Standing in front of somebody. Harder to put down for it.
fields.supplies:food#description: Consumed each overworld step per party member. Without food, passive healing stops; prolonged starvation drains HP.
fields.supplies:herbs#description: Consumed by the Medicine passive to boost party healing on the overworld. When depleted, bonus healing stops but base healing continues.
fields.supplies:reagents#description: Consumed by Alchemy to passively brew potions, bombs, and oils on the overworld. Can be toggled off to save for active crafting.
fields.supplies:scrap#description: Consumed by the Smithing passive to repair equipment durability and restore ranged ammo. When depleted, repair and ammo restore stop.
fields.talisman:perk:air_brand#description: Attacks deal +10% base damage as bonus lightning damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:air_brand_greater#descript: Attacks deal +15% base damage as bonus lightning damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:air_brand_minor#descriptio: Attacks deal +5% base damage as bonus lightning damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:earth_brand#description: Attacks deal +10% base damage as bonus crushing damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:earth_brand_greater#descri: Attacks deal +15% base damage as bonus crushing damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:earth_brand_minor#descript: Attacks deal +5% base damage as bonus crushing damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:fire_brand#description: Attacks deal +10% base damage as bonus fire damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:fire_brand_greater#descrip: Attacks deal +15% base damage as bonus fire damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:fire_brand_minor#descripti: Attacks deal +5% base damage as bonus fire damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:lifesteal#description: Heal for 15% of damage dealt by attacks
fields.talisman:perk:magic_mirror#description: 10% chance to reflect hostile incoming spells back at the caster
fields.talisman:perk:mana_cascade#description: Regenerate 7% of max mana per turn, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:mana_stream#description: Regenerate 4% of max mana per turn, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:mana_trickle#description: Regenerate 2% of max mana per turn, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:mental_immune#description: Immune to all mental effects (Fear, Charm, Confusion, Berserk)
fields.talisman:perk:phys_brand#description: Attacks deal +10% base damage as bonus physical damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:phys_brand_greater#descrip: Attacks deal +15% base damage as bonus physical damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:phys_brand_minor#descripti: Attacks deal +5% base damage as bonus physical damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:poison_brand#description: Attacks deal +10% base damage as poison and 10% chance to inflict Poisoned, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:poison_brand_greater#descr: Attacks deal +15% base damage as poison and 15% chance to inflict Poisoned, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:poison_brand_minor#descrip: Attacks deal +5% base damage as poison and 5% chance to inflict Poisoned, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:regen_greater#description: Regenerate 7% of max HP per turn, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:regen_minor#description: Regenerate 2% of max HP per turn, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:regen_moderate#description: Regenerate 4% of max HP per turn, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:risen_dead#description: 15% chance that enemies slain by this character rise as allied undead for the remainder of combat
fields.talisman:perk:space_brand#description: Attacks deal +10% base damage as bonus space damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:space_brand_greater#descri: Attacks deal +15% base damage as bonus space damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:space_brand_minor#descript: Attacks deal +5% base damage as bonus space damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:water_brand#description: Attacks deal +10% base damage as bonus ice damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:water_brand_greater#descri: Attacks deal +15% base damage as bonus ice damage, rounded up
fields.talisman:perk:water_brand_minor#descript: Attacks deal +5% base damage as bonus ice damage, rounded up
fields.traits:addiction#desc: Dependent on something — herbs, drink, or something stranger.
fields.traits:ancient_memory#desc: Long ages of accumulated experience have sharpened recall and insight. What others learn in a lifetime, this being has lived through many times over.
fields.traits:aquatic#desc: Born of the water. Breathes and moves freely in aquatic environments. If the entire party shares this trait, the party may traverse water tiles without penalty in both combat and overworld.
fields.traits:armored#desc: Dense natural plating — chitin, thick hide, or bone — makes this creature hard to put down.
fields.traits:ascetic#desc: Eats little, sleeps hard, and wants less than the people around them.
fields.traits:ash_marked#desc: Has done the purification rites often enough to stop finding them strange.
fields.traits:attractive#desc: A pleasing appearance opens many doors.
fields.traits:beast_tender#desc: Good with animals, and they appear to know it right away.
fields.traits:beauty_struck#desc: Saw something that quietly reordered what they had thought possible.
fields.traits:better_starting_weapon#desc: Some lives grant wisdom, others grief - this one grants you a superior weapon.
fields.traits:bhang_enjoyer#desc: Takes it only at the festivals - and isn't every day a festival of its own kind?
fields.traits:bird_lover#desc: Aren't those beady eyes just adorable?
fields.traits:blood_handed#desc: Has taken lives that weigh on the soul.
fields.traits:bloodied#desc: Has killed something that everyone agreed could not be killed.
fields.traits:braggart#desc: Improves the story a little every time it is told.
fields.traits:bulky#desc: A massive build that weathers punishment others could not survive.
fields.traits:celebrant#desc: Takes uncomplicated pleasure in other people's luck.
fields.traits:clear_eyed#desc: Sees what is in front of them without dressing it up.
fields.traits:clubfooted#desc: An awkward gait that hampers quick movement.
fields.traits:collector#desc: Compelled to gather and catalogue curious objects.
fields.traits:colony_mind#desc: Born into a collective, this creature is never truly alone. Shared purpose dampens individual anxiety.
fields.traits:composed#desc: A hard-won calm. Seldom ruffled by what once would have stung.
fields.traits:content#desc: When you don't have what you like, like what you have.
fields.traits:corpse_rider#desc: Wears the dead the way others wear a coat, and has worn many. Something of each one stays behind in the way the hands move.
fields.traits:covetous#desc: Measures their life against other people's, and comes up short every time.
fields.traits:craven#desc: Runs first and reasons afterwards. Whatever else is true, nothing has ever caught them.
fields.traits:death_touched#desc: Was owed to something, and was not collected. It has changed how they walk into rooms.
fields.traits:debtor#desc: Owes money somewhere, to someone with an unusually long memory.
fields.traits:deep_current#desc: Thinks in pressures and distances no surface creature has words for. The magic that comes of it is correspondingly difficult to explain and difficult to argue with.
fields.traits:devout#desc: A sincere and practiced faith shapes every act.
fields.traits:dreamer#desc: Feels more at home among the visions than the flesh.
fields.traits:drunk#desc: Past enjoying it, now it's just an everyday fact.
fields.traits:duelist#desc: Prides themselves on never turning down a challenge.
fields.traits:early_riser#desc: Early bird gets to gloat when others wake up.
fields.traits:enlightened_insight#desc: A rare flash of clarity left a permanent mark.
fields.traits:extra_starting_gold#desc: Maybe they inherited it, maybe they've hoarded it by themselves - the important part is the weight of the purse.
fields.traits:fastidious#desc: Particular about cleanliness and order; unsettled by squalor.
fields.traits:first_to_know#desc: The head comes up before the sound arrives. Alertness inherited rather than learned.
fields.traits:flirt#desc: Incurably charming, and worst of all at the least convenient moments.
fields.traits:flying#desc: Sustained winged flight. If the entire party shares this trait, the party may traverse air tiles and elevated terrain in combat and overworld.
fields.traits:forgetful#desc: Details slip away; rarely remembers what was said.
fields.traits:frail#desc: A fragile constitution, easily tired and slow to heal.
fields.traits:gambler#desc: Did you know most gamblers walk away from the table right before a big win?
fields.traits:generous#desc: Gives freely, expects little in return.
fields.traits:gossip#desc: Knows everyone's business within a day of arriving anywhere.
fields.traits:gourmand#desc: Takes great pleasure in fine food and good company at table.
fields.traits:greedy#desc: Always calculating what they stand to gain.
fields.traits:grief_struck#desc: Carrying a loss that has not yet found its shape.
fields.traits:grudge_bearer#desc: Forgets nothing that was done to them, and keeps the ledger current.
fields.traits:guardian_geas#desc: Bound to a place, a hoard, or a promise made before memory. The binding is not resented; it is the shape of the self. Ask what is being guarded and the answer comes back older than the question.
fields.traits:hard_of_hearing#desc: Weary of asking others to repeat themselves, they begrudgingly accepted their condition.
fields.traits:harrowed#desc: Something happened. They have not described it, and are not going to.
fields.traits:haunted#desc: Disturbing memories surface at the worst moments.
fields.traits:hell_born#desc: Forged in the fires and torments of hell. Instinctively at home in its rabid violence and hierarchy.
fields.traits:hoard_keeper#desc: Wealth is not spent here, it is accumulated and remembered. Every piece of it has a provenance, and the provenance is the point.
fields.traits:homesick#desc: The farther away you are from your home, the easier it is to see it through rose-colored glasses.
fields.traits:hot_tempered#desc: Quick to anger, slow to forgive.
fields.traits:hunter#desc: Reads ground the way other people read letters. Knows what passed, how long ago, and whether it was hungry.
fields.traits:hunters_yoga#desc: Lifetimes of the twisted disciplines — breath held to stillness, hunger cultivated rather than sated, the body worked into a shape that only makes sense mid-leap. It is a real practice. It is simply pointed the wrong way.
fields.traits:impaired_vision#desc: Struggles in the dark, misses details and enemies.
fields.traits:incorporeal#desc: Barely present in the physical world — more dissolution than body. Food, wealth and violence seem somehow exotic.
fields.traits:incurious#desc: At first, asking questions was difficult, then it became impossible.
fields.traits:insatiable#desc: Mouth like a gate, throat like a needle.
fields.traits:lapsed#desc: Once practiced, now adrift. The forms remain but the heart has gone.
fields.traits:light_sleeper#desc: Sleep with one eye open, gripping the pillow tight.
fields.traits:long_marched#desc: Has been on the road long enough to stop thinking of settling down.
fields.traits:maimed#desc: Something is gone that used to be there. Warmth still seems to linger in the void.
fields.traits:mantra_worn#desc: Has said it enough times that it says itself now, under everything else.
fields.traits:melancholic#desc: A deep sadness runs beneath the surface.
fields.traits:merciful#desc: Has spared someone who could not have stopped them.
fields.traits:mourner#desc: Keeps the dead's days. Leaves food out on the right nights, wherever they are.
fields.traits:night_drinker#desc: When the sun goes down, the glass goes up.
fields.traits:night_owl#desc: The owl of wisdom flies after midnight.
fields.traits:night_vision#desc: Sees equally in darkness and light, perceiving what others miss.
fields.traits:nimble_mischief#desc: Quick hands and a quicker mind.
fields.traits:oath_breaker#desc: Has broken a solemn vow. The weight of it is visible.
fields.traits:oath_keeper#desc: Has held to a vow through the circumstances that made holding it expensive.
fields.traits:paranoid#desc: Always watching. Always expecting the worst. Wait, did you hear that?
fields.traits:patient#desc: Once you endure the first impulse, you can wait almost indefinitely.
fields.traits:pet_lover#desc: Has never once passed an animal without stopping.
fields.traits:pilgrim#desc: The party schedule will wait, the shrine must be circumambulated.
fields.traits:poet#desc: Composes constantly in their head, and occasionally, without warning, out loud.
fields.traits:predator_grace#desc: The natural speed and precision of a born hunter.
fields.traits:quick#desc: Naturally fast reflexes and light feet.
fields.traits:renunciate#desc: Has put down something they wanted badly, on purpose, and did not pick it back up.
fields.traits:scarred#desc: The wound closed. The body it closed on is not quite the one they had before.
fields.traits:scrimper#desc: Cannot part with money without a grimace.
fields.traits:secret_bearer#desc: Carrying something they have told nobody, and have no plans to.
fields.traits:serpentine#desc: A body built for water and coiling grace, equally at home in the deep as on land.
fields.traits:sole_survivor#desc: Walked out of something that nobody else walked out of.
fields.traits:sovereign_grudge#desc: Ruled something once and has not accepted the loss of it. Every room is a court held in absentia, every slight a matter of record.
fields.traits:steady_practice#desc: Sits every night, whether or not the night deserves it.
fields.traits:storyteller#desc: Always has a tale ready — some true, most embellished.
fields.traits:stubborn#desc: Hard to sway in any direction — for good or ill.
fields.traits:superstitious#desc: There are no coincidences, only signs!
fields.traits:suspicious#desc: Trusts no one at face value.
fields.traits:swift_wing#desc: Exceptional speed even among the creatures of the sky.
fields.traits:sworn_vegetarian#desc: Will not eat anything that had a mother.
fields.traits:tea_ritualist#desc: The drinking is only the last part of the pleasure.
fields.traits:timid#desc: Easily frightened; prefers to avoid confrontation.
fields.traits:touched_by_grace#desc: Met something that had no business being kind to them, and was anyway.
fields.traits:trusting#desc: Extends goodwill freely, perhaps too freely.
fields.traits:undead#desc: The body is dead, or was never fully alive. Disease and poison find less purchase; the usual urgencies of flesh have gone quiet.
fields.traits:vain#desc: Takes great pride in their appearance and reputation.
fields.traits:venom_ward#desc: Generations of hunting venomous prey have made this creature resistant to poisons.
fields.traits:void_touched#desc: Stood too near the place where things stop and came back with the cold still in them. Silence follows this one into rooms.
fields.traits:war_banner#desc: Where this one stands, a line forms. It is not courage exactly — closer to the certainty that the fight has already been decided and everyone else is simply catching up.
fields.traits:war_hardened#desc: Violence no longer shocks, only excites the senses.
fields.traits:warm_hearted#desc: Easy to like, and easy about liking other people.
fields.upgrades:ambush_master#description: Strike first, strike hard. +50% damage on first attack in combat.
fields.upgrades:arcane_reservoir#description: Your magical capacity has expanded. +15% max Mana.
fields.upgrades:battle_hardened#description: Years of combat have toughened your body. +10% max HP.
fields.upgrades:eagle_eye#description: Your keen sight extends your effective range. +1 Range for ranged attacks.
fields.upgrades:iron_will#description: Your mind is a fortress. +10% resistance to all magical damage.
fields.upgrades:nimble_fighter#description: You dance around your enemies with ease. +5 Dodge.
fields.upgrades:quick_reflexes#description: Your reactions are lightning fast. +5 Initiative.
fields.upgrades:second_wind#description: Once per combat, recover 25% HP when reduced below 25% HP.
fields.upgrades:spell_focus#description: Your concentration amplifies your magic. +3 Spellpower.
fields.upgrades:tactician#description: Your strategic mind allows precise positioning of allies before battle. Enables manual deployment of party members.
fields.world:domain:cloud#description: Where water surrenders its weight to air, cloud is born — neither earth nor sky, neither solid nor gone. Cloud magic is the discipline of the in-between: it slips past barriers, sheds damage like rain, carries the party home on a breath of wind, and answers a call with something vast and serpentine that lives between the rain and the stars. The nagas who dwell in cloud are rare and sovereign; they do not welcome interruption, but they respect those who know how to approach.
fields.world:domain:cloud#theme: Transience, sovereignty, height. Cloud moves freely, belongs nowhere, answers to no one.
fields.world:domain:crystal#description: Where earth is compressed to perfection by space, crystal grows — ordered, resonant, and perfectly transparent. Crystal magic is a discipline of clarity: it reveals what hides, focuses the mind to a razor edge, and defends by refracting rather than absorbing. The Crystal Guardian is its emblem: patient, immovable, and lethal at a distance.
fields.world:domain:crystal#theme: Clarity, resonance, precision. Crystal focuses and reveals.
fields.world:domain:glass#description: Where earth is seized by air and made impossibly thin, glass is born — transparent, silent, and lethal when broken. Glass magic is precise and reactive: a shard in the dark, powder in the eyes, a globe that waits to shatter. It punishes the enemy for coming close and the ally for taking hits.
fields.world:domain:glass#theme: Precision, fragility, reflection. Glass wounds and reveals.
fields.world:domain:luminosity#description: Where fire illuminates space, luminosity is born — not the light of sun or flame but the clear light of awareness itself. Luminosity magic grants vision that pierces all deception, an aura that shields the mind from manipulation, and illusions so vivid they confuse even those who know what they are seeing.
fields.world:domain:luminosity#theme: Clear light, perception, mental mastery. Luminosity reveals and protects the mind.
fields.world:domain:mud#description: Where earth and water meet without ceremony, mud is born — patient, heavy, and suffocating. Mud magic combines the endurance of earth with the corrosion of water: slow but relentless, hard to wash off.
fields.world:domain:mud#theme: Corruption, weight, tenacity. Mud endures and smothers.
fields.world:domain:rainbow#description: Where space refracts through white light, rainbow is born — not one thing but all things at once, shimmering and impossible to hold. Rainbow magic is wildly unpredictable: each spell rolls its own dice, choosing from a palette of effects that might blind, charm, heal, or burn. Those who master it learn to see reality itself as a display of light.
fields.world:domain:rainbow#theme: Prismatic chaos, revelation, transcendence. Rainbow dazzles and illuminates.
fields.world:domain:smoke#description: Where fire meets earth, smoke is born — neither solid nor flame, a thing between states. Smoke magic inherits fire's hunger and earth's patience: it lingers, it blinds, it creeps into lungs and minds. The Smoking Mirror is its emblem: a surface that shows not the world but what the world hides.
fields.world:domain:smoke#theme: Concealment, suffocation, transformation. Smoke obscures and corrupts.
fields.world:domain:sound#description: Where air vibrates through space, sound is born — not mere noise but the primordial vibration that shapes reality. Sound magic is the discipline of mantra and resonance: battle chants that sharpen the will, dirges that sap the spirit, sonic blasts that shatter armor and silence, and the legendary eleventh note that transcends all structure.
fields.world:domain:sound#theme: Vibration, mantra, resonance. Sound shatters and commands.
fields.world:domain:steam#description: Where water meets fire, steam is born — neither liquid nor flame, a force that cleanses and scalds in equal measure. Steam magic purifies and erupts: healing mists that strip poison from allies, geysers that hurl enemies skyward, and lingering fog that sears those who linger.
fields.world:domain:steam#theme: Purification, eruption, transformation. Steam cleanses and scalds.
fields.world:domain:tummo#description: Where fire meets air within the body, tummo is born — the inner heat of yogic practice, the flame that melts the crown and blazes upward from the secret chakra. Tummo magic transforms the caster rather than the world: resistance to the elements, transfer of vitality, and ultimately the blazing and dripping of the inner channels.
fields.world:domain:tummo#theme: Inner heat, yogic fire, self-transformation. Tummo burns from within.
fields.world:names:animal#design: Tibetan/Sanskrit compound names for animal realm settlements — dens, lairs, watering holes, coral grottos, and sacred gathering sites. Vana/Shing=forest, Jala/Tsho=water/lake, Pakshi/Bya=bird, Mriga=deer/animal, Simha=lion, Naga=serpent, Matsya/Nya=fish, Parvata/Ri=mountain, Aranya=wilderness, Vyaghra=tiger, Gaja=elephant. Suffixes: khar=fort, thang=plain, yul=land, lung=valley, pura=city, gram=village.
fields.world:names:hell#design: Tibetan/Sanskrit compound place names drawn randomly when placing town-type objects. Ro=corpse, Nag=black, Dur=charnel, Trak=blood, Mun=darkness, Jik=fear, Shi=death, Bar=blazing, Me=fire, Gang=glacier, Drang=cold, Drag=fierce. khar=fort, thang=plain, yul=land, lung=valley, ri=mountain, dzong=citadel, pura=city.
fields.world:names:hungry_ghost#design: Tibetan/Sanskrit compound names for hungry ghost realm settlements. Preta=hungry ghost, Ro=corpse, Drib=obscuration, Tshog=gathering/craving, Nyom=desire, Ku=body, Sem=mind. Sanskrit: ksudha=hunger, trishna=craving, shava=corpse, shmashana=charnel. Suffixes: khar=fort, thang=plain, yul=land, lung=valley, dzong=citadel, pura=city.
fields.world:realm:animal#description: The realm of primal instinct and predation. The vast ocean depths hold naga courts older than memory and makara that swallow ships whole. Inland, the ancient forest is territory — contested, marked, fought over — while the open meadows are the world's great stage, where khadga charge and bhramara darken the sun. The birds live everywhere, but the high places belong to them alone.
fields.world:realm:hell#description: The Hell Realm of Naraka, split between the frozen wastes of the north and the burning badlands of the south, divided by an impassable mountain range.
fields.world:realm:hungry_ghost#description: The realm of insatiable craving, divided into fetid swamps crawling with the newly dead, ancient graveyards haunted by desiccated skeletons, and the charnel grounds where vetalas hold court in palaces that are not quite real.
fields.world:shop:animal_ancient_banyan#descrip: A banyan so old it has become its own forest — hundreds of aerial roots, each descended root a new trunk, the whole organism covering ground that would take an hour to walk around. The beings who live inside its aerial forest do not remember when they arrived.
fields.world:shop:animal_birds_congress#descrip: A high cliff where every species of bird in the realm sends at least one representative, continuously, by some rotation that appears to involve song but which scholars cannot fully decode. What looks like a congress is also, apparently, a school.
fields.world:shop:animal_black_lodge#descriptio: Half-buried, marked with a khatvanga hung with black ribbons and bone-charms. The practitioners here study predation as a spiritual technology — what it means to take life, what it transfers. The animal realm is uncommonly honest about the subject.
fields.world:shop:animal_bone_forest#descriptio: A forest of pale calcified trees — not dead but transformed, turned to mineral over geological time. The predators who come here to meditate among the skeletal forms have access to a school of thought that treats death not as an ending but as a material.
fields.world:shop:animal_crossroads_stupa#descr: Where four major migration routes intersect, a stupa marks the conjunction. Tormas and butter lamps heap at its base, some kept burning by passing devotees, some long guttered out. The practitioners here specialize in working with beings rather than forces.
fields.world:shop:animal_eternal_fire#descripti: White-robed priests have tended this fire since before the realm's current configuration. The animals who come here for vision-seeking say the fire speaks differently than any other source of light — more direct, less patient.
fields.world:shop:animal_forest_merchant#descri: A varaha trader working a circuit he holds entirely in his head. Everything he owns is on his back.
fields.world:shop:animal_forest_teahouse#descri: A platform structure high in the canopy, reachable by rope bridges from three directions. The vanara who run it have been doing so since before any of them can remember. The tea is brewed from forest herbs you don't recognize and tastes like rain, bark, and something that is not quite spice.
