- **Paranoid** `paranoid` — awareness +1, charm -1
  - desc: Always watching. Always expecting the worst. Wait, did you hear that?
rendered.Traits › behavioral › pet_lover:
- **Pet-lover** `pet_lover` — inborn
  - desc: Has never once passed an animal without stopping.
rendered.Traits › behavioral › pilgrim:
- **Pilgrim** `pilgrim` — inborn
  - desc: The party schedule will wait, the shrine must be circumambulated.
rendered.Traits › behavioral › poet:
- **Poet** `poet` — inborn
  - desc: Composes constantly in their head, and occasionally, without warning, out loud.
rendered.Traits › behavioral › present:
- **Present** `present` — inborn · awareness +1
  - desc: Here and now.
rendered.Traits › behavioral › scrimper:
- **Scrimper** `scrimper` — inborn
  - desc: Cannot part with money without a grimace.
rendered.Traits › behavioral › secret_bearer:
- **Secret-bearer** `secret_bearer` — inborn
  - desc: Carrying something they have told nobody, and have no plans to.
rendered.Traits › behavioral › storyteller:
- **Storyteller** `storyteller` — inborn
  - desc: Always has a tale ready — some true, most embellished.
rendered.Traits › behavioral › superstitious:
- **Superstitious** `superstitious` — inborn
  - desc: There are no coincidences, only signs!
rendered.Traits › behavioral › sworn_vegetarian:
- **Sworn Vegetarian** `sworn_vegetarian` — inborn
  - desc: Will not eat anything that had a mother.
rendered.Traits › behavioral › tea_ritualist:
- **Tea Ritualist** `tea_ritualist` — inborn
  - desc: The drinking is only the last part of the pleasure.
rendered.Traits › personality › brave:
- **Brave** `brave` — inborn
  - desc: Faces danger without flinching.
rendered.Traits › personality › clear_eyed:
- **Clear-eyed** `clear_eyed` — inborn
  - desc: Sees what is in front of them without dressing it up.
rendered.Traits › personality › content:
- **Content** `content` — inborn
  - desc: When you don't have what you like, like what you have.
rendered.Traits › personality › covetous:
- **Covetous** `covetous` — inborn
  - desc: Measures their life against other people's, and comes up short every time.
rendered.Traits › personality › craven:
- **Craven** `craven` — inborn · finesse +1
  - desc: Runs first and reasons afterwards. Whatever else is true, nothing has ever caught them.
rendered.Traits › personality › curious:
- **Curious** `curious` — inborn
  - desc: Irresistibly drawn to the unknown.
rendered.Traits › personality › forgetful:
- **Forgetful** `forgetful` — inborn
  - desc: Details slip away; rarely remembers what was said.
rendered.Traits › personality › generous:
- **Generous** `generous` — inborn · charm +1
  - desc: Gives freely, expects little in return.
rendered.Traits › personality › greedy:
- **Greedy** `greedy` — inborn
  - desc: Always calculating what they stand to gain.
rendered.Traits › personality › grudge_bearer:
- **Grudge-bearer** `grudge_bearer` — inborn
  - desc: Forgets nothing that was done to them, and keeps the ledger current.
rendered.Traits › personality › hot_tempered:
- **Hot-tempered** `hot_tempered` — inborn · charm -1
  - desc: Quick to anger, slow to forgive.
rendered.Traits › personality › incurious:
- **Incurious** `incurious` — inborn
  - desc: At first, asking questions was difficult, then it became impossible.
rendered.Traits › personality › melancholic:
- **Melancholic** `melancholic` — inborn
  - desc: A deep sadness runs beneath the surface.
rendered.Traits › personality › patient:
- **Patient** `patient` — inborn
  - desc: Once you endure the first impulse, you can wait almost indefinitely.
rendered.Traits › personality › sharp_memory:
- **Sharp Memory** `sharp_memory` — inborn
  - desc: Remembers everything — names, faces, slights.
rendered.Traits › personality › stubborn:
- **Stubborn** `stubborn` — inborn
  - desc: Hard to sway in any direction — for good or ill.
rendered.Traits › personality › suspicious:
- **Suspicious** `suspicious` — inborn · charm -1, awareness +1
  - desc: Trusts no one at face value.
rendered.Traits › personality › timid:
- **Timid** `timid` — inborn · charm -1
  - desc: Easily frightened; prefers to avoid confrontation.
rendered.Traits › personality › trusting:
- **Trusting** `trusting` — inborn · charm +1, awareness -1
  - desc: Extends goodwill freely, perhaps too freely.
rendered.Traits › personality › vain:
- **Vain** `vain` — inborn · charm +1
  - desc: Takes great pride in their appearance and reputation.
rendered.Traits › personality › warm_hearted:
- **Warm-hearted** `warm_hearted` — inborn · charm +1
  - desc: Easy to like, and easy about liking other people.
rendered.Traits › physical › attractive:
- **Attractive** `attractive` — inborn · charm +1
  - desc: A pleasing appearance opens many doors.
rendered.Traits › physical › chronic_pain:
- **Chronic Pain** `chronic_pain` — inborn · constitution -1
  - desc: Dull, throbbing, always there.
rendered.Traits › physical › clubfooted:
- **Clubfooted** `clubfooted` — inborn · finesse -1
  - desc: An awkward gait that hampers quick movement.
rendered.Traits › physical › frail:
- **Frail** `frail` — inborn · constitution -1
  - desc: A fragile constitution, easily tired and slow to heal.
rendered.Traits › physical › hard_of_hearing:
- **Hard of Hearing** `hard_of_hearing` — inborn · awareness -1
  - desc: Weary of asking others to repeat themselves, they begrudgingly accepted their condition.
rendered.Traits › physical › impaired_vision:
- **Impaired Vision** `impaired_vision` — inborn · awareness -1
  - desc: Struggles in the dark, misses details and enemies.
rendered.Traits › physical › iron_stomach:
- **Iron Stomach** `iron_stomach` — inborn
  - desc: Five second rule!
rendered.Traits › physical › light_sleeper:
- **Light Sleeper** `light_sleeper` — inborn · awareness +1
  - desc: Sleep with one eye open, gripping the pillow tight.
rendered.Traits › physical › night_owl:
- **Night Owl** `night_owl` — inborn
  - desc: The owl of wisdom flies after midnight.
rendered.Traits › physical › quick:
- **Quick** `quick` — inborn · finesse +1
  - desc: Naturally fast reflexes and light feet.
rendered.Traits › physical › sharp_eyed:
- **Sharp-eyed** `sharp_eyed` — inborn · awareness +1
  - desc: Nothing escapes their notice.
rendered.Traits › physical › strong:
- **Strong** `strong` — inborn · strength +1
  - desc: Doors seem a little narrow.
rendered.Traits › racial › ancient_memory:
- **Ancient Memory** `ancient_memory` — inborn · awareness +1
  - desc: Long ages of accumulated experience have sharpened recall and insight. What others learn in a lifetime, this being has lived through many times over.
rendered.Traits › racial › aquatic:
- **Aquatic** `aquatic` — inborn
  - desc:
    > Born of the water. Breathes and moves freely in aquatic environments. If the entire party shares this trait, the party may traverse water tiles without penalty in both combat and overworld.
rendered.Traits › racial › armored:
- **Armored** `armored` — inborn · constitution +2, finesse -1
  - desc: Dense natural plating — chitin, thick hide, or bone — makes this creature hard to put down.
rendered.Traits › racial › better_starting_weapon:
- **Armory Rights** `better_starting_weapon` — inborn
  - desc: Some lives grant wisdom, others grief - this one grants you a superior weapon.
rendered.Traits › racial › bulky:
- **Bulky** `bulky` — inborn · constitution +1
  - desc: A massive build that weathers punishment others could not survive.
rendered.Traits › racial › colony_mind:
- **Colony Mind** `colony_mind` — inborn
  - desc: Born into a collective, this creature is never truly alone. Shared purpose dampens individual anxiety.
rendered.Traits › racial › corpse_rider:
- **Corpse Rider** `corpse_rider` — inborn · focus +1
  - desc: Wears the dead the way others wear a coat, and has worn many. Something of each one stays behind in the way the hands move.
rendered.Traits › racial › deep_current:
- **Deep Current** `deep_current` — inborn · focus +1
  - desc:
    > Thinks in pressures and distances no surface creature has words for. The magic that comes of it is correspondingly difficult to explain and difficult to argue with.
rendered.Traits › racial › extra_starting_gold:
- **Hoarder's Instinct** `extra_starting_gold` — inborn
  - desc: Maybe they inherited it, maybe they've hoarded it by themselves - the important part is the weight of the purse.
rendered.Traits › racial › first_to_know:
- **First to Know** `first_to_know` — inborn · awareness +1
  - desc: The head comes up before the sound arrives. Alertness inherited rather than learned.
rendered.Traits › racial › flying:
- **Flying** `flying` — inborn · finesse +1
  - desc: Sustained winged flight. If the entire party shares this trait, the party may traverse air tiles and elevated terrain in combat and overworld.
rendered.Traits › racial › guardian_geas:
- **Guardian's Geas** `guardian_geas` — inborn · charm +1
  - desc:
    > Bound to a place, a hoard, or a promise made before memory. The binding is not resented; it is the shape of the self. Ask what is being guarded and the answer comes back older than the question.
rendered.Traits › racial › hell_born:
- **Hell-born** `hell_born` — inborn
  - desc: Forged in the fires and torments of hell. Instinctively at home in its rabid violence and hierarchy.
rendered.Traits › racial › hoard_keeper:
- **Hoard Keeper** `hoard_keeper` — inborn · awareness +1
  - desc: Wealth is not spent here, it is accumulated and remembered. Every piece of it has a provenance, and the provenance is the point.
rendered.Traits › racial › hunters_yoga:
- **Hunter's Yoga** `hunters_yoga` — inborn · strength +1
  - desc:
    > Lifetimes of the twisted disciplines — breath held to stillness, hunger cultivated rather than sated, the body worked into a shape that only makes sense mid-leap. It is a real practice. It is simply pointed the wrong way.
rendered.Traits › racial › incorporeal:
- **Incorporeal** `incorporeal` — inborn · constitution -1
  - desc: Barely present in the physical world — more dissolution than body. Food, wealth and violence seem somehow exotic.
rendered.Traits › racial › insatiable:
- **Insatiable** `insatiable` — inborn
  - desc: Mouth like a gate, throat like a needle.
rendered.Traits › racial › night_vision:
- **Night Vision** `night_vision` — inborn · awareness +1
  - desc: Sees equally in darkness and light, perceiving what others miss.
rendered.Traits › racial › nimble_mischief:
- **Nimble Mischief** `nimble_mischief` — inborn
  - desc: Quick hands and a quicker mind.
rendered.Traits › racial › predator_grace:
- **Predator's Grace** `predator_grace` — inborn · finesse +2, constitution -1
  - desc: The natural speed and precision of a born hunter.
rendered.Traits › racial › serpentine:
- **Serpentine** `serpentine` — inborn
  - desc: A body built for water and coiling grace, equally at home in the deep as on land.
rendered.Traits › racial › sovereign_grudge:
- **Sovereign Grudge** `sovereign_grudge` — inborn · charm +1
  - desc: Ruled something once and has not accepted the loss of it. Every room is a court held in absentia, every slight a matter of record.
rendered.Traits › racial › swift_wing:
- **Swift Wing** `swift_wing` — inborn · finesse +1
  - desc: Exceptional speed even among the creatures of the sky.
rendered.Traits › racial › taloned_strike:
- **Taloned Strike** `taloned_strike` — inborn
  - desc: Natural weapons of uncommon sharpness.
rendered.Traits › racial › undead:
- **Undead** `undead` — inborn
  - desc: The body is dead, or was never fully alive. Disease and poison find less purchase; the usual urgencies of flesh have gone quiet.
rendered.Traits › racial › venom_ward:
- **Venom Ward** `venom_ward` — inborn
  - desc: Generations of hunting venomous prey have made this creature resistant to poisons.
rendered.Traits › racial › void_touched:
- **Void Touched** `void_touched` — inborn · focus +1
  - desc: Stood too near the place where things stop and came back with the cold still in them. Silence follows this one into rooms.
rendered.Traits › racial › war_banner:
- **War Banner** `war_banner` — inborn · charm +1
  - desc:
    > Where this one stands, a line forms. It is not courage exactly — closer to the certainty that the fight has already been decided and everyone else is simply catching up.
rendered.World › animal › landmarks › animal_boss: - **The King of Beasts** `animal_boss_simha_king` — boss · zone forest · near_portal
rendered.World › animal › landmarks › animal_ocea: - **The Naga's Greeting** `animal_ocean_naga_greeting` — event · zone ocean · near_start
rendered.World › animal › location_names › names:
- **Location names** `names`
  - design:
    > Tibetan/Sanskrit compound names for animal realm settlements — dens, lairs, watering holes, coral grottos, and sacred gathering sites. Vana/Shing=forest, Jala/Tsho=water/lake, Pakshi/Bya=bird, Mriga=deer/animal, Simha=lion, Naga=serpent, Matsya/Nya=fish, Parvata/Ri=mountain, Aranya=wilderness, Vyaghra=tiger, Gaja=elephant. Suffixes: khar=fort, thang=plain, yul=land, lung=valley, pura=city, gram=village.
  - town: Vanakhar, Jalathang, Simhakhar, Mrigapura, Nagalung, Vyaghrakhar, Aranyagram, Pakshiyul, Matsyathang, Tshokhar, Byathang, Nyaling, Klungri, Vanarapura, Gajayul
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_ancient:
- **The Ancient Banyan** `animal_ancient_banyan` — spell_guild · prices x1.0 · guild Earth · 9 items
  - description:
    > A banyan so old it has become its own forest — hundreds of aerial roots, each descended root a new trunk, the whole organism covering ground that would take an hour to walk around. The beings who live inside its aerial forest do not remember when they arrived.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_birds_c:
- **Birds' Congress** `animal_birds_congress` — spell_guild · prices x1.1 · guild Air · 8 items
  - description:
    > A high cliff where every species of bird in the realm sends at least one representative, continuously, by some rotation that appears to involve song but which scholars cannot fully decode. What looks like a congress is also, apparently, a school.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_black_l:
- **Black Lodge** `animal_black_lodge` — spell_guild · prices x1.25 · guild Black · 8 items
  - description:
    > Half-buried, marked with a khatvanga hung with black ribbons and bone-charms. The practitioners here study predation as a spiritual technology — what it means to take life, what it transfers. The animal realm is uncommonly honest about the subject.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_bone_fo:
- **Bone Forest** `animal_bone_forest` — spell_guild · prices x1.2 · guild Black · 8 items
  - description:
    > A forest of pale calcified trees — not dead but transformed, turned to mineral over geological time. The predators who come here to meditate among the skeletal forms have access to a school of thought that treats death not as an ending but as a material.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_crossro:
- **Crossroads Stupa** `animal_crossroads_stupa` — spell_guild · prices x1.15 · guild Summoning · 9 items
  - description:
    > Where four major migration routes intersect, a stupa marks the conjunction. Tormas and butter lamps heap at its base, some kept burning by passing devotees, some long guttered out. The practitioners here specialize in working with beings rather than forces.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_eternal:
- **Temple of the Eternal Fire** `animal_eternal_fire` — spell_guild · prices x1.2 · guild Fire · 9 items
  - description:
    > White-robed priests have tended this fire since before the realm's current configuration. The animals who come here for vision-seeking say the fire speaks differently than any other source of light — more direct, less patient.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_forest_:
- **Forest Merchant** `animal_forest_merchant` — general · prices x1.15 · 11 items
  - description: A varaha trader working a circuit he holds entirely in his head. Everything he owns is on his back.

- **Forest Teahouse** `animal_forest_teahouse` — teahouse · prices x1.1 · 3 items
  - description:
    > A platform structure high in the canopy, reachable by rope bridges from three directions. The vanara who run it have been doing so since before any of them can remember. The tea is brewed from forest herbs you don't recognize and tastes like rain, bark, and something that is not quite spice.

- **Forest Training Camp** `animal_forest_training_camp` — veteran_camp · prices x1.0 · 2 items
  - description:
    > A gana training ground deep in the canopy — worn wooden practice posts, rope courses strung between trees, the smell of exertion and leaf-litter. The instructors are scarred veterans who have survived things that don't have names yet.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_garuda_:
- **Garuda Roost** `animal_garuda_roost` — spell_guild · prices x1.15 · guild Air · 8 items
  - description:
    > A great landing pole rises above the canopy, hung with wind-bells and sky-prayer flags. The Garudas who use it leave residual power in the ground below. Practitioners of air and space magic come here to feel the difference between flight and fall.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_healer_:
- **Healer's Camp** `animal_healer_camp` — healer · prices x0.9 · 9 items
  - description: A canvas clinic strung between four trees, run by a grey-muzzled gana who does not hurry.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_hidden_:
- **Hidden Gompa** `animal_hidden_gompa` — spell_guild · prices x1.15 · guild Space · 11 items
  - description:
    > A monastery that exists only insofar as the practice of its inhabitants sustains it. The walls are older than memory and the silence deeper than the forest. The practitioners here have been undisturbed for long enough that the ground itself has opinions.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_meadow_:
- **Plains Merchant** `animal_meadow_merchant` — general · prices x1.05 · 15 items
  - description: An enormous cart drawn by a harnessed khadga, worked by a yaksha who has run this route for decades.

- **Meadow Teahouse** `animal_meadow_teahouse` — teahouse · prices x1.1 · 4 items
  - description:
    > A circular tent-structure at a major watering hole, serving travelers and migrants and the occasional khadga who has learned to sit still long enough to drink something warm. The yaksha proprietor brews from the seasonal grass-flowers and charges exactly what the market will bear.

- **Meadow Training Camp** `animal_meadow_training_camp` — veteran_camp · prices x1.0 · 2 items
  - description:
    > An open-air training ground where the wind comes from every direction at once. The dura instructors here believe that there is no better teacher than exposure, and schedule sparring sessions during the hour before the bhramara cloud arrives.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_medicin:
- **Medicinal Garden** `animal_medicinal_garden` — spell_guild · prices x1.1 · guild White · 9 items
  - description:
    > A cultivated clearing tended by practitioners who have studied the relationship between plant, body, and suffering for generations. The herbs here grow things that have no equivalent elsewhere. Knowledge is shared freely; materials cost what they cost.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_mercena:
- **Mercenary Guild** `animal_mercenary_guild` — mercenary_guild · prices x1.0 · 14 items
  - description:
    > Animals who have figured out that their skills have cash value and have the good sense to organize. Better equipment than you might expect. The guild master keeps the contracts brief and the payment terms clear.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_mirror_:
- **Mirror Lake** `animal_mirror_lake` — spell_guild · prices x1.2 · guild Enchantment · 10 items
  - description:
    > The surface shows things that aren't there — or rather, things that are there but not yet. Followers of the Goddess of Illusion use this as a training ground: if you can hold your mind still enough to see clearly in a place that specializes in confusion, you can do it anywhere.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_naga_pa:
- **Naga Palace** `animal_naga_palace` — spell_guild · prices x1.0 · guild Water · 11 items
  - description:
    > The seat of a naga court that remembers when this ocean was fresh water. Trading access: the naga have long memories and are interested in what traveling parties have seen. Their price for advanced teaching is always information — specific, verifiable, and something they don't already know.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_ocean_t:
- **Tide Shelter** `animal_ocean_teahouse` — teahouse · prices x1.1 · 4 items
  - description:
    > A structure built into a sea cliff, half-submerged at high tide and bone-dry at low. A fire burns in a sealed alcove. The keeper is a broad and unhurried makara current who settled down forty years ago and has been pouring the same tea blend since. Nobody asks the recipe.

- **Reef Training Camp** `animal_ocean_training_camp` — veteran_camp · prices x1.0 · 2 items
  - description:
    > A karka war-school built into the coral. Sessions alternate between fighting in the shallows and fighting in open water, on the grounds that you will never get to choose. The instructors communicate primarily by demonstration.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_pearl_m:
- **Pearl Merchant** `animal_pearl_merchant` — general · prices x1.1 · 7 items
  - description: Pearls, polished shell, sea-glass, and a few things older than her trade.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_sacred_:
- **Sacred Grove** `animal_sacred_grove` — spell_guild · prices x1.1 · guild Earth · 9 items
  - description:
    > The oldest trees in the realm gather here as if in council. Bark-sigils accumulate on the trunks over centuries — offerings pressed into the wood, prayers absorbed by the roots. The Yakshas and Yakshinis who maintain this grove are older than the realm's current configuration.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_shell_w:
- **Shell-Wright's Stall** `animal_shell_wright` — blacksmith · prices x0.95 · 16 items
  - description: A karka craftsman working in moulted shell, chitin, and salvaged metal.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_temple_:
- **Temple of the Naga** `animal_temple_of_the_naga` — spell_guild · prices x1.1 · guild Water · 8 items
  - description:
    > An old structure where those born with naga-affinity come to train under the great serpents' direct guidance. The water here has properties that don't exist anywhere else in the realm. Offerings of saffron milk and river-flowers are accepted at the outer shrine.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_termite:
- **Termite Cathedral** `animal_termite_cathedral` — spell_guild · prices x1.0 · guild Earth · 8 items
  - description:
    > A structure ten meters high, built over centuries by beings each the size of a thumbnail, with architectural precision that confounds engineers. The collective intelligence that designed and maintains it doesn't communicate in any language known to surface beings, but it does teach — by implication and exposure.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_town_ma:
- **Town** `animal_town_magic` — town · prices x1.1 · 14 items
  - description:
    > A settlement that has drawn its share of hedge-mages, ritual practitioners, and wandering herbalists. The apothecary smells of bark, fungal spores, and something resinous that's been burning for days.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_town_su:
- **Town** `animal_town_supplies` — town · prices x1.0 · 11 items
  - description:
    > A clearing settlement where four game trails meet. Sounder matrons and herb-walkers tend most of the stalls. Food preserved in bark and clay, medicines extracted from things most travelers walk past without recognizing, tools for the deep wild. It is honest trade in a place that doesn't demand credentials.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_town_we:
- **Town** `animal_town_weapons` — town · prices x1.05 · 19 items
  - description:
    > A market where different territories agree, briefly, to exchange. Dura shell-wright craftsmanship, vanara jugaad improvisation, marjara-claw handles on daggers sold by gana traders who got them somewhere no one is explaining. The weapons here are practical and tell stories.
rendered.World › animal › places › animal_yogini_:
- **Yogini Circle** `animal_yogini_circle` — yogini_circle · prices x1.1 · 19 items
  - description:
    > Sixty-four Yoginis carved in relief on an inward-facing ring of stone, no ceiling, no door. The practitioners who gather here are a rougher assembly than the hidden gompa — interested in results more than elegance, and willing to discuss the dangerous schools.
rendered.World › animal › realm:
- **Tiryakloka - The Animal Realm** `realm` — 192x192 tiles
  - description:
    > The realm of primal instinct and predation. The vast ocean depths hold naga courts older than memory and makara that swallow ships whole. Inland, the ancient forest is territory — contested, marked, fought over — while the open meadows are the world's great stage, where khadga charge and bhramara darken the sun. The birds live everywhere, but the high places belong to them alone.
rendered.World › animal › zones › coastal_wall:
- **Coral Barrier** `coastal_wall` — rows 120-127 · mountain_wall
  - design:
    > Horizontal wall separating the ocean from the inland zones. A coral barrier ridge — impassable except at tidal passes where the reef breaks. The karka hold these choke-points.
rendered.World › animal › zones › forest:
- **forest** `forest` — rows 0-119
  - design:
    > Upper-left section. Dense canopy — dark, layered, territorial. The forest floor is never quiet. Every fallen log is a claim, every fruiting tree a war. The portal to the Human Realm is hidden in the oldest part, near the northwestern corner.
rendered.World › animal › zones › meadow:
- **meadow** `meadow` — rows 0-119
  - design:
    > Upper-right section. Open sky-brushed plains, termite cathedrals, migration routes, watering holes. Exposure is the currency here — the khadga charge, the yaksha mark territory, the bhramara darken the midday sun. More dangerous than the forest because there is nowhere to hide.
rendered.World › animal › zones › ocean:
- **ocean** `ocean` — rows 128-191
  - design:
    > Bottom section. Entry zone — player arrives from the Hungry Ghost Realm. Vast coastal shelf and open ocean: deep water channels, coral reef flats, rocky islets, sandy shallows. The naga rule here and they remember everything.
rendered.World › animal › zones › ridge:
- **Thorn Ridge** `ridge` — rows 0-119 · mountain_wall
  - design:
    > Vertical wall between forest and meadow. A ridgeline of tumbled boulders, thorn scrub, and dry ravines. Hard to cross but not impossible — the passes tend to be where the old game trails are.
rendered.World › domains › cloud:
- **Cloud** `cloud` — elements Water, Air
  - description:
    > Where water surrenders its weight to air, cloud is born — neither earth nor sky, neither solid nor gone. Cloud magic is the discipline of the in-between: it slips past barriers, sheds damage like rain, carries the party home on a breath of wind, and answers a call with something vast and serpentine that lives between the rain and the stars. The nagas who dwell in cloud are rare and sovereign; they do not welcome interruption, but they respect those who know how to approach.
  - theme: Transience, sovereignty, height. Cloud moves freely, belongs nowhere, answers to no one.
rendered.World › domains › crystal:
- **Crystal** `crystal` — elements Earth, Space
  - description:
    > Where earth is compressed to perfection by space, crystal grows — ordered, resonant, and perfectly transparent. Crystal magic is a discipline of clarity: it reveals what hides, focuses the mind to a razor edge, and defends by refracting rather than absorbing. The Crystal Guardian is its emblem: patient, immovable, and lethal at a distance.
  - theme: Clarity, resonance, precision. Crystal focuses and reveals.
rendered.World › domains › glass:
- **Glass** `glass` — elements Earth, Air
  - description:
    > Where earth is seized by air and made impossibly thin, glass is born — transparent, silent, and lethal when broken. Glass magic is precise and reactive: a shard in the dark, powder in the eyes, a globe that waits to shatter. It punishes the enemy for coming close and the ally for taking hits.
  - theme: Precision, fragility, reflection. Glass wounds and reveals.
rendered.World › domains › luminosity:
- **Luminosity** `luminosity` — elements Fire, Space
  - description:
    > Where fire illuminates space, luminosity is born — not the light of sun or flame but the clear light of awareness itself. Luminosity magic grants vision that pierces all deception, an aura that shields the mind from manipulation, and illusions so vivid they confuse even those who know what they are seeing.
  - theme: Clear light, perception, mental mastery. Luminosity reveals and protects the mind.
rendered.World › domains › mud:
- **Mud** `mud` — elements Earth, Water
  - description:
    > Where earth and water meet without ceremony, mud is born — patient, heavy, and suffocating. Mud magic combines the endurance of earth with the corrosion of water: slow but relentless, hard to wash off.
  - theme: Corruption, weight, tenacity. Mud endures and smothers.
rendered.World › domains › rainbow:
- **Rainbow** `rainbow` — elements Space, White
  - description:
    > Where space refracts through white light, rainbow is born — not one thing but all things at once, shimmering and impossible to hold. Rainbow magic is wildly unpredictable: each spell rolls its own dice, choosing from a palette of effects that might blind, charm, heal, or burn. Those who master it learn to see reality itself as a display of light.
  - theme: Prismatic chaos, revelation, transcendence. Rainbow dazzles and illuminates.
rendered.World › domains › smoke:
- **Smoke** `smoke` — elements Earth, Fire
  - description:
    > Where fire meets earth, smoke is born — neither solid nor flame, a thing between states. Smoke magic inherits fire's hunger and earth's patience: it lingers, it blinds, it creeps into lungs and minds. The Smoking Mirror is its emblem: a surface that shows not the world but what the world hides.
  - theme: Concealment, suffocation, transformation. Smoke obscures and corrupts.
rendered.World › domains › sound:
- **Sound** `sound` — elements Air, Space
  - description:
    > Where air vibrates through space, sound is born — not mere noise but the primordial vibration that shapes reality. Sound magic is the discipline of mantra and resonance: battle chants that sharpen the will, dirges that sap the spirit, sonic blasts that shatter armor and silence, and the legendary eleventh note that transcends all structure.
  - theme: Vibration, mantra, resonance. Sound shatters and commands.
rendered.World › domains › steam:
- **Steam** `steam` — elements Water, Fire
  - description:
    > Where water meets fire, steam is born — neither liquid nor flame, a force that cleanses and scalds in equal measure. Steam magic purifies and erupts: healing mists that strip poison from allies, geysers that hurl enemies skyward, and lingering fog that sears those who linger.
  - theme: Purification, eruption, transformation. Steam cleanses and scalds.
rendered.World › domains › tummo:
- **Tummo** `tummo` — elements Fire, Air
  - description:
    > Where fire meets air within the body, tummo is born — the inner heat of yogic practice, the flame that melts the crown and blazes upward from the secret chakra. Tummo magic transforms the caster rather than the world: resistance to the elements, transfer of vitality, and ultimately the blazing and dripping of the inner channels.
  - theme: Inner heat, yogic fire, self-transformation. Tummo burns from within.

rendered.World › hell › places › hell_circle_of_y:

  - description:

  - description:

rendered.World › hell › places › hell_eternal_fir:
- **Temple of the Eternal Fire** `hell_eternal_fire` — spell_guild · prices x1.25 · guild Fire · 9 items

rendered.World › hell › places › hell_garuda_roos:
- **Garuda Roost** `hell_garuda_roost` — spell_guild · prices x1.2 · guild Air · 8 items
  - description:

rendered.World › hell › places › hell_hidden_gomp:
- **Hidden Gompa** `hell_hidden_gompa` — spell_guild · prices x1.2 · guild Space · 10 items
  - description:
    > Practitioners come to this place seeking solitude and peace. The ground itself vibrates with the power of their meditation, mantric syllables appearing spontaneously in the rock.
rendered.World › hell › places › hell_medicinal_g:
- **Medicinal Garden** `hell_medicinal_garden` — spell_guild · prices x1.15 · guild White · 6 items
  - description:
    > The air is vibrant with the aroma of medicinal herbs and flowers. The healers cultivating them are happy to share some of their knowledge for the benefit of all suffering beings.
rendered.World › hell › places › hell_mercenary_g:

rendered.World › hell › places › hell_mirror_lake:

  - description:

rendered.World › hell › places › hell_sacred_grov:
- **Sacred Grove** `hell_sacred_grove` — spell_guild · prices x1.15 · guild Earth · 9 items
  - description:

rendered.World › hell › places › hell_tavern:

rendered.World › hell › places › hell_teahouse_fi:

rendered.World › hell › places › hell_temple_of_t:
- **Temple of the Naga** `hell_temple_of_the_naga` — spell_guild · prices x1.15 · guild Water · 7 items
  - description:

rendered.World › hell › places › hell_town_magic:

rendered.World › hell › places › hell_yogini_circ:

rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_alche:

rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_black:
- **Black Lodge** `hg_black_lodge` — spell_guild · prices x1.3 · guild Black · 9 items
  - description: A mound of bones marks the entrance, a khatvanga hung with a skull and black silk. Inside, something moves that may not be fully alive. It knows what you want.

- **The Smuggler's Alcove** `hg_black_market` — general · prices x1.5 · 21 items
  - description:
    > A low tunnel behind a false wall, lit by a single floating ember. The figure inside won't show its face. It trades in things that shouldn't have made it into the hungry ghost realm — quality ironwork, foreign medicines, a few items with the smell of other worlds still on them. Prices reflect the difficulty of getting anything here at all.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_bone_:
- **Bone Merchant** `hg_bone_merchant` — general · prices x1.1 · 11 items
  - description:
    > A skeleton trader squats among the dry graves, its jaw clicking as it counts coins with bony fingers. The wares are crude but functional — carved from the bones of those who no longer need them.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_charn:
- **Charnel Sorcerer** `hg_charnel_sorcerer` — spell_trainer · prices x1.3 · 9 items
  - description:
    > A vetala perches atop a crumbling funerary monument, its stolen body draped in rotting silk. It trades in dark knowledge — curses, poisons, and the thin art of pulling life from the dying.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_circl:
- **Circle of the Yoginis** `hg_circle_of_yoginis` — spell_guild · prices x1.2 · guild Sorcery · 10 items
  - description:
    > Sixty-four forms carved into standing bones, forming a ring on the charnel ground. The earth inside is worn smooth by countless ritual footprints. The witches still come.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_cross:
- **Crossroads Stupa** `hg_crossroads_stupa` — domain_spell_trainer · prices x1.5
  - description:
    > At the intersection of the ancient paths, a stupa rises from layers of offerings — skulls, prayer flags, bones wrapped in cloth. The practitioners here call back what has been lost.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_hidde:
- **Hidden Gompa** `hg_hidden_gompa` — domain_spell_trainer · prices x1.5
  - description:
    > A small monastery sits undisturbed between the burial grounds, its walls marked with painted eyes. The monks here practice for the benefit of all beings caught between lives.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_merce:
- **Undertakers' Lodge** `hg_mercenary_guild` — mercenary_guild · prices x1.1 · 16 items
  - description:
    > A fortified charnel house where the realm's hired fighters gather between jobs. They call themselves undertakers — they put things in the ground, one way or another.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_mirro:
- **Mirror Lake** `hg_mirror_lake` — domain_spell_trainer · prices x1.5
  - description: The surface of the lake reflects not the sky but something else — other realms, other moments. Practitioners sit at its edge, learning to bend what is seen.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_sacre:
- **Sacred Grove** `hg_sacred_grove` — domain_spell_trainer · prices x1.5
  - description:
    > A stand of ancient trees whose roots grow through charnel earth. Offerings of food hang from the branches — the hungry ghosts can smell them but cannot eat. Practitioners here speak to both the living and the dead.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_spell:
- **The Bone Library** `hg_spell_shop` — spell_trainer · prices x1.1 · 14 items
  - description:
    > A sorcerer-ghost has assembled a collection of sutras and grimoires, most of them water-stained or singed at the edges, all of them legible to those with the patience to study. It charges for access by the session — a small candle's worth of time per spell — and answers no questions that aren't paid for.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_teaho:
- **The Last Cup** `hg_teahouse` — teahouse · prices x1.0 · 1 items
  - description:
    > A lantern glows faintly above a low doorway carved into a burial mound. Inside, a quiet figure brews tea from dried flowers that grow only on graves. The dead do not drink, but the living are welcome to rest.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_templ:
- **Temple of the Naga** `hg_temple_of_the_naga` — domain_spell_trainer · prices x1.5
  - description:
    > A low temple built around a black-water pool. The nagas who dwell in such pools are guardians of the dead. Their human followers leave milk offerings at the water's edge and learn what the serpents are willing to teach.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_town_:
- **Whispering Shrine** `hg_town_magic` — town · prices x1.2 · 9 items
  - description:
    > Faded prayer flags hang from a cracked shrine where the boundary between the living and dead has worn thin. The priests here teach what they remember of the old arts — healing and hexing in equal measure.

- **Gravedigger's Supply** `hg_town_supplies` — town · prices x1.0 · 8 items
  - description:
    > A practical establishment run by those who tend to the dead for a living. The shelves are well stocked — people always need supplies in a land where nothing grows.

- **Crossbones Armory** `hg_town_weapons` — town · prices x1.15 · 12 items
  - description:
    > A squat stone building marked with crossed femurs above the door. The smith inside is alive — barely — and forges weapons from scavenged iron and whatever the gravediggers bring in.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_veter:
- **The Old Guard** `hg_veterans_camp` — veteran_camp · prices x1.0 · 1 items
  - description:
    > A ring of tents around a guttering fire, where warriors who have survived the hungry ghost realm long enough gather to share what they know. Their eyes have the hollow look of those who have seen too much decay.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › places › hg_wande:
- **Wandering Preta** `hg_wandering_preta` — general · prices x0.9 · 7 items
  - description:
    > A gaunt, distended figure with a neck like a needle and a belly like a drum. It clutches its wares with desperate hands, willing to trade food for almost anything — though it can never eat enough to be satisfied.
rendered.World › hungry_ghost › realm:
- **Pretaloka - The Hungry Ghost Realm** `realm` — 192x192 tiles
  - description:
    > The realm of insatiable craving, divided into fetid swamps crawling with the newly dead, ancient graveyards haunted by desiccated skeletons, and the charnel grounds where vetalas hold court in palaces that are not quite real.
  - notes:
    > From the hungry ghost events plan (all 60 planned events are built):
    >
    > Realm themes:
    > - **Insatiable hunger and craving** — the defining trait of pretas
    > - **Decay, rot, and impermanence** — everything is falling apart
    > - **Attachment to the past** — ghosts clinging to former lives
    > - **Three zones**: Fetid Swamps (rolang/zombies), Dry Graveyards (skeletons), Charnel Grounds (vetalas)
    >
    > Karma guidelines:
    > - Feeding/sharing → god, human karma
    > - Greed/hoarding → hungry_ghost karma
    > - Violence against undead → hell, asura karma
    > - Compassion/release → god karma
    > - Trickery/theft → animal, hungry_ghost karma
    > - Buddhist practice (yoga, ritual) → god karma
